content.original: Developed by Majesty M&M from battle data gathered in engagements with the Word of Blake's patterns of Phoenix Hawk BattleMechs, the Agrotera is a fast, hard-hitting Medium 'Mech packed with some of the most cutting-edge technology available. An XL 300 fusion engine and 240-meter jump capacity give the Agrotera excellent agility for it's weight class, while 9.5 tons of armor keep it reasonably safe against the hits that do land. The Agrotera is no slouch giving hits back, sporting an ERPPC linked to an advanced Actuator Enhancement System, backed by a Medium VSPL. A single normal Medium Pulse Laser and a pair of Small Pulse Lasers round out the Agrotera's arsenal and leave it well equipped to handle virtually any battlefield threat, entirely independent from supply line restrictions. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The Anzu was well-regarded by both MechWarriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had developed since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 km/h, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard Armor with CASE II built in to protect the 'Mech and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Мех Anzu был хорошо оценен как мехвоинами, так и техами за свою надежность; AMSC посчитали Anzu хорошо подходящим для агрессивной тактики боя, которую они разработали во время Джихада. Хотя максимальная наземная скорость Anzu составляла 64 км/ч, прыжковые двигатели Chilton 465 позволяли Anzu прыгать до 120 метров. Anzu был оснащен одиннадцатью тоннами стандартной брони Starshield A со встроенной системой CASE II для защиты меха и его пилота от взрывов боеприпасов. Anzu также использовал те же системы жизнеобеспечения, что и Shadow Hawk, уже хорошо зарекомендовавшие себя к моменту поступления Anzu на вооружение, а система наведения и сопровождения RCA Instatrac Mark X позволяла Anzu одновременно поражать несколько целей, а также помогать вести огонь непрямой наводкой, подсвечивая цели своим TAG. Особенность: Многоприцельный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.08 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Designed to engage in close-range brawls, the 100-ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated cXL Engine paired with TSM allows the BRZ-D4 to outrun almost any other heavy- or assault-grade Mech. A Bombast Laser and 4 Clan ER Medium Lasers make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10-ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. Angel ECM and Impact Resistant Armor keep the BRZ-D4 safe as it closes in, 4 Jump Jets provide extra mobility and allow the Berserker to execute lethal DFA attacks; while a head-mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original:
The Centurion OmniMech was born out of a desire on the part of Corean Enterprises to expand the company's market share. Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01

Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The CRD-9BR Crusader was an attempt by Bander BattleMechs to take a well-performing melee mech at the Solaris 7 arenas and make it into a production unit. Using an 325 XXL engine and TSM, it is incredibly fast to close up to other 'Mechs before it delivers a debilitating melee attack with its Claws. The variant also has four leg-mounted Medium Lasers and two side torso mounted Medium Pulse Lasers, complimented by a LRM-10 launcher in each arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

The full armament consists of a LRM-15, a light PPC and a Machine Gun in each arm, and two SRM-6 mounted in the legs. The 3.5 ton of combined ammunition is protected by a CASE II. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Cuirass main armament is the Rotary AC/5 carried in the left arm. Identical to the weapon used on the Legionnaire and Blade BattleMechs, this weapon can easily knock smaller opponents right off their feet. Three tons of ammunition keeps the Cuirass fighting for a long time. Unlike the Legionnaire the Cuirass can close with an enemy unit and finish it off with either its ER Medium Laser or (if it needs to cool down) the two ton Sword mounted in the right arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.content: Основным оружием «Кирасы» является Rotary AC/5, расположенная в левой руке. Подобно оружию, используемому на боевых мехах «Легионер» и «Блэйд», это оружие легко сбивает с ног небольших противников. Три тонны боеприпасов позволяют «Кирасе» вести бой долгое время. В отличие от «Легионера», «Кираса» может приблизиться к противнику и добить его либо своим средним ER-лазером, либо (если ему нужно остыть) двухтонным мечом в правой руке. Особенность: Прост в обслуживании Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower

content.original: The Dark Crow is a Clan Snow Raven developed Second Line BattleMech, which was produced only at its Inner Sphere facilities in the Outworlds Alliance after the Jihad. Named after a strange cave-dwelling bird found on Dante, the 'Mech has proven to be a popular design among Second Line troops. This variant of the Dark Crow appears to be a hybrid of the original Dark Crow and the Dark Crow 2, the ER Large Laser, which has been replaced with a standard Heavy Medium Laser and an advanced Targeting Computer, a configuration similar to that found on the Dark Crow 2. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: «Тёмный Ворон» — боевой мех второй линии, разработанный кланом Снежного Ворона и производившийся только на их заводах во Внутренней Сфере, в Альянсе Внешних Миров, после Джихада. Названный в честь странной пещерной птицы, найденной на Данте, этот мех оказался популярным среди отрядов второй линии. Этот вариант Dark Crow, по-видимому, является гибридом оригинального Dark Crow и Dark Crow 2, с ER Large Laser, заменённым на стандартный Heavy Medium Laser и продвинутый компьютер наведения, конфигурация, аналогичная той, что установлена ​​на Dark Crow 2. Особенность: Точное оружие - AC Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Powered by a 200 rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth G is armed with 4 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers augmented by a Targeting Computer. A Supercharger pushes the Fire Moth to even faster speeds. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

Предназначенный для разведки и транспортировки элементалей, Fire Moth поступил в производство в 2874 году. Сочетание ферроволокна и эндо-стали дает Fire Moth 7,5 тонн пространства под вооружение. The Fire Moth G is armed with 4 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers augmented by a Targeting Computer. A Supercharger pushes the Fire Moth to even faster speeds. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.98

content.original: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The C variants tactical capabilities are expanded thanks to the inclusion of an ECM Suite in the center torso, along with the three Improved Jump Jets split between the side torsos. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Деймос» был разработан кланом Снежного Ворона. Этот мех впервые был представлен в середине 3060-х годов, предположительно на планете Люм в Кластере Керенского. Однако во время Джихада разведслужбы Внутренней Сферы перестали получать информацию об этом мехе, и он канул в Лету. В 3085 году Снежные Вороны раскрыли Внутренней Сфере существование «Деймоса». Он считается гордостью их клана, и как минимум один такой мех был приписан к каждому тумену. Тактические возможности варианта C расширены за счет включения комплекта ECM в центральный торс, а также трех усовершенствованных прыжковых двигателей, распределенных между боковыми торсами. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.14 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: Designed for the Republic Armed Forces in 3121, the Doloire is an 80 ton Omnimech designed with a mixture of Clantech and Inner Sphere tech. Designed around a 320-rated Clan XL Engine and an Endo-Composite Structure, the Doloire has 32 tons of pod space, with a pair of Clan ER Medium Lasers hardwired into the Mechs CT. The Doloire DLR-O is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a Gauss Rifle. All of the weapons are Clantech versions, while 4 extra DHS and an Angel ECM suite round out the variant. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Разработанный для Вооружённых сил Республики в 3121 году, Doloire представляет собой 80-тонный омнимех, созданный с использованием технологий Кланов и Внутренней Сферы. Спроектированный на базе кланового двигателя XL320 и эндокомпозитной структуры, Doloire имеет 32 тонны под вооружение, вкупе с парой средних ER-лазеров, вмонтированных в CT меха. Doloire DLR-O вооружён парой больших импульсных лазеров и пушкой Гаусса. Всё оружие — клановые версии, а четыре дополнительных DHS и комплекс РЭБ «Ангел» завершают комплектацию. content.original: Clan Jade Falcon designed the Eyrie to parallel the Cougar, only with slightly less firepower in favor of a more well-rounded combat performance. It was first used in battle on the Lyran world of Zhongshan in 3087. Since then it has been deployed throughout the Clan's Clusters as light 'Mech hunters and fast support. Its distinctive wings, common with later Jade Falcon designs, allow the Eyrie to dissipate heat almost as fast as it gains it. In addition, the Partial Wing adds approximately sixty meters to the Eyrie's 150 meter range. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Intended to cripple and capture enemy units, the C configuration's principal tool in its mission is a TSEMP Cannon found in the left arm. Its offensive weaponry includes a single Snub-Nose PPC and a Light Autocannon/5 found in the other arm. Both arms' lower actuators have been removed to allow the 'Mech the flexibility of flipping its arms. CASE II has been added to the right torso to prevent any ammunition explosion effects from crippling the 'Mech's engine and arm weapons. One additional heat sink is added as well. Quirk: Adv. M.A.S.C. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike 'Mech that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the Republic of the Sphere. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A Beagle Active Probe allows the Ghost to find enemy units, while Stealth Armor and a Guardian ECM Suite allows the 'Mech to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins. This variant developed in 3087 replaces the standard weapons with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a single SRM-6. Built around an Endo Steel skeleton, this version uses a Defiance 300 Light Fusion Engine and standard armor with CASE to protect itself. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The Grand Summoner is a Heavy Class Clan OmniMech which was first produced by Clan Jade Falcon during the early years of the thirty-second century. Initially produced by the Eagle Craft Group on Erewhon in the Inner Sphere, the Grand Summoner(also known by the Clan as the Grand Summoner) proved to be a highly reliable replacement for the original Thor OmniMech. The design would soon be traded among other Inner Sphere Clans and became popular among their Warrior castes. One of the 'Mech's most noted actions was during Clan Wolf's Trial of Possession for then Clan Diamond Shark's entire Swimmer Khanate’s Beta Aimag. The flotilla’s commanders were able to bid down the Clan Wolf commander to a Cluster’s worth of forces on the world of Feltre. The Grand Summoner's performance in the hands of Diamond Shark MechWarriors in this difficult terrain helped to turn the tide of battle and resulted in winning the Trial. Clan Jade Falcon first produced the Grand Summoner as a distinct symbol of honor. This 'Mech is painted yearly in the parade scheme of a unit chosen by the Clan's Khan as part of tradition of honoring Clusters who had performed services honoring the Clan. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Grand Summoner — тяжёлый клановый омнимех, впервые произведённый кланом Нефритового Сокола в начале 32 века. Изначально производившийся Eagle Craft Group на Эревоне во Внутренней Сфере, Grand Summoner (также известный во Внутренней Сфере как «Тор II») оказался высоконадёжной заменой оригинальному омнимеху Summoner. content.original: The Grand Summoner is a Heavy Class Clan OmniMech which was first produced by Clan Jade Falcon during the early years of the thirty-second century. Initially produced by the Eagle Craft Group on Erewhon in the Inner Sphere, the Grand Summoner(also known by the Clan as the Grand Summoner) proved to be a highly reliable replacement for the original Thor OmniMech. The design would soon be traded among other Inner Sphere Clans and became popular among their Warrior castes. One of the 'Mech's most noted actions was during Clan Wolf's Trial of Possession for then Clan Diamond Shark's entire Swimmer Khanate’s Beta Aimag. The flotilla’s commanders were able to bid down the Clan Wolf commander to a Cluster’s worth of forces on the world of Feltre. The Grand Summoner's performance in the hands of Diamond Shark MechWarriors in this difficult terrain helped to turn the tide of battle and resulted in winning the Trial. Clan Jade Falcon first produced the Grand Summoner as a distinct symbol of honor. This 'Mech is painted yearly in the parade scheme of a unit chosen by the Clan's Khan as part of tradition of honoring Clusters who had performed services honoring the Clan. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Grand Summoner shares some similarities to its predecessor, sharing the same size XL Fusion Engine, and physical appearance. What differs from the older design is its Pod Capacity; the Grand Summoner has a 30.5 ton capacity over the older model's 22.5. This increase of capacity comes from the reshuffling of the 'Mech's internal components and dropping the original's permanently-mounted Jump Jets from the design. The Grand Summoner's armor protection is slightly greater than the original, with half a ton more. The Prime Configuration long-range firepower comes from its side-torso-mounted 15-Tubed Long-Range Missile Launcher and pair of arm-mounted Class 5 Ultra Autocannons. Their ammunition is kept where these weapons are housed, with single ton per Autocannon and two tons for the missile launcher. In intermediate and close ranges, the Grand Summoner's full arsenal — including its four Extended Range Medium Lasers — can be brought to bear on a target with a minimum of overheating concerns (except when its Jump Jets are in use).

content.original: This Grand Titan is based on a field refit. It carries a Heavy PPC, two ER Medium Lasers, a single ER Large Laser, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Pulse Laser for anti-infantry work. For close combat it carries a Sword. It also has a 90 meter jump radius. A Heavy Duty Gyro has been Armored, as has the cockpit and all the arm and leg actuators. At the same time, this Grand Titan is equipped with Triple Strength Myomer which allows it to inflict twice as much damage in a physical brawl, as well as reach speeds of 64 km/h. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: Built for speed, firepower, and simplicity, the Gyrfalcon became common in Jade Falcon Stars. Its 275-Rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine would help propel the design into the battlefield at 86 kph and at bursts to 108 kph with the help of its MASC. Included in its construction is a Partial Wing, which gives the design the ability to jump further than the normal 150 meters that its Jump Jets would be capable of. In addition to its regular sensors, the engineers would fit a Light Active Probe in the 'Mech's head to help it identify potential enemy targets.While it has been noted that its MechWarriors have it customized for their purposes, this design's original weapons layout consisted of two Series 6b Extended Range Large Lasers and two Type OVR-V LB 2-X ACs mounted in its shortened arms actuators. In addition to these ranged weapons systems, engineers would go on to reinforce the Gyrfalcon's legs. This is a nod to their touman changing its attitude towards the use of physical attacks, namely using Death from Above maneuver. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Developed prior to Gray Monday, the Hel is a Heavy Class OmniMech, which was originally created for the touman of Clan Jade Falcon. Also known as the Hel internally among the Clans, the Loki is an upgraded version of the venerable Hellbringer developed by Clan Hell's Horses in 2926. The new 'Mech differs from its thirtieth century originator by having heavier equipment capacity and improved armor protection but a lower top speed. The 'Mech would become primarily used by Clans Jade Falcon and Hell's Horses in 3145, where the 'Mech would see action during those Clans' invasions of the Inner Sphere powers such as the Republic of the Sphere and Lyran Commonwealth. A noted action that utilized the Loki was during the Jade Falcon's occupation of Sargasso in 3142. The 9th Talon deployed a binary of Lokis to suppress resistance in the city of Salicastrum. The Cluster's Lokis (fitted with B Configurations) used their Long Tom Cannons to blast rebel forces. However, a Nova of Wolf-In-Exiles forces ambushed the binary, and the ensuing battle rendered half the Jade Falcon Lokis destroyed, however the survivors would withdraw temporarily. A Star's worth of survivors from the 9th would return to force a Clan Wolf retreat and prevent the world from falling back into Commonwealth hands. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Известный в Кланах как «Хель», а во Внутренней Сфере как Loki Mk II, этот мех — это улучшенная версия почтенного «Хеллбрингера», разработанного кланом Адских Лошадей в 2926 году. Новый мех отличается от своего предшественника тридцатого века большей грузоподъёмностью и улучшенной броней, но меньшей максимальной скоростью. В 3145 году мех стал в основном использоваться кланами Нефритового Сокола и Адских Лошадей, где он участвовал в боевых действиях во время вторжений этих кланов в державы Внутренней Сферы, такие как Республика Сферы и Лиранское Содружество. Знаменитая операция с использованием Loki Mk II произошла во время оккупации Саргассо Нефритовыми Соколами в 3142 году. 9-й Коготь развернул бинарий Loki Mk II для подавления сопротивления в городе Саликаструм. Loki Mk II (оснащённые конфигурациями B) использовали свои пушки Long Tom для уничтожения повстанцев. Однако нова Волков-в-изгнании устроила засаду на бинарий, и в ходе последовавшего сражения половина «Локи» Нефритовых Соколов была уничтожена, однако выжившие временно отступили. Выжившая звезда из 9-го Когтя вернулась и вынудила клан Волка отступить и, тем самым, они предотвратили возвращение планеты в руки Содружества. Особенность: Experimental TC Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.1 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

Each of the Configuration's arms comes with an ER PPC and Medium Pulse Laser, and two Double Heat Sinks. In the right torso are fitted two hard-hitting Improved Heavy Medium Lasers and a pair of AP Gauss Rifles. The left side torso houses a single LB 10-X Class Autocannon, 'Mech's 2 tons of ammunition for the AC, and the single ton of space for AP Gauss Rifles' ammo. An additional Double Heat Sink is found in the center torso and another in the head, along with an additional two in each arm. An Angel ECM is mounted in the right torso for added protection.

content.original: Developed prior to Gray Monday, the Hel is a Heavy Class OmniMech, which was originally created for the touman of Clan Jade Falcon. Also known as the Hel internally among the Clans, the Loki is an upgraded version of the venerable Hellbringer developed by Clan Hell's Horses in 2926. The new 'Mech differs from its thirtieth century originator by having heavier equipment capacity and improved armor protection but a lower top speed. The 'Mech would become primarily used by Clans Jade Falcon and Hell's Horses in 3145, where the 'Mech would see action during those Clans' invasions of the Inner Sphere powers such as the Republic of the Sphere and Lyran Commonwealth. A noted action that utilized the Loki was during the Jade Falcon's occupation of Sargasso in 3142. The 9th Talon deployed a binary of Lokis to suppress resistance in the city of Salicastrum. The Cluster's Lokis (fitted with B Configurations) used their Long Tom Cannons to blast rebel forces. However, a Nova of Wolf-In-Exiles forces ambushed the binary, and the ensuing battle rendered half the Jade Falcon Lokis destroyed, however the survivors would withdraw temporarily. A Star's worth of survivors from the 9th would return to force a Clan Wolf retreat and prevent the world from falling back into Commonwealth hands. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Hel is noted for its large 40 ton Omni Pod Capacity. This improvement was achieved through reducing the size of the 'Mech's engine to a 260-Rated XL Fusion Engine, installing a Small Cockpit, and the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prime Configuration of the Loki is geared towards long-range combat. The 'Mech's arms are fitted with a pair of Gauss Rifles and ER Large Lasers. In closer ranges, MechWarriors have a right torso mounted 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher to add additional firepower where the Gauss Rifles become difficult to aim. The main guns are supplied with 3 tons of ammunition, while the Streak launcher is allotted a single ton. Two additional Double Heat Sinks are fitted to the Prime, to help it cope with the heat of the ER Larges.

content.original: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industries rediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: «Шершень» дебютировал в 2760 году как городской разведывательный мех, но два года спустя отсутствие заинтересованности у покупателей вынудило приостановить проект. В 2990 году Kallon Industries вновь обнаружила чертежи и возобновила производство. Модернизированный HNT-171 начал производство в 3051 году. Производственная линия была уничтожена капелланцами в 3069 году. Мех разработан с учетом возможности быстрого перемещения по городской среде с относительно тяжелой броней. В целом, из-за своего разнонаправленного вооружения и относительно низкой скорости, Hornet лишь отчасти эффективен в городе. Вне городской среды меху трудно защищаться. It carries a Small Re-Engineered Laser, Small Laser, and an MML-5 with two tons of ammunition in a CASE protected bay. It is most frequently seen in the service of AFFS and Filtvelt Coalition militias.

content.original: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industries rediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: «Шершень» дебютировал в 2760 году как городской разведывательный мех, но два года спустя отсутствие заинтересованности у покупателей вынудило приостановить проект. В 2990 году Kallon Industries вновь обнаружила чертежи и возобновила производство. Модернизированный HNT-171 начал производство в 3051 году. Производственная линия была уничтожена капелланцами в 3069 году. Мех разработан с учетом возможности быстрого перемещения по городской среде с относительно тяжелой броней. В целом, из-за своего разнонаправленного вооружения и относительно низкой скорости, Hornet лишь отчасти эффективен в городе. Вне городской среды меху трудно защищаться. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

Ice Ferret — 45-тонный омнимех Кланов, оснащенный двигателем XL360 и благодаря сочетанию эндостали, двигателя XL и ферроволокна имеет 9,5 тонн пространства под вооружение. Ice Ferret IFR-J вооружён десятью малыми ER-лазерами и двумя тяжёлыми пулемётами. Компьютер прицеливания повышает точность оружия, а Supercharger увеличивает максимальную скорость.

content.original: The Jenner has been the stalwart of DCMS light lances for centuries. The JR7-N combines the frame of the -C4 model with more conventional weapons. Heavy ferro-fibrous armor provides nearly maximum protection, and CASE II protects the vulnerable XL engine. The JR7-N improved its scouting and raiding abilities with increased jump range and a Beagle Active Probe. Careful pilots have learned to stagger weapons fire and jumping to avoid overheating. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of Common Sense Rules for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Предназначавшийся как для продажи клиентам из Внутренней Сферы, так и для Кланов, он был отвергнут Кланами, за исключением Нова Котов и изгнанных Волков, как «...оскорбление всего, за что выступал и чему нас учил Николай Керенский». Тем не менее, мех оказался популярен в государствах-наследниках.

content.original: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. Designed as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL Engine is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of armor which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with.Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16.

content.original: A Regulan design built to emulate the Lyran Berzerker, the Neandertal is an 80 ton Battlemech designed around two concepts – speed and close combat. A 400-rated XL Engine paired with TSM helps achieve the first objective, while a massive Hatchet makes the Neanderthal deadly in close quarters. The Neanderthal NTL-AG is armed with a pair of Snub Nose PPC’s augmented by a PPC Capacitor. A trio of Rocket Launchers provide additional punch in close quarters, while Guardian ECM rounds out the mech. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: The Omen is a Clan Assault BattleMech that was created by Clan Snow Raven in the post-Jihad era. Designed as an all-purpose combat unit, the Omen is considered to be slower than the typical late thirty-first century Clan Assault BattleMech. However, its well-rounded weaponry and its 16.5 tons of Standard Armor allows it to be durable in combat. Also to help with its lack of speed, the Omen has been given three Jump Jets, which allow the 'Mech to tactically position itself up to 90 meters in the air and effectively use its weapons. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Designed as a cost effective Assault grade battlemech, the Onager OGR-1 was created by the Jade Falcons to replace captured Inner Sphere mechs used by Garrison troops. A 270-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis allow the mech to carry a mammoth HAG/30. Supporting this are a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of SRM-6’s with 2 Micro Pulse Lasers and a Small Pulse Laser deterring Infantry. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original: Developed in 3139, the OSP-36 was the first non-prototype Advanced Point Defense System-equipped BattleMech introduced by the Republic Armed Forces. To mount a APDS system and a ton of ammo in each arm, the OSP-36 drops the Beagle probe and ER Small Laser entirely, replacing the Gauss Rifle with an ER PPC supported by a Radical Heat Sink System to free up the required weight while allowing the variant to remain combat-effective. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Conceptualised as a long range support platform, the Pendragon was a result of House Davion’s Jihad era MUSE programs. A 95-ton mech, the Pendragon is built around a 380-rated XL Engine and is loosely based on the Templar OmniMech. The Pendragon PDR-1R is the first production model and unlike the original prototype is entirely built with Inner Sphere technology. A pair of Extended Range LRM-15’s provide extreme range firepower, while an ER PPC and a trio of ER Medium Lasers provide closer ranged firepower. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: Задуманный как платформа поддержки дальнего действия, «Пендрагон» появился в результате реализации программ MUSE Дома Дэвион времён Джихада. 95-тонный мех «Пендрагон» построен на базе двигателя XL380 и в некоторой степени основан на омнимехе «Тамплиер». Pendragon PDR-1R — первая серийная модель, и, в отличие от оригинального прототипа, она полностью построена по технологиям Внутренней Сферы. Пара ракет LRM-15 увеличенной дальности обеспечивают огневую мощь на экстремальном расстоянии, а ER PPC и три ER Medium Lasers — при приближении. Особенность: Улучшенное наведение - Long Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.17 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: After the Free Worlds League acquired the Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle technology from House Davion they put out a request for an experimental platform to trial the new weapons on. The RFL-7G was introduced by Kallon Industries in 3085 as their answer, mounting two Silver Bullet Gauss Rifles instead of the Autocannon-based weaponry their other models used. Due to the larger size and need for more ammunition bins the 'Mech could only fit 2 Extended Range Medium Lasers as the complementary armament. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Taking a cue from Clan Jade Falcon’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’Mech’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized armor coverage to see the Clan’s precious OmniMechs and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III A configuration features only a ER Large Laser in each arm. Mobility has been substantially increased with the retention of the MASC system and the inclusion of eight pod mounted Improved Jump Jets to increase jump ranges 50% over the original Shadow Cat. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Взяв пример с Thor II клана Нефритового Сокола десятилетней давности, ученые Нова Котов убрали из оригинального Shadow Cat фиксированные прыжковые двигатели. Большая часть свободного тоннажа направилась на вооружение, повышая гибкость меха, а остальное - на броню, чтобы драгоценные омнимехи и воины Кланов смогли безопасно вернуться домой. Конфигурация Shadow Cat III A оснащена только одним большим ER-лазером в каждой руке. Мобильность значительно повышена благодаря сохранению системы MASC и установке восьми улучшенных прыжковых двигателей, что увеличивает дальность прыжков на 50% по сравнению с оригинальной версией Shadow Cat. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.04 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: Taking a cue from Clan Jade Falcon’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’Mech’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized armor coverage to see the Clan’s precious OmniMechs and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III C configuration does away with all Jump Jets in favor of extreme ground mobility in the form of the standard MASC system and an engine Supercharger allowing it to reach burst speeds of up to 162 km/h. Complimenting this speed is massive firepower in the form of an LB 20-X Autocannon and an Improved Heavy Large Laser.

content.content: Взяв пример с Thor II клана Нефритового Сокола десятилетней давности, ученые Нова Котов убрали из оригинального Shadow Cat фиксированные прыжковые двигатели. Большая часть свободного тоннажа направилась на вооружение, повышая гибкость меха, а остальное - на броню, чтобы драгоценные омнимехи и воины Кланов смогли безопасно вернуться домой. Конфигурация Shadow Cat III C избавлена ​​от всех прыжковых двигателей в пользу исключительной наземной мобильности благодаря стандартной системе MASC и Supercharger, дающие пиковую скорость 162 км/ч. Дополняет эту скорость огневая мощь в виде автопушки LB 20-X и улучшенного тяжёлого лазера.

content.original: The Shrike is outfitted with a powerful Targeting Computer that allows it to bring accurate firepower to bear on the battlefield. It has a hard-hitting armament that gives the 'Mech a powerful sting in combat at most ranges. A Long Bow LRM-10-rack allows pilots to engage enemies at long range, and two Type 9 Ultra Autocannon/5s are effective against even other assault-class 'Mechs. Lastly, two Series 2b ER Large Lasers provide a fairly powerful punch should the other weapon systems deplete their ammunition. The design owes its large weapon capacity to due use to its Endo Steel construction and its large 380-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine. Engineers enhanced the design by adding a Partial Wing, giving the Shrike extra jump capacity as well as additional cooling abilities under normal atmospheric conditions. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded armor protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this armor is still too light to allow the 'Mech to operate in a stand up fight. Double Heat Sinks keep the Stinger IIC cool. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01

Возможность прыжка на 180 метров также полезна, позволяя пилоту очень быстро выбраться из труднопроходимой местности. Модернизированная броня ценится воинами, которые пилотировали старый Stinger, но эта броня все еще слишком легкая, чтобы позволить меху принимать участие в прямых столкновениях. Double Heat Sinks keep the Stinger IIC cool. Особенность: Распространенный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.01

content.original: The Tenshi, ("Angel" in japanese), is an Assault Class OmniMech, which was manufactured during the early thirty-second century for the Draconis Combine's armed forces. A product of House Kurita's hidden efforts to rebuild its decimated 'Mech regiments, the Tenshi was designed to use resources found within the Combine. The Tenshi was first deployed among the ranks of the Ghost Regiments in the early 3100s, its deployment with a less-renowned brigade was part of the DCMS' two-fold effort of testing the 'Mech while also providing a fire-wall to save face should the design prove to be a failure in combat. One of its first deployments was in 3103, when the 1st Ghost conducted a raid on the Ghost Bear Dominionworld of Grumium. The eight Tenshis among the Ghosts' ranks performed well, with most of their numbers returning to the Combine with stolen Clan technology. Among the Tenshi's design features is its durability and having a heavy equipment payload. The designers saw fit to equip the 'Mech with a Compact Gyro and 18.5 tons of Standard Armor. The Tenshi also uses a number of new technologies that had finally entered production in the decades preceding the Jihad. The use of an Endo-Composite internal structure and a Light Fusion Engine granted the design a huge pod capacity of 48 tons. However, this large capacity had come at a price; that price being a slightly lower maximum speed than other comparable designs of the era." Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Тэнши» («Ангел» по-японски) — омнимех штурмового класса, произведённый в начале 32-го века для Вооружённых сил Синдиката Дракона. «Тэнши», являясь результатом усилий Дома Куриты скрытно восстановить свои поредевшие полки мехов, был разработан лишь на ресурсах, найденных внутри Синдиката. «Тэнши» впервые был задействован в рядах Призрачных полков в начале 3100-х годов. Его причисление в состав менее известной бригады несло несколько целей: испытание меха и перестраховка, позволяющая сохранить лицо в случае неудачи меха в бою. Одна из первых высадок состоялась в 3103 году, когда 1-й Призрачный совершил налёт на планету-доминион Призрачного Медведя, Грумиум. ​​Восемь «Тэнши» из рядов Призраков показали себя хорошо, и большинство из них вернулись в Синдикат с украденными технологиями Кланов. Среди конструктивных особенностей «Тэнши» — его прочность и тяжёлая боевая нагрузка. Конструкторы сочли целесообразным оснастить мех компактным гироскопом и стандартной броней весом 18,5 тонн. «Тэнши» также использует ряд новых технологий, которые наконец-то поступили в производство. Использование эндокомпозитной внутренней конструкции и лёгкого термоядерного двигателя позволило увеличить полезную нагрузку до 48 тонн. Однако такая высокая грузоподъёмность имела свою цену: максимальная скорость была несколько ниже, чем у других сопоставимых моделей той эпохи." Особенность: Встроенный прожектор Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.12 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Tenshi's Primary configuration is equipped mainly with standard technologies that allow the 'Mech to engage an enemy unit at long-range. Its main weapon is an arm-mounted Gauss Rifle which is fed with 3 tons of ammunition. Its other set of long range weaponry consists five Light Particle Projection Cannons, all of which are fitted into the 'Mech's right arm. For a last resort, the 'Mech sports a pair of 10-tubed Rocket Launchers, with one placed in each of its legs. All of the energy weapons are tied to a Targeting Computer for greater accuracy. Among other equipment found in this configuration is a Guardian ECM, providing an electronic screen against enemy attacks, while a Supercharger is fitted into the center torso to help temporarily increase ground speed.

content.original: The A configuration's principle firepower comes from three Large Variable Speed Pulse Lasers, one mounted in each of the arms and in the center torso. Backing up the lasers is a single Apollo FCS-guided 30-tubed Medium-Range Missile Launcher with two tons of CASE II-protected ammunition. To help manage the great amounts of heat generated by the weapons, five additional Double Heat Sinks are added as well as a Coolant Pod.

Использование эндокомпозитной внутренней конструкции и лёгкого термоядерного двигателя позволило увеличить полезную нагрузку до 48 тонн. Однако такая высокая грузоподъёмность имела свою цену: максимальная скорость была несколько ниже, чем у других сопоставимых моделей той эпохи." Особенность: Встроенный прожектор Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.12 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: A much tougher BattleMech than its predecessor, the Viking IIC is protected by a massive 31 tons of GC Hardened Slab Armor. This is a dense and tough hardened armor, which while providing considerable protection in combat also slows the 'Mech down. Its lack of speed would make the Viking IIC unpopular with Clan warriors, who prefer swifter machines in combat. The foundation of toughness is also found in its GC Type 2C Endo Steel skeleton and a General Motors 270-Rated Fusion Engine. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Standing at ten meters tall, the Watchman is a 'Mech that was born of necessity. The idea for the design came when the bulk of the AFFS was moved to the Clan front. Because this seriously undermined the ability of the Federated Suns to keep its borders secure, the Watchman was designed to be distributed to militia units within the border marches to bulk up their strength. In its own right the Watchman is a durable and reliable 'Mech that is built with off the shelf components and is very easy to repair. The 'Mech is armored with eight and a half tons of standard armor, has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This, combined with the Watchman's varied arsenal, makes it an excellent trooper or trainer. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The -X3 carried four ER Medium Lasers in the right arm and an ER PPC in the left arm, connected to a Targeting Computer. The true uniqueness of the design came in its use of Improved Jump Jets: the -X3 could jump up to 240 meters, which rivaled the jumping capability of any light 'Mech. This combination of heavy armor, speed and firepower made -the X3 the nightmare of any light or medium 'Mech and could outmaneuver any heavy or assault 'Mech. The -X3 mounted seventeen double heat sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content:
Изготовленный на заводе Defiance в Кванжон-ни, Zeus X стал одновременно образцом совершенства в области производственной инженерии и инновационной высокотехнологичной платформой. X3 нёс четыре средних ER-лазера в правой руке и одну ER PPC в левой, соединённых с компьютером наведения. Уникальность конструкции заключалась в использовании улучшенных прыжковых двигателей: X3 мог прыгать до 240 метров, что превосходило прыжковые возможности даже лёгких мехов. Сочетание тяжёлой брони, скорости и огневой мощи делало X3 настоящим кошмаром для любого лёгкого или среднего меха и превосходило по манёвренности любой тяжёлый или штурмовой мех. X3 нёс семнадцать двойных охладителей. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.2

Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Developed by Majesty M&M from battle data gathered in engagements with the Word of Blake's patterns of Phoenix Hawk BattleMechs, the Agrotera is a fast, hard-hitting Medium 'Mech packed with some of the most cutting-edge technology available. An XL 300 fusion engine and 240-meter jump capacity give the Agrotera excellent agility for it's weight class, while 9.5 tons of armor keep it reasonably safe against the hits that do land. The Agrotera is no slouch giving hits back, sporting an ERPPC linked to an advanced Actuator Enhancement System, backed by a Medium VSPL. A single normal Medium Pulse Laser and a pair of Small Pulse Lasers round out the Agrotera's arsenal and leave it well equipped to handle virtually any battlefield threat, entirely independent from supply line restrictions. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The Anzu was well-regarded by both MechWarriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had developed since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 km/h, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard Armor with CASE II built in to protect the 'Mech and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Особенность: Надёжное вооружение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.09

content.original: The CRD-9BR Crusader was an attempt by Bander BattleMechs to take a well-performing melee mech at the Solaris 7 arenas and make it into a production unit. Using an 325 XXL engine and TSM, it is incredibly fast to close up to other 'Mechs before it delivers a debilitating melee attack with its Claws. The variant also has four leg-mounted Medium Lasers and two side torso mounted Medium Pulse Lasers, complimented by a LRM-10 launcher in each arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Cuirass main armament is the Rotary AC/5 carried in the left arm. Identical to the weapon used on the Legionnaire and Blade BattleMechs, this weapon can easily knock smaller opponents right off their feet. Three tons of ammunition keeps the Cuirass fighting for a long time. Unlike the Legionnaire the Cuirass can close with an enemy unit and finish it off with either its ER Medium Laser or (if it needs to cool down) the two ton Sword mounted in the right arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.content: Основным оружием «Кирасы» является Rotary AC/5, расположенная в левой руке. Подобно оружию, используемому на боевых мехах «Легионер» и «Блэйд», это оружие легко сбивает с ног небольших противников. Три тонны боеприпасов позволяют «Кирасе» вести бой долгое время. В отличие от «Легионера», «Кираса» может приблизиться к противнику и добить его либо своим средним ER-лазером, либо (если ему нужно остыть) двухтонным мечом в правой руке. Особенность: Прост в обслуживании Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower

content.original: The Dark Crow is a Clan Snow Raven developed Second Line BattleMech, which was produced only at its Inner Sphere facilities in the Outworlds Alliance after the Jihad. Named after a strange cave-dwelling bird found on Dante, the 'Mech has proven to be a popular design among Second Line troops. This variant of the Dark Crow appears to be a hybrid of the original Dark Crow and the Dark Crow 2, the ER Large Laser, which has been replaced with a standard Heavy Medium Laser and an advanced Targeting Computer, a configuration similar to that found on the Dark Crow 2. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: «Тёмный Ворон» — боевой мех второй линии, разработанный кланом Снежного Ворона и производившийся только на их заводах во Внутренней Сфере, в Альянсе Внешних Миров, после Джихада. Названный в честь странной пещерной птицы, найденной на Данте, этот мех оказался популярным среди отрядов второй линии. Этот вариант Dark Crow, по-видимому, является гибридом оригинального Dark Crow и Dark Crow 2, с ER Large Laser, заменённым на стандартный Heavy Medium Laser и продвинутый компьютер наведения, конфигурация, аналогичная той, что установлена ​​на Dark Crow 2. Особенность: Точное оружие - AC Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Powered by a 200 rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth G is armed with 4 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers augmented by a Targeting Computer. A Supercharger pushes the Fire Moth to even faster speeds. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

content.original: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The C variants tactical capabilities are expanded thanks to the inclusion of an ECM Suite in the center torso, along with the three Improved Jump Jets split between the side torsos. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Деймос» был разработан кланом Снежного Ворона. Этот мех впервые был представлен в середине 3060-х годов, предположительно на планете Люм в Кластере Керенского. Однако во время Джихада разведслужбы Внутренней Сферы перестали получать информацию об этом мехе, и он канул в Лету. В 3085 году Снежные Вороны раскрыли Внутренней Сфере существование «Деймоса». Он считается гордостью их клана, и как минимум один такой мех был приписан к каждому тумену. Тактические возможности варианта C расширены за счет включения комплекта ECM в центральный торс, а также трех усовершенствованных прыжковых двигателей, распределенных между боковыми торсами. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.14 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: Designed for the Republic Armed Forces in 3121, the Doloire is an 80 ton Omnimech designed with a mixture of Clantech and Inner Sphere tech. Designed around a 320-rated Clan XL Engine and an Endo-Composite Structure, the Doloire has 32 tons of pod space, with a pair of Clan ER Medium Lasers hardwired into the Mechs CT. The Doloire DLR-O is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a Gauss Rifle. All of the weapons are Clantech versions, while 4 extra DHS and an Angel ECM suite round out the variant. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Разработанный для Вооружённых сил Республики в 3121 году, Doloire представляет собой 80-тонный омнимех, созданный с использованием технологий Кланов и Внутренней Сферы. Спроектированный на базе кланового двигателя XL320 и эндокомпозитной структуры, Doloire имеет 32 тонны под вооружение, вкупе с парой средних ER-лазеров, вмонтированных в CT меха. Doloire DLR-O вооружён парой больших импульсных лазеров и пушкой Гаусса. Всё оружие — клановые версии, а четыре дополнительных DHS и комплекс РЭБ «Ангел» завершают комплектацию. content.original: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike 'Mech that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the Republic of the Sphere. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A Beagle Active Probe allows the Ghost to find enemy units, while Stealth Armor and a Guardian ECM Suite allows the 'Mech to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins. This variant developed in 3087 replaces the standard weapons with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a single SRM-6. Built around an Endo Steel skeleton, this version uses a Defiance 300 Light Fusion Engine and standard armor with CASE to protect itself. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The Grand Summoner is a Heavy Class Clan OmniMech which was first produced by Clan Jade Falcon during the early years of the thirty-second century. Initially produced by the Eagle Craft Group on Erewhon in the Inner Sphere, the Grand Summoner(also known by the Clan as the Grand Summoner) proved to be a highly reliable replacement for the original Thor OmniMech. The design would soon be traded among other Inner Sphere Clans and became popular among their Warrior castes. One of the 'Mech's most noted actions was during Clan Wolf's Trial of Possession for then Clan Diamond Shark's entire Swimmer Khanate’s Beta Aimag. The flotilla’s commanders were able to bid down the Clan Wolf commander to a Cluster’s worth of forces on the world of Feltre. The Grand Summoner's performance in the hands of Diamond Shark MechWarriors in this difficult terrain helped to turn the tide of battle and resulted in winning the Trial. Clan Jade Falcon first produced the Grand Summoner as a distinct symbol of honor. This 'Mech is painted yearly in the parade scheme of a unit chosen by the Clan's Khan as part of tradition of honoring Clusters who had performed services honoring the Clan. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Grand Summoner — тяжёлый клановый омнимех, впервые произведённый кланом Нефритового Сокола в начале 32 века. Изначально производившийся Eagle Craft Group на Эревоне во Внутренней Сфере, Grand Summoner (также известный во Внутренней Сфере как «Тор II») оказался высоконадёжной заменой оригинальному омнимеху Summoner. Вскоре мех стал предметом обмена среди других кланов во Внутренней Сфере и стал популярен среди их каст воинов. Клан Нефритового Сокола создал Grand Summoner как особый символ гордости. Первый в истории Grand Summoner с серийным номером JF000-01A установлен на стеле перед воротами завода Эревона. Каждый год его перекрашивают в парадные расцветки на выбор кластера хана, чтобы почтить службу этого юнита клану. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: This Grand Titan is based on a field refit. It carries a Heavy PPC, two ER Medium Lasers, a single ER Large Laser, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Pulse Laser for anti-infantry work. For close combat it carries a Sword. It also has a 90 meter jump radius. A Heavy Duty Gyro has been Armored, as has the cockpit and all the arm and leg actuators. At the same time, this Grand Titan is equipped with Triple Strength Myomer which allows it to inflict twice as much damage in a physical brawl, as well as reach speeds of 64 km/h. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

Armed with an ER PPC and an Enhanced LRM-10 with Artemis IV, the Griffin 3N can fight at much longer ranges than would be expected from a standard Griffin. Case II and heavier armor round out the design, making it much more resistant to damage or ammunition explosions. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Built for speed, firepower, and simplicity, the Gyrfalcon became common in Jade Falcon Stars. Its 275-Rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine would help propel the design into the battlefield at 86 kph and at bursts to 108 kph with the help of its MASC. Included in its construction is a Partial Wing, which gives the design the ability to jump further than the normal 150 meters that its Jump Jets would be capable of. In addition to its regular sensors, the engineers would fit a Light Active Probe in the 'Mech's head to help it identify potential enemy targets.While it has been noted that its MechWarriors have it customized for their purposes, this design's original weapons layout consisted of two Series 6b Extended Range Large Lasers and two Type OVR-V LB 2-X ACs mounted in its shortened arms actuators. In addition to these ranged weapons systems, engineers would go on to reinforce the Gyrfalcon's legs. This is a nod to their touman changing its attitude towards the use of physical attacks, namely using Death from Above maneuver. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

With his sibkin, Galaxy Commander Malvina Hazen, they would nearly take the world through his methods. However, he would be killed in action with Prefect Tara Campbell at the hands of her Hatchetman signature weapon. content.original: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Developed prior to Gray Monday, the Hel is a Heavy Class OmniMech, which was originally created for the touman of Clan Jade Falcon. Also known as the Hel internally among the Clans, the Loki is an upgraded version of the venerable Hellbringer developed by Clan Hell's Horses in 2926. The new 'Mech differs from its thirtieth century originator by having heavier equipment capacity and improved armor protection but a lower top speed. The 'Mech would become primarily used by Clans Jade Falcon and Hell's Horses in 3145, where the 'Mech would see action during those Clans' invasions of the Inner Sphere powers such as the Republic of the Sphere and Lyran Commonwealth. A noted action that utilized the Loki was during the Jade Falcon's occupation of Sargasso in 3142. The 9th Talon deployed a binary of Lokis to suppress resistance in the city of Salicastrum. The Cluster's Lokis (fitted with B Configurations) used their Long Tom Cannons to blast rebel forces. However, a Nova of Wolf-In-Exiles forces ambushed the binary, and the ensuing battle rendered half the Jade Falcon Lokis destroyed, however the survivors would withdraw temporarily. A Star's worth of survivors from the 9th would return to force a Clan Wolf retreat and prevent the world from falling back into Commonwealth hands. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Разработанный до Серого Понедельника, «Хель» — тяжёлый омнимех, изначально созданный для тумена клана Нефритового Сокола. Известный в Кланах как «Хель», а во Внутренней Сфере как Loki Mk II, этот мех — это улучшенная версия почтенного «Хеллбрингера», разработанного кланом Адских Лошадей в 2926 году. Новый мех отличается от своего предшественника тридцатого века большей грузоподъёмностью и улучшенной броней, но меньшей максимальной скоростью. В 3145 году мех стал в основном использоваться кланами Нефритового Сокола и Адских Лошадей, где он участвовал в боевых действиях во время вторжений этих кланов в державы Внутренней Сферы, такие как Республика Сферы и Лиранское Содружество. Знаменитая операция с использованием Loki Mk II произошла во время оккупации Саргассо Нефритовыми Соколами в 3142 году. 9-й Коготь развернул бинарий Loki Mk II для подавления сопротивления в городе Саликаструм. Loki Mk II (оснащённые конфигурациями B) использовали свои пушки Long Tom для уничтожения повстанцев. Однако нова Волков-в-изгнании устроила засаду на бинарий, и в ходе последовавшего сражения половина «Локи» Нефритовых Соколов была уничтожена, однако выжившие временно отступили. Выжившая звезда из 9-го Когтя вернулась и вынудила клан Волка отступить и, тем самым, они предотвратили возвращение планеты в руки Содружества. Особенность: Experimental TC Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.1 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industries rediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of Common Sense Rules for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Taking a cue from Clan Jade Falcon’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’Mech’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized armor coverage to see the Clan’s precious OmniMechs and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III A configuration features only a ER Large Laser in each arm. Большая часть свободного тоннажа направилась на вооружение, повышая гибкость меха, а остальное - на броню, чтобы драгоценные омнимехи и воины Кланов смогли безопасно вернуться домой. Мобильность значительно повышена благодаря сохранению системы MASC и установке восьми улучшенных прыжковых двигателей, что увеличивает дальность прыжков на 50% по сравнению с оригинальной версией Shadow Cat. content.original: The Shrike is outfitted with a powerful Targeting Computer that allows it to bring accurate firepower to bear on the battlefield. It has a hard-hitting armament that gives the 'Mech a powerful sting in combat at most ranges. A Long Bow LRM-10-rack allows pilots to engage enemies at long range, and two Type 9 Ultra Autocannon/5s are effective against even other assault-class 'Mechs. Lastly, two Series 2b ER Large Lasers provide a fairly powerful punch should the other weapon systems deplete their ammunition. The design owes its large weapon capacity to due use to its Endo Steel construction and its large 380-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine. Engineers enhanced the design by adding a Partial Wing, giving the Shrike extra jump capacity as well as additional cooling abilities under normal atmospheric conditions. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Tenshi, ("Angel" in japanese), is an Assault Class OmniMech, which was manufactured during the early thirty-second century for the Draconis Combine's armed forces. A product of House Kurita's hidden efforts to rebuild its decimated 'Mech regiments, the Tenshi was designed to use resources found within the Combine. The Tenshi was first deployed among the ranks of the Ghost Regiments in the early 3100s, its deployment with a less-renowned brigade was part of the DCMS' two-fold effort of testing the 'Mech while also providing a fire-wall to save face should the design prove to be a failure in combat. One of its first deployments was in 3103, when the 1st Ghost conducted a raid on the Ghost Bear Dominionworld of Grumium. The eight Tenshis among the Ghosts' ranks performed well, with most of their numbers returning to the Combine with stolen Clan technology. Among the Tenshi's design features is its durability and having a heavy equipment payload. The designers saw fit to equip the 'Mech with a Compact Gyro and 18.5 tons of Standard Armor. The Tenshi also uses a number of new technologies that had finally entered production in the decades preceding the Jihad. The use of an Endo-Composite internal structure and a Light Fusion Engine granted the design a huge pod capacity of 48 tons. However, this large capacity had come at a price; that price being a slightly lower maximum speed than other comparable designs of the era." Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Тэнши» («Ангел» по-японски) — омнимех штурмового класса, произведённый в начале 32-го века для Вооружённых сил Синдиката Дракона. «Тэнши», являясь результатом усилий Дома Куриты скрытно восстановить свои поредевшие полки мехов, был разработан лишь на ресурсах, найденных внутри Синдиката. «Тэнши» впервые был задействован в рядах Призрачных полков в начале 3100-х годов. Его причисление в состав менее известной бригады несло несколько целей: испытание меха и перестраховка, позволяющая сохранить лицо в случае неудачи меха в бою. Одна из первых высадок состоялась в 3103 году, когда 1-й Призрачный совершил налёт на планету-доминион Призрачного Медведя, Грумиум. ​​Восемь «Тэнши» из рядов Призраков показали себя хорошо, и большинство из них вернулись в Синдикат с украденными технологиями Кланов. Среди конструктивных особенностей «Тэнши» — его прочность и тяжёлая боевая нагрузка. Конструкторы сочли целесообразным оснастить мех компактным гироскопом и стандартной броней весом 18,5 тонн. «Тэнши» также использует ряд новых технологий, которые наконец-то поступили в производство. Использование эндокомпозитной внутренней конструкции и лёгкого термоядерного двигателя позволило увеличить полезную нагрузку до 48 тонн. Однако такая высокая грузоподъёмность имела свою цену: максимальная скорость была несколько ниже, чем у других сопоставимых моделей той эпохи." Особенность: Встроенный прожектор Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.12 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Tenshi, ("Angel" in japanese), is an Assault Class OmniMech, which was manufactured during the early thirty-second century for the Draconis Combine's armed forces. A product of House Kurita's hidden efforts to rebuild its decimated 'Mech regiments, the Tenshi was designed to use resources found within the Combine. The Tenshi was first deployed among the ranks of the Ghost Regiments in the early 3100s, its deployment with a less-renowned brigade was part of the DCMS' two-fold effort of testing the 'Mech while also providing a fire-wall to save face should the design prove to be a failure in combat. One of its first deployments was in 3103, when the 1st Ghost conducted a raid on the Ghost Bear Dominionworld of Grumium. The eight Tenshis among the Ghosts' ranks performed well, with most of their numbers returning to the Combine with stolen Clan technology. Among the Tenshi's design features is its durability and having a heavy equipment payload. The designers saw fit to equip the 'Mech with a Compact Gyro and 18.5 tons of Standard Armor. The Tenshi also uses a number of new technologies that had finally entered production in the decades preceding the Jihad. The use of an Endo-Composite internal structure and a Light Fusion Engine granted the design a huge pod capacity of 48 tons. However, this large capacity had come at a price; that price being a slightly lower maximum speed than other comparable designs of the era." Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Standing at ten meters tall, the Watchman is a 'Mech that was born of necessity. The idea for the design came when the bulk of the AFFS was moved to the Clan front. Because this seriously undermined the ability of the Federated Suns to keep its borders secure, the Watchman was designed to be distributed to militia units within the border marches to bulk up their strength. In its own right the Watchman is a durable and reliable 'Mech that is built with off the shelf components and is very easy to repair. The 'Mech is armored with eight and a half tons of standard armor, has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This, combined with the Watchman's varied arsenal, makes it an excellent trooper or trainer. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The -X3 carried four ER Medium Lasers in the right arm and an ER PPC in the left arm, connected to a Targeting Computer. The true uniqueness of the design came in its use of Improved Jump Jets: the -X3 could jump up to 240 meters, which rivaled the jumping capability of any light 'Mech. This combination of heavy armor, speed and firepower made -the X3 the nightmare of any light or medium 'Mech and could outmaneuver any heavy or assault 'Mech. The -X3 mounted seventeen double heat sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

content.content:
Изготовленный на заводе Defiance в Кванжон-ни, Zeus X стал одновременно образцом совершенства в области производственной инженерии и инновационной высокотехнологичной платформой. X3 нёс четыре средних ER-лазера в правой руке и одну ER PPC в левой, соединённых с компьютером наведения. Уникальность конструкции заключалась в использовании улучшенных прыжковых двигателей: X3 мог прыгать до 240 метров, что превосходило прыжковые возможности даже лёгких мехов. Сочетание тяжёлой брони, скорости и огневой мощи делало X3 настоящим кошмаром для любого лёгкого или среднего меха и превосходило по манёвренности любой тяжёлый или штурмовой мех. X3 нёс семнадцать двойных охладителей. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.2

content.original: First introduced in 3096, this post-Jihad design was created by Clan Wolf as a cheap anti-aircraft platform. Slow and heavily armored, the Aesir is often set into static positions where its relatively slow speed is not considered a liability. The Aesir mounts a set of four Type Sierra LB-X Autocannon/2s in its turret. With their long range, and cluster munitions, they serve as an effective counter against airborne raiders. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: The Aithon Assault Transport is a Clan heavy infantry transport first produced by Swedenborg Heavy Industries in 3084 for Clan Hell's Horses. Created as a new design, the Aithon serves as a replacement for the various vehicles that the Clan is no longer able to produce. The Aithon is slow, but it is a well armored design which sports 12.5 tons of advance tech Ferro-Lamellor Armor. In addition to its damage reducing armor, the vehicle's vulnerable traction system is protected with a 10-ton Armored Motive System. One of the vehicle's principal features is its Infantry Bay, which is able to handle upwards to 10 tons worth of troops. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Lamellor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 220 50 Left 180 50 Right 180 50 Rear 140 50 Turret 170 50 Total 890 250 Quirk: Distracting Can Resupply/Repair Can carry 2 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.

content.original: The Anat Armored Personnel Carrier is an early Dark Age design which was first produced by Clan Hell's Horses in 3092. The Horses wanted a fast vehicle that could handle multiple terrain types. For this reason the vehicle was given a wheeled chassis and Limited Amphibious Equipment. The wheeled chassis can handle more terrain types than a hovercraft, and the amphibious equipment allows it to cross small water obstacles. Protected by three and a half tons of armor, the Anat can transport infantry units into hostile fire with some degree of safety. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 130 15 Left 80 15 Right 80 15 Rear 65 15 Turret 80 15 Total 435 75 Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Can Resupply/Repair Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.

content.original: The Maxim Mark II transport is produced by Cyclops Inc. of Skye and Scarborough Manufacturers. The vehicle was intended as an upgrade from the original Maxim hover transport. Though Cyclops wanted to build on the long history of the original Maxim and continue to use heavy weapons, Scarborough’s engineers pointed out that by carrying fewer weapons the crew would naturally withdraw from the battlefield before getting into overly dangerous situations. This would keep the Maxim Mk. II in service for a longer time, allowing the Republic Armed Forces to spend more money on battle armor and other equipment. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 170 25 Left 100 25 Right 100 25 Rear 100 25 Turret 100 25 Total 570 125 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Can carry 4 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.

content.content: «Максим Марк II» производился Cyclops Inc. на Скае и Скарборо. Эта машина задумывалась как усовершенствованная версия оригинального ховера Maxim. Хотя Cyclops стремились развить богатую историю оригинального Maxim и продолжить использовать тяжёлое вооружение, инженеры из Скарборо отметили, что при меньшем количестве вооружения экипаж сможет лучше отступать с поля боя, избегая опасных ситуаций. Это позволило бы Maxim Mk. II оставаться на вооружении дольше, что позволило бы Вооружённым силам Республики тратить больше средств на боевую броню и другое снаряжение. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 8/12 гексов / 240/360 метров. content.original: The genesis of the Arrow IV Assault Vehicle or AAV was the battle to liberate Canopus IV during the Jihad, when Naomi Centrella and her forces saw the effectiveness of the Arrow IV-equipped Demolishers deployed by the Red Lancers when fighting against the Blakist Thirty-Fourth Militia Division. Although the AAV carried just the one missile system, the weight savings in comparison to the Demolisher allowed the AAV to carry more armor - thirteen and a half tons of heavy ferro-fibrous armor in total - and defensive weapons, a trait that was used to great effect against those used to fighting against the Demolisher. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters.
