The 'Mech is built around a massive 200 XL engine, which provides the Tarantula with a top speed approaching 130 km/h. The 'Mech is also equipped with eight jump jets which can be used to propel the 'Mech up to 240 meters allowing the Tarantula to easily navigate rough terrain.

content.original: Fast and well-armed for its weight, the Tiburon can be used in scout and attack formations alike. Mounting a pair of ER medium lasers in each arm, and backed up by two SRM-2 launchers and twin ER small lasers, the Tiburon can quickly close with an enemy and inflict damage before moving out of range again. Making matters worse for its opponents, the Tiburon carries a Watchdog CEWS to not only interfere with their electronics, but also assist in finding them from farther distances, and the lasers are all connected to an accurate targeting computer. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: The Tiburon is a name that hearkens back to when Clan Sea Fox was known as Clan Diamond Shark. The Tiburon is named after a large Terran shark found in the Caribbean, the design was created as the Clan transformed itself from a decimated-yet-centralized military force to a nomadic, spacefaring society of warrior-merchants. The Tiburon is just as lethal as its namesake and unlike most other 'Mechs built by the Sea Foxes, the Tiburon is not for sale and is used exclusively by its own warriors.

content.original: The Tiburon is a name that hearkens back to when Clan Sea Fox was known as Clan Diamond Shark. The Tiburon is named after a large Terran shark found in the Caribbean, the design was created as the Clan transformed itself from a decimated-yet-centralized military force to a nomadic, spacefaring society of warrior-merchants. The Tiburon is just as lethal as its namesake and unlike most other 'Mechs built by the Sea Foxes, the Tiburon is not for sale and is used exclusively by its own warriors.

content.original: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech.  Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad.

content.original: The TR-XB is protected by 16 tons of Durallex Heavy Armor, with CASE embedded into its right torso. The 'Mech uses a XL 285-rated Fusion Engine as its source of power, to aid the 'Mech's ability to cope with a lack of rear-facing weapons and a modest top speed, the design was also given five Improved Jump Jets. The Trebaruna was designed to fight its opponents at long ranges, with its main weapon being its right torso-mounted Gauss Rifle, with 2 tons of ammunition, and supported by three Light PPC found in the opposite torso. These weapons are guided by a Targeting Computer located in the 'Mech's left torso. The Trebaruna is fitted with ten double heat sinks to help cope with its weapon and engine heat. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: The Trebaruna is a Quad configured Assault BattleMech that was originally designed by the Word of Blake Protectorate. Production plans were canceled by the Word of Blake in 3078, when Allied Coalition forces were finally closing in on Terra. The design was discovered by Coalition members, and was offered to all the partners. The design was put into production by the Republic of the Sphere as part of its newly-formed armed forces in 3081, followed shortly after by the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth and Capellan Confederation.

content.original: The Xanthos was first introduced by the Capellan Confederation in 2564, designed by a young engineer named Dr. David Harrison. Working for Hollis Inc., he pioneered the technology to create four-legged BattleMechs. This technological advancement that later allowed the research into the Scorpion and Goliath enabled the Xanthos to get on the field. It was presented to the Terran Hegemony for review after the cancellation of the Catapult. Hollis pushed to have this 'Mech presented against Dr. Harrison's wishes in a bid to maintain financial solvency. Clumsy and stiff, the 'Mech failed to win the contract from the Star League purchasing committee.

content.original: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. An evolution of the Zeus -9T, the new ZEU-11S is a mixture of technologies that blurs the Inner Sphere and Clan divide. Using Clan specification extended-range lasers, an extralight engine and LRM-15 launcher built on-site, the -11S seamlessly integrates these onto the frame of the -9T, although mating the Sphere-made Artemis FCS onto the ClanTech launcher did prove to be a challenge. Everything on the -9T was improved, especially armor protection, with the 'Mech's resilience being further bolstered by a compact gyro and CASE II. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: «Зевс» был впервые построен Лиранским Содружеством в 2787 году, как раз в начале Первой Наследной войны. Созданный по просьбе командования Вооружённых сил Лиранского Содружества в качестве нового лёгкого штурмового меха, «Зевс» достаточно быстр, чтобы не отставать от большинства тяжёлых мехов, и в равной степени способен побеждать их. Новый ZEU-11S, являющийся развитием Zeus-9T, представляет собой сочетание технологий, стирающих границы между Внутренней Сферой и Кланами. Используя клановые лазеры увеличенной дальности, сверхлёгкий двигатель и пусковую установку LRM-15, ZEU-11S органично интегрирует это на раму от ZEU-9T, хотя стыковка сфероидной Artemis FCS с клановой пусковой установкой оказалась непростой задачей. Всё,что было в ZEU-9T было улучшено, особенно бронирование, а устойчивость меха была дополнительно усилена компактным гироскопом и системой CASE II. Особенность: Рука-пушка Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.14 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Cizin is a hover tank developed by Clan Nova Cat during the last years of the thirty-first century. Designed to be fast and hard hitting. Most of the Cizin's firepower comes from four ER Medium Lasers found in the tank's turret. A pair of SRM-2 Launchers are mounted in its front. content.content: Несмотря на то, что оригинальная модель была представлена ​​в 2564 году, модернизированные танки «Кондор» всё ещё производятся по состоянию на начало XXXII века. Мощная броня весом не менее шести тонн и различные комплексы вооружения средней и большой дальности делают «Кондор» актуальным танком. Тяжёлый кавалерийский танк, предназначенный для быстрого реагирования на меняющуюся обстановку боя, «Кондор» был одним из немногих тяжёлых танков на воздушной подушке, доступных на момент появления. Этот огромный ховер-танк способен развивать скорость до 129 км/ч, что делает его одним из самых быстрых танков в своём весовом классе. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунном или марсианском биомах из-за использования ДВС. Передвижение: 8/12 гексов / 240/360 метров. content.original: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by Clan Hell's Horses. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: [This version has Standard Arrows] The Hadur Fast Support Vehicle was developed by Clan Hell's Horses and introduced in 3102. Capable of reaching a top speed of 151 km/h, the Hadur can quickly position itself to provide heavy missile artillery support. It performs best when paired with forward scouts like the Asshur scout. The crew is protected by six tons of standard plate armor. The primary weapon of the Hadur is the Class 16 Arrow IV launcher. This massive weapon provides missile artillery support to friendly forces. However, unlike the Naga OmniMech, the Hadur has a single twenty round magazine instead of four smaller five round magazines. This means that switching ammunition types is a problem for Hadur crews. To remedy this, the Horses typically load the magazine with homing Arrow IV rounds. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. content.original: The Kamakiri mounts three weapon systems mounted in the front of the VTOL - a single Tiegart Particle Projection Cannon and a pair of Telos ThunderShot Thunderbolt 10 Missile Launchers. The Kamakiri Attack VTOL was developed at the end of the thirty-first century by Yan Manufacturing of New Samarkand as a result of their growing success in the military aerospace market. Dubbed as resembling a praying mantis, the Kamakiri was an immediate success; the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery personnel responsible for supervising the first vehicle trial watched for just two minutes before approving the Kamakiri for purchase. Moving as fast as many reconnaissance and strike platforms in service with the DCMS already thanks to the DAV 155 XL extra light engine, the original specification armor installed by Yan was replaced with seven tons of StarGuard Aurora Reflective at the request of the DCMS, who wanted to improve the Kamakari's protection against energy weapons, although the nature of the Reflective Armor didn't offer any additional protection against the flak commonly directed at VTOLs. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. content.original: The modern Kruger Combat Car is a scout vehicle reintroduced in the Thirty-second century as an update of the much older original Kruger Combat Car introduced in 2620. The modern Kruger was developed by the Avalon Arms Company on New Avalon and marketed initially to the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns in 3091. Updated to use advanced equipment and technologies, the Kruger is a popular reconnaissance vehicle for scout detachments operating in the spinward Inner Sphere as well as neighboring Periphery nations. Lightly armed, it has a pair of turret mounted ER medium lasers and features a DAV 50 Fusion engine that powers the Kruger to speeds of up to 118 km/h. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: The Main Gauche Light Support Tank is a fire support companion to Brooks Incorporated's Galleon. Though slower, topping out at only 64 km/h, five tons of armor protect it. The Main Gauche was actually submitted to the Free Worlds League Military because that organization was looking for a tank with long range capability. It finally reached full production in 3064. Based on the XL variant, this version introduced in 3081 is equipped with a four ton infantry compartment. The weapons have been removed and replaced by a forward mounted Plasma Rifle with 2 tons of ammo and two Light Machine Guns. Another Light Machine Gun covers the right and left side of the tank. It also carries some additional armor. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 150 15 Left 115 15 Right 115 15 Rear 85 15 Total 465 60 Quirk: Quick Off The Line Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.

content.original: Developed as a generalist upgrade to the classic Manticore, the Manticore (XL) is an attempt by Defiance Industries to bring in additional revenue. Developed with an eye to licensing thee tank to other manufactures, the XL variant makes modest use of established technology. A 240-rated XL engine and Heavy Ferro-Fibrous with added CASE provide a good balance of protection and practicality. The weapons systems are a riff on the classic Manticore with an ER PPC and a Medium Laser paired with a Targeting Computer. A Streak SRM-6 and an Enhanced LRM-10 replace the standard SRM/LRM combo. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.original: The Patton tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in conventional armored warfare. Identical to its twin, the Rommel, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Patton has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after General George S. Patton, Jr., a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. Unlike the Rommel, which features a massive and powerful but short-ranged AC/20 as its main gun, the Patton mounts an AC/10, giving it twice the ammunition capacity and superior firing range while also enabling it to be fitted with more armor. The Patton is capable of fighting in short-ranged and urban environments, but is far more suited than the Rommel to engaging targets at medium to long range. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: The Skadi is a Fast Attack VTOL. It can reach a top speed of 162 km/h, and is protected by four and a half tons of Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The Skadi was originally designed by Clan Jade Falcon, but the main factory fell to the Lyran Commonwealth. For the next few decades, the Commonwealth sold the Skadi to any interested party. The combination of good protection, high speed, and a heavy gun proved to be very popular, and the Skadi was exported across the Inner Sphere. The Falcons later recaptured the facility and have restricted the Skadi to their own forces. This right here is a Lyran model, with the oversized bomb rack hanging below the nose. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. content.content: «Скади» — это быстрый боевой VTOL. Он способен развивать максимальную скорость 162 км/ч и защищён четырьмя с половиной тоннами клановой ферроволоконной брони. Изначально «Скади» был разработан кланом Нефритового Сокола, но позже основные производственные мощности перешли к Лиранскому Содружеству. В течение следующих нескольких десятилетий Содружество продавало «Скади» всем желающим. Сочетание хорошей защиты, высокой скорости и мощного орудия оказалось очень популярным, и «Скади» экспортировался по всей Внутренней Сфере. Позже Соколы вернули себе завод и ограничили использование «Скади» только для своих войск. Перед вами сейчас лиранская модель с увеличенным держателем бомб, подвешенным под носом. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунных биомах. Передвижение: 10/15 гексов / 300/450 метров. content.original: The Skulker Wheeled Scout is the much larger cousin of the Swift Wind scout car and originally based on the Heavy APC design. Due to it being larger than any scout car, it can act as a mobile communication outpost. With its advanced sensor suite which is tied to both its communication and targeting systems, it can navigate with only its sensors. While hot environments would normally wreak havoc upon its advanced electronics, the heat sinks from its Medium Laser cool the sensors while the laser is not in use. This allows it to operate in even the hottest environments where other scout vehicles cannot. The Skulker comes with four and a half tons of armor as standard. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: The Sokar was developed by Clan Jade Falcon after the Jihad. The Falcons needed a vehicle to deal with large numbers of unarmed rioters on occupied worlds, and the police subcaste received the Sokar Urban Combat Unit. The Sokar's presence is often enough to dissuade the lower castes from continuing to riot for silly things like food. When it doesn't the Sokar's quartet of AP Gauss Rifles can reduce dozens of civilians to a pile of broken flesh in seconds. Assignment to a Sokar isn't desired, with only solahma units of the Falcon touman receiving it. Warriors dislike it because it is used to 'fight' non-warriors. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Quirk: Advanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 km/h and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Centurion OmniMech was born out of a desire on the part of Corean Enterprises to expand the company's market share. Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The first update to the Chameleon line after the acquirement of the rights by J.B. BattleMechs, the new CLN-8V is the apotheosis of this rebranding. The variant able to serve every role from ab initio and advanced training, to front-line combatant. Combat models retain the heat management software of the original trainer, enabling it to simulate high-heat side effects without the risk, or to prevent the pilot from pushing the heat level past a pre-set limit. Since virtually anyone capable of piloting a 'Mech is familiar with the Chameleon, it is an easy sell to budget-conscious buyers eager to save on familiarization training. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The latest iteration of the Clint is a sensible upgrade rather than a revolution. It shares many components with the Cadaver. This is a great advantage in the Periphery, where new components are perpetually scarce, especially for a volatile 'Mech like the Clint. The upgrade removed many of its troublesome features, to the joy of technicians. Its weapons array benefited from concurrent developments. This includes X-pulse technology, first used by the Taurians on the Brahma, which had since reached maturity for full-scale production. The new Clint's reflective armor remains a gamble that could possibly undo its other logistical advantages Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Despite the standard Elemental's all-around utility, Clan Hell's Horses sought to enhance their Elementals mobility. The result of their work, Elemental II, discards Jump Jets and SRM pack in favor of battle armor myomer booster. The design didn't gain popularity and saw no interest from other clans, and Elemental II remains in limited service in Hell's Horses garrisons. Quirk: Elemental Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Несмотря на универсальность стандартного «Элементала», клан Адских Лошадей стремился повысить мобильность своих «Элементалов». Результатом их работы стал «Элементал II», отказавшийся от прыжковых двигателей и SRM в пользу миомерного усилителя боевой брони. Конструкция не снискала популярности и не вызвала интереса у других кланов, и «Элементал II» до сих пор ограниченно эксплуатируется лишь в гарнизонах Адских Лошадей. Особенность: Elemental Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.87 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: After the ultimately failed Elemental II project, the Hell's Horses quest to improve Elementals didn't end. The Elemental III keeps the basic suit relevant for another century, incorporating a one-shot advanced SRM system to extend the suit’s reach and newly developed stealth armor to increase survivability. Quirk: BA Stealth (C) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Eris started life as the prototype 'Hel' from Nasha Diversified, but when it failed to gather interest the design was sold to Kallon Weapon, eventually giving birth to the final design put into mass production. The 2H base variant uses an Endo Steel structure with a 250 XL engine and five jump jets. The weapons loadout consists of a Heavy PPC in the Right Arm, one Streak SRM-6 launcher and two ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The J configuration is a frightful variant that has only recently graced the battlefields of the Inner Sphere during the waning days of the Dark-Age. One of very few mechs to mount the massive HAG-40, the J has to utilize the entire right arm and part of the torso to house the weapon. A four-ton magazine in the right torso feeds the gun, giving it reasonable staying power. Backing up the HAG is an impressive array of three SRM-6 launchers in the left arm. The SRMs utilize a two-ton magazine housed alongside them in the arm. While lacking a true "knock out" weapon the sheer damage potential of this variant is staggering. Problematically, the J houses no backup energy weaponry and must leave the field should it expend all of its ammo. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The L configuration is truly a master of long range. Mounting the same tried and true dual ER Large Lasers of the Prime, the L's true claim to fame is its other armaments. Its left arm houses two Streak LRM-15 Launchers. A CASE II protected magazine holds four tons of ammunition in the left torso. The streak technology and deep ammo bin ensures the L a long life on the battlefield as none of its ammo will be wasted on missed shots. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Fenrir II Assault Battle Armor may have allegedly originated as the result of a bet between Archon Adam Steiner and Duke Vedet Brewer of Hesperus II, but Duke Brewer's vision of "a monstrous wolf straight from the nightmares of our ancestors" proved to be one of the most popular battle suits on the market after its introduction to service in 3119. Quirk: Advanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня Fenrir II по слухам возникла в результате пари между архонтом Адамом Штайнером и герцогом Ведетом Брюером из Гесперуса II, и после появления в 3119 году на вооружении герцога Брюера «гигантского волка прямо из страшилок наших предков» он оказался одним из самых популярных боевых костюмов на рынке. Особенность: Продвинутый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The -M3 is a modification of the -M2 introduced in 3104 that has been optimized for artillery spotting. The 'Mech has removed the three flamers mounted in the left arm, replacing them with a single ER small laser, added a TAG laser designator to the right torso, allowing it to spot for artillery, and MASC, which allows it to move at up to 129.6 km/h. The -M3 also dropped a single double heat sink but added another half ton of armor, giving it a total of seven and a half tons of standard armor. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Powered by a 200-rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth G is armed with 4 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers augmented by a Targeting Computer. A Supercharger pushes the Fire Moth to even faster speeds. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

content.original: Built for speed, firepower, and simplicity, the Gyrfalcon became common in Jade Falcon Stars. Its 275-Rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine would help propel the design into the battlefield at 86 km/h and at bursts to 108 km/h with the help of its MASC. Included in its construction is a Partial Wing, which gives the design the ability to jump further than the normal 150 meters that its Jump Jets would be capable of. In addition to its regular sensors, the engineers would fit a Light Active Probe in the 'Mech's head to help it identify potential enemy targets. While it has been noted that its MechWarriors have it customized for their purposes, this design's original weapons layout consisted of two Series 6b Extended Range Large Lasers and two Type OVR-V LB 2-X ACs mounted in its shortened arms actuators. In addition to these ranged weapons systems, engineers would go on to reinforce the Gyrfalcon's legs. This is a nod to their touman changing its attitude towards the use of physical attacks, namely using Death from Above maneuver. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast OmniMech that has respectable firepower. This light 'Mech is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. The primary configuration consists of four ER Medium Lasers as well as a trio of Streak SRM-2s, which make it a potent headhunter 'Mech. It also packs an LRM-10 to harass enemies at range. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Хеллион» — творение клана Ледяного Хеллиона и их философии, ставящей скорость превыше всего. Созданный на основе «Мист Линкса», «Хеллион» — это быстрый омнимех с впечатляющей огневой мощью. Этот лёгкий мех довольно сложно уничтожить, так как он оснащён пятью с половиной тоннами ферроволоконной брони. Для снижения веса «Хеллион» также использует эндостальной каркас. Хотя он не особенно быстр для своих размеров, «Хеллион» использует систему MASC, позволяющую ему резко увеличивать скорость. Основная конфигурация включает четыре средних ER-лазера и три Streak SRM-2, что делает его мощным мехом для охоты за головами. Он также оснащён LRM-10 для подавления врагов на расстоянии. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.98 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Kodiak II's long-range weaponry revolves around pair of arm mounted 20-tubed Long-Range Missile Launchers, backed up by a single 10-tubed LRM launcher found in the left torso. These missile launchers are guided by Artemis IV Fire Control Systems, allowing the 'Mech weapons to deliver its multiple tons of ammunition on target. Backing up the missile launchers is an Extended Range Particle Projection Cannon, found in the right torso. While it does need to close into brawling range to use them, the Kodiak II also has eight Extended Ranged Small Lasers split between the 'Mech's two arm actuators. All the 'Mech's energy weapons are tied into a Targeting Computer found in the center torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24

content.original: Though powerful, the original Kodiak lacked sufficient long range weaponry and did not come close to mounting its full compliment of armor. In 3095, saKhan Ragnar of Clan Ghost Bear tasked the technician caste with developing a variant that would resolves these setbacks. A first prototype of the new version designated V1 sported two LRM-20 and one LRM-10 launchers, an ER PPC and replaces the eight Medium Lasers with ER Small Lasers. This version also adds jump jets to the design, allowing the 'Mech to jump over 90 meters. The core concept behind this design is what eventually evolved into the Kodiak II. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

It uses a higher-rated XL engine to turn the 'Mech into a fast raider. The redesign was otherwise conservative due to its speed, favoring off-the-shelf weapons instead of pursuing a modern 'Omni-Mercury' upgrade. content.original: This version introduced in 3083 was based on the earlier ON3-MX, although it addresses some of the shortcomings of that 'Mech and shares many of the same features as the ON1-M. Providing a more balanced weapon suite it still carries an Extended LRM-15 with four tons of ammo and an ER medium laser in each arm but instead uses a Grand Slam Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammo in the right torso. It also uses CASE II to protect the ammunition and has a head-mounted TAG system to call in artillery. Initial feedback and advanced orders convinced Kali Yama to switch most of their Orion production lines over to making the ON3-M in 3086, but were soon set back a few years later when pressure from the Republic of the Sphere caused the Federated Suns to cancel their order. The company has seen sold the 'Mech at below-market prices and suffered financial hardship. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: A post-Jihad variant produced by Krupp Armament Works for the Republic of the Sphere in 3084, the production model 8R was based on the prototype SDR-8X that used during the liberation of Terra. Built on an Endo Steel chassis and powered by a smaller 210 Light Fusion Engine - while its ground speed was reduced, the SDR-8R's ten Pitban LFT-20X Improved Jump Jets gave it amazing maneuverability. Carrying ten double heat sinks allowed the 8R to fire its twin Diverse Optics ER Medium Lasers and jump without fear of overheating. Boasting a very different look, the redesigned 8R was also notable for being one of the first Spiders to include an ejection system. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: The Spider -9M was not a grand evolution of the chassis. Instead, it derived directly from preceding variants. Unwilling to gamble on reverse-engineered Clan weaponry, the -9M replaces the prior pulse laser loadouts with variable speed medium lasers. While Nimakachi touts the -9M's 'greatly increased' short-range firepower as the basis for its high sales, customers indicate that demand for the model is only due to the desperation of the mid-thirty-second century. Industry watchers have been critical partly due to the absence of the promised ejection seat, but primarily because the -9M's weaponry doubles in mass for no significant increase in range. The new Spider could be outperformed by units with lighter weapon arrays. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: The Stalking Spider II features most notably a heavy large laser along with a pair of SRM-4 launchers. Due to a design flaw, the ammunition feed for the SRM launchers occasionally explodes from the ammunition feed into the turret. Rounding out its weaponry, the 'Quad features a pair of heavy machine guns mounted in the left torso. The Stalking Spider II is protected by 9.5 tons of standard armor, which includes its built-in CASE that minimizes damage from ammunition explosions. With its 225-rated standard fusion engine, the Spider is able to move at a maximum speed of 86 km/h. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

The 'Mech uses a XL 285-rated Fusion Engine as its source of power, to aid the 'Mech's ability to cope with a lack of rear-facing weapons and a modest top speed, the design was also given five Improved Jump Jets. The Trebaruna was designed to fight its opponents at long ranges, with its main weapon being its right torso-mounted Gauss Rifle, with 2 tons of ammunition, and supported by three Light PPC found in the opposite torso. These weapons are guided by a Targeting Computer located in the 'Mech's left torso. The Trebaruna is fitted with ten double heat sinks to help cope with its weapon and engine heat. content.original: The Wraith battle armor was designed by the Rasalhague Dominion to support conventional infantry as well as perform surgical strikes. It is equipped with Basic Stealth armor to hide it from enemy probes, and its jump jets allow it to cover ninety meters in a single jump. The suit was introduced after extensive testing of the Rogue Bear battle armor, and is a direct descendant of that design. Quirk: BA Stealth (C) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Она оснащена базовой стелс-броней, скрывающей её от вражеских зондов, а прыжковые двигатели позволяют ей преодолевать девяносто метров за один прыжок. content.original: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. An evolution of the Zeus -9T, the new ZEU-11S is a mixture of technologies that blurs the Inner Sphere and Clan divide. Using Clan specification extended-range lasers, an extralight engine and LRM-15 launcher built on-site, the -11S seamlessly integrates these onto the frame of the -9T, although mating the Sphere-made Artemis FCS onto the ClanTech launcher did prove to be a challenge. Everything on the -9T was improved, especially armor protection, with the 'Mech's resilience being further bolstered by a compact gyro and CASE II. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: «Зевс» был впервые построен Лиранским Содружеством в 2787 году, как раз в начале Первой Наследной войны. Созданный по просьбе командования Вооружённых сил Лиранского Содружества в качестве нового лёгкого штурмового меха, «Зевс» достаточно быстр, чтобы не отставать от большинства тяжёлых мехов, и в равной степени способен побеждать их. Новый ZEU-11S, являющийся развитием Zeus-9T, представляет собой сочетание технологий, стирающих границы между Внутренней Сферой и Кланами. Используя клановые лазеры увеличенной дальности, сверхлёгкий двигатель и пусковую установку LRM-15, ZEU-11S органично интегрирует это на раму от ZEU-9T, хотя стыковка сфероидной Artemis FCS с клановой пусковой установкой оказалась непростой задачей. Всё,что было в ZEU-9T было улучшено, особенно бронирование, а устойчивость меха была дополнительно усилена компактным гироскопом и системой CASE II. Особенность: Рука-пушка Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.14 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: This version of the Atlas was created by Preceptor Anton Jurn of the Outworlds Alliance. The traditional weaponry has been completely removed from an AS7-K chassis. The Atlas was then equipped with a Hypervelocity AC/10 and Snub Nose PPC in the right torso, while a Thunderbolt 15 launcher occupies the left torso and each arm carries a Light PPC. The ammunition for the AC and Thunderbolt are in a CASE II protected bay in the left torso. Jurn's refit also features a Cockpit Command Console that has been armored. To provide more intelligence to the commander, a Beagle Active Probe is mounted in the center torso, and each leg carries a Remote Sensor Dispenser system. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

content.original: The Tiburon is a name that hearkens back to when Clan Sea Fox was known as Clan Diamond Shark. The Tiburon is named after a large Terran shark found in the Caribbean, the design was created as the Clan transformed itself from a decimated-yet-centralized military force to a nomadic, spacefaring society of warrior-merchants. The Tiburon is just as lethal as its namesake and unlike most other 'Mechs built by the Sea Foxes, the Tiburon is not for sale and is used exclusively by its own warriors.

content.original: This version of the Atlas was created by Preceptor Anton Jurn of the Outworlds Alliance. The traditional weaponry has been completely removed from an AS7-K chassis. The Atlas was then equipped with a Hypervelocity AC/10 and Snub Nose PPC in the right torso, while a Thunderbolt 15 launcher occupies the left torso and each arm carries a Light PPC. The ammunition for the AC and Thunderbolt are in a CASE II protected bay in the left torso. Jurn's refit also features a Cockpit Command Console that has been armored. To provide more intelligence to the commander, a Beagle Active Probe is mounted in the center torso, and each leg carries a Remote Sensor Dispenser system. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

content.original:
A one of a kind Rattlesnake developed by Headhunter Stables of Solaris 7; the Rattlesnake JR7-31R was piloted by Gideon Wozniak during his arena fight with the wanted war criminal and ex ROM agent, Victor Reskov. Built from a Rattlesnake JR7-37, the 37R model upgrades the Mech with Clan made Ferro-Fibrous armor and MASC. 2 Clan ER Medium Lasers, 3 Medium Lasers and a Clan ER Small Laser form the Mechs armament; with Angel ECM and a Clan made Targeting Computer enhancing the Mechs effectiveness. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: An experimental Republic era version of an updated -3F, using all Clan-based technology. The combination of an Ultra-light Gyro, XXL engine and both Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel chassis allows the mounting of two Gauss Rifles and 4 tons of ammunition. Due to the sheer weight of these weapons, the only other equipment is a single head-mounted ER Micro Laser to help dealing with infantry. The 'Mech however loses it characteristic Jump Jets and has to rely solely on its 225-rated engine core to get in melee range for the Hatchet. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Developed for The Republic of the Sphere after the Capellan Crusades, this Hatchetman uses a Light Engine to develop a maximum ground speed of 85 km/h. It also has a jump range of 150 meters and is protected by eight and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor. Twelve double heat sinks are also installed, which dissipates the extreme heat from the single Medium X-Pulse Laser and six standard Medium Lasers mounted in the right arm. The left arm has the trademark hatchet. What makes this version so deadly is the fact that each arm has an Actuator Enhancement System, which improves targeting. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Developed during the Jihad in 3084, this Hatchetman variant has an expanded role beyond urban combat. By using a larger Light Engine, designers increased the 'Mech's cruising speed by 25% and added another jump jet to increase the jump range by 25%. The biggest change is in the 'Mech's armament. The traditional autocannon is replaced by a single MML-9 and three tons of ammunition. A Guardian ECM Suite disrupts enemy electronics while ferro-fibrous armor and CASE protect the 'Mech from weapons fire and an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Mortis was designed by the branches of StarCorps Industries in the Capellan Confederation and the Free Worlds League. A fast heavy 'Mech, the Mortis has thirteen tons of armor, a jump radius of 150 meters, and a top speed of 86 km/h. The Mortis places its main weaponry in the arms. The five ton Hatchet carried in the right arm is excellent for delivering a crushing blow in physical combat, while the Heavy PPC in the left arm is useful for punching holes in an opponent's armor. To harass enemy forces while closing to the short range preferred by Mortis pilots, the right torso carries a single MML-5 with a two ton magazine. To provide a little more firepower, the center torso boasts a Rocket Launcher 10. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: An experimental Republic era version of an updated -3F, using all Clan-based technology. The combination of an Ultra-light Gyro, XXL engine and both Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel chassis allows the mounting of two Gauss Rifles and 4 tons of ammunition. Due to the sheer weight of these weapons, the only other equipment is a single head-mounted ER Micro Laser to help dealing with infantry. The 'Mech however loses it characteristic Jump Jets and has to rely solely on its 225-rated engine core to get in melee range for the Hatchet. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Developed for The Republic of the Sphere after the Capellan Crusades, this Hatchetman uses a Light Engine to develop a maximum ground speed of 85 km/h. It also has a jump range of 150 meters and is protected by eight and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor. Twelve double heat sinks are also installed, which dissipates the extreme heat from the single Medium X-Pulse Laser and six standard Medium Lasers mounted in the right arm. The left arm has the trademark hatchet. What makes this version so deadly is the fact that each arm has an Actuator Enhancement System, which improves targeting. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Developed during the Jihad in 3084, this Hatchetman variant has an expanded role beyond urban combat. By using a larger Light Engine, designers increased the 'Mech's cruising speed by 25% and added another jump jet to increase the jump range by 25%. The biggest change is in the 'Mech's armament. The traditional autocannon is replaced by a single MML-9 and three tons of ammunition. A Guardian ECM Suite disrupts enemy electronics while ferro-fibrous armor and CASE protect the 'Mech from weapons fire and an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Mortis was designed by the branches of StarCorps Industries in the Capellan Confederation and the Free Worlds League. A fast heavy 'Mech, the Mortis has thirteen tons of armor, a jump radius of 150 meters, and a top speed of 86 km/h. The Mortis places its main weaponry in the arms. The five ton Hatchet carried in the right arm is excellent for delivering a crushing blow in physical combat, while the Heavy PPC in the left arm is useful for punching holes in an opponent's armor. To harass enemy forces while closing to the short range preferred by Mortis pilots, the right torso carries a single MML-5 with a two ton magazine. To provide a little more firepower, the center torso boasts a Rocket Launcher 10. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Collapsing Vulcan sales led to deliberations on whether to focus entirely on increased Firestarter production, until representatives from Coventry took the unusual initiative of reaching out to Nimakachi executives. A technological summit, attended by engineers from both corporations, resulted in the development of a new, relatively simple Vulcan that combined the strengths of prior variants. Armed with the incendiary payload of the Coventry models and the durability, heat dissipation, and accuracy of the Nimakachi builds, the new -7T hit markets running. Now a top seller once more, the Vulcan is the deadliest it has ever been in urban environments. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Almost 300 years after its original creation, the Viper was reborn in the Republic era. But not because of demand for a forgotten unit, but because a stockpile of blazers was discovered in a Kallon warehouse in 3123. Kallon engineers were then developing a new 'Mech for the RAF. They, like their predecessors, realized that the Viper was ideal for the surplus weapons. Viper schematics survived in their database, and existing Crusader tooling could be readily adapted.

content.original: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.

content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: The -2Y is equipped with an XL engine that drives it to 54 km/h. The weight freed by the XL engine is used to add a Beagle Active Probe, Guardian ECM Suite, and C3 slave unit. It has thirteen and a half tons of armor to protect an Endo-Composite skeleton. It is also equipped with a Targeting Computer, and a Medium Shield is carried on the right arm. Offensively, it mounts a PPC, two large lasers, and three medium lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: This version is equipped with an ER PPC, two ER Medium Pulse Lasers, two ER small lasers, and two small pulse lasers, all made to Clan specifications. This Black Knight also carries a plasma rifle in each arm, which use three tons of ammunition. The Medium Shield and thirteen and a half tons of armor protect the Endo-Composite structure. An Angel ECM Suite provides electronic warfare support, and eighteen Clan-spec double heat sinks keep the 'Mech running cool. Its max speed is 54 km/h. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.original: Newly developed by Clan Jade Falcon for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere, the Black Lanner is a fast medium OmniMech that can take on a variety of roles. Intended as a front-line 'Mech, the Black Lanner makes use of all weight-saving technology available to the Clan Jade Falcon scientists who designed it, including an XL engine, endo steel, and eight tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Black Lanner also includes a MASC system on the base chassis that enables it to run up to 151 km/h in bursts, allowing it to outrun many 'Mechs half its size. The design sacrifices pod space for that speed however, with an engine almost half the Black Lanner's weight leaving a mere 13 tons for offensive weaponry.

content.original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.

content.content: «Лютоволк» - один из тех омнимехов, которых стали бояться во Внутренней Сфере во время первого вторжения Кланов, и вполне заслуженно. «Лютоволк» весит внушительные сто тонн и имеет относительно невысокую крейсерскую скорость 54 км/ч, обеспечиваемую двигателем 300 XL. По скорости и бронезащите он не уступает «Атласу», но обладает более высокой потенциальной огневой мощью с 55,5 тонн свободного пространства для оружия и оборудования. Именно за эти качества в криминальных кругах Синдиката Дракона мех окрестили Daishi (псевдояпонское название «Великая смерть»), и это название раз за разом подтверждало свою мрачную правоту.

The Gargoyle is therefore commonly seen among Clan Wolf, and was a featured assault OmniMech during the Clan Invasion. This dependable design eventually spread throughout the Clans, and can be seen with any of their Galaxies now.

content.original: The Grand Summoner shares some similarities to its predecessor, sharing the same size XL Fusion Engine, and physical appearance. What differs from the older design is its Pod Capacity; the Grand Summoner has a 30.5 ton capacity over the older model's 22.5. This increase of capacity comes from the reshuffling of the 'Mech's internal components and dropping the original's permanently-mounted Jump Jets from the design. The Grand Summoner's armor protection is slightly greater than the original, with half a ton more. The Prime Configuration long-range firepower comes from its side-torso-mounted 15-Tubed Long-Range Missile Launcher and pair of arm-mounted Class 5 Ultra Autocannons. Their ammunition is kept where these weapons are housed, with single ton per Autocannon and two tons for the missile launcher. In intermediate and close ranges, the Grand Summoner's full arsenal — including its four Extended Range Medium Lasers — can be brought to bear on a target with a minimum of overheating concerns (except when its Jump Jets are in use).

Like other IIC designs, visual similarities between it and its predecessor initially led ComStar to incorrectly label the design as a mere refit of the original.

content.original: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

content.content: Многоцелевой боевой мех, разработанный в 2550 году во время Золотого века, Shadow Hawk представляет собой мощное сочетание маневренности и огневой мощи. Благодаря сочетанию оружия дальнего и ближнего боя, хорошей маневренности благодаря прыжковым двигателям и отличной выносливости, Shadow Hawk долгое время считался одним из лучших мехов в своей весовой категории. Shadow Hawk одинаково хорош как в роли командира развед роты, так и в качестве засветчика для тяжелых и штурмовых отрядов.

content.original: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

content.original: The Thunderbolt started production in 2491 as a planetary-assault 'Mech, and in fact was one of the heaviest 'Mechs that could be produced at that time. Since then the 'Mech, known affectionately as the T-Bolt, has had its classification changed as larger 'Mechs were built but thanks to periodic updates it is still feared and respected by many. With its varied arsenal, the Thunderbolt remains one of the best-armed 'Mechs, making it capable of serving in many roles. It is also an incredibly well-armored 'Mech, rivaling or exceeding the amount of armor carried by some assault 'Mechs. One downside to the Thunderbolt though is poor heat management.

С тех пор классификация меха, ласково называемого T-Bolt, менялась по мере строительства более крупных мехов, но благодаря периодическим обновлениям его по-прежнему боятся и уважают многие. Благодаря своему разнообразному арсеналу Thunderbolt остаётся одним из наиболее вооруженных мехов, что делает его способным выполнять множество ролей. Кроме того, это невероятно хорошо бронированный мех, соперничающий или превосходящий по количеству брони некоторые штурмовые мехи. Однако одним из недостатков Thunderbolt является плохое управление теплом.

content.original: This variant, built on Tikonov and used by the Republic of the Sphere, is intended to anchor and support vehicle formations. With a top speed of 54 km/h it won't break any speed records, but can keep up with most battle armor and combat vehicle formations. The standard armor is replaced by Reflective Armor and ammunition has been stored in a CASE II-protected bay. The right arm carries a plasma rifle, while the right torso carries a pair of Thunderbolt 5 launchers. The left torso is equipped with a Clan-spec LRM-15, and the traditional medium lasers of the left torso have been replaced by three Small Variable Speed Pulse Lasers. The left arm carries a pair of standard medium lasers. Twelve double heat sinks handle the heat load. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.content: Производство Thunderbolt началось в 2491 году как планетарный штурмовой мех, и фактически был одним из самых тяжелых мехов, которые могли быть произведены в то время. С тех пор классификация меха, ласково называемого T-Bolt, менялась по мере строительства более крупных мехов, но благодаря периодическим обновлениям его по-прежнему боятся и уважают многие. Благодаря своему разнообразному арсеналу Thunderbolt остаётся одним из наиболее вооруженных мехов, что делает его способным выполнять множество ролей. Кроме того, это невероятно хорошо бронированный мех, соперничающий или превосходящий по количеству брони некоторые штурмовые мехи. Однако одним из недостатков Thunderbolt является плохое управление теплом.

content.original: Focusing solely on long range combat, the Lightning LHN-C5 carries an Improved Heavy Gauss Rifle and an Heavy Particle Projection Cannon. These weapons inflict heavy damage at long range, rapidly stripping armor from nearby units. Three tons of ammunition are carried for the Gauss Rifle. The lack of short range weapons is deliberate because the Strategios wants the Lightning to focus on long range combat while the partner-'Mech, the Thunder, handles close in conflict. The 3R variant is meant to increase its short term and short range firepower, the 3R removes two of the LRM-5 launchers and replaces them with two Rocket Launcher 10s and two Rocket Launcher 15s. content.original: This variant, built on Tikonov and used by the Republic of the Sphere, is intended to anchor and support vehicle formations. With a top speed of 54 km/h it won't break any speed records, but can keep up with most battle armor and combat vehicle formations. The standard armor is replaced by Reflective Armor and ammunition has been stored in a CASE II-protected bay. The right arm carries a plasma rifle, while the right torso carries a pair of Thunderbolt 5 launchers. The left torso is equipped with a Clan-spec LRM-15, and the traditional medium lasers of the left torso have been replaced by three Small Variable Speed Pulse Lasers. The left arm carries a pair of standard medium lasers. Twelve double heat sinks handle the heat load. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

While lacking The Lich's more exotic experimental and Clan-tech components, it retained the Heavy Gyro, Endo Steel chassis, light fusion engine and twelve and half tons of light ferro-fibrous armor. The weapons themselves were relatively unchanged, mounting a Snub-Nose PPC in each arm, and a pair of ER medium lasers and medium pulse lasers supported by a Streak SRM-6 Rack in its torsos. Thirteen double heat sinks and a Targeting Computer rounded out the variant. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Thunderbolt started production in 2491 as a planetary-assault 'Mech, and in fact was one of the heaviest 'Mechs that could be produced at that time. Since then the 'Mech, known affectionately as the T-Bolt, has had its classification changed as larger 'Mechs were built but thanks to periodic updates it is still feared and respected by many. With its varied arsenal, the Thunderbolt remains one of the best-armed 'Mechs, making it capable of serving in many roles. It is also an incredibly well-armored 'Mech, rivaling or exceeding the amount of armor carried by some assault 'Mechs. One downside to the Thunderbolt though is poor heat management.

content.content: Производство Thunderbolt началось в 2491 году как планетарный штурмовой мех, и фактически был одним из самых тяжелых мехов, которые могли быть произведены в то время. С тех пор классификация меха, ласково называемого T-Bolt, менялась по мере строительства более крупных мехов, но благодаря периодическим обновлениям его по-прежнему боятся и уважают многие. Благодаря своему разнообразному арсеналу Thunderbolt остаётся одним из наиболее вооруженных мехов, что делает его способным выполнять множество ролей. Кроме того, это невероятно хорошо бронированный мех, соперничающий или превосходящий по количеству брони некоторые штурмовые мехи. Однако одним из недостатков Thunderbolt является плохое управление теплом.

content.original: This custom Thunderbolt refitted by Salazar Tsakalotos uses the standard TDR-10M as a base. Equipped with Stealth Armor and a Guardian ECM, it's much harder to hit than a standard Thunderbolt. The weapons have also changed: A plasma rifle replaces the Heavy PPC, and to cover the 'Mech's rear an experimental Small Variable Speed Pulse Laser is mounted in the head. For anti-infantry work the 'Mech carries a flamer in the right torso. A medium pulse laser is also fitted in place of the ER medium model used in standard Thunderbolts, and it keeps the Snub-Nose PPC, Light PPC, and MML-5 of the original TDR-10M. To make room for this equipment, the 'Mech's jumping range is reduced to 90 meters. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: The Antlion is an unusual quad BattleMech, purpose-built by StarCorps Industries for the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns from their plant on Crofton to fill a tactical indirect fire support role. Outclassed in direct combat by many 'Mechs, the Antlion wasn't designed to fight opponents directly; instead, the Antlion was designed to rain down indirect fire, preferably from cover some distance away. The Bloodhound active probe helped with this mission profile, but StarCorps also installed a remote sensor dispenser in the Antlion's left torso, acting as a force multiplier by allowing an Antlion to seed an area with sensors in anticipation of subsequent fire missions.

content.original: The Arbalest was first used during the Word of Blake Jihad by Clan Nova Cat as they sought to improve their second-line forces. The Arbalest's long range firepower makes up for its relatively slow speed when compared to other clan 'Mechs of a similar size. To make production easier and faster, Clan Nova Cat engineers used less expensive components that were readily available in the Inner Sphere. Utilizing a standard engine, standard internal structure, and basic armor allowed the Nova Cats to produce the 'Mech in large numbers. The Arbalest is manufactured on the Nova Cat's enclave capital Irece in the Draconis Combine and can be found throughout the post-Jihad Inner Sphere.

content.original: The Balius is a quadrupedal, front-line OmniMech produced by Clan Hell's Horses. It is a totem 'Mech, resembling a horse, that is meant to improve morale as much as to be an effective combat unit. There is apparently no factory producing this design. Instead, it is hand-crafted by a crew of technicians specifically selected for the task by the Khan. This has led to few Balius' being produced, so the 'Mech is only in the hands of select Bloodnamed warriors. Truly a frontline Omni, the Balius makes use of weight-saving technologies in the form of an Endo Steel chassis, eleven tons of ferro-fibrous armor, and an XL engine. However, on a quad, this leaves little room for other components. It does allow for great speed, though, and the Balius maxes out at 97 km/h, quite fast for a 'Mech its size.

content.content: «Балиус» — четвероногий омнимех первой линии, производимый кланом Адских Лошадей. Это тотемный мех, напоминающий лошадь, призванный не только повышать боевой дух, но и быть эффективной боевой единицей. По-видимому, завода, выпускающего этого меха не существует. Вместо этого он собирается вручную бригадой техов, специально отобранных для этой задачи ханом. Это привело к тому, что на свет вышло мало Balius, поэтому мех находится только в руках избранных воинов с кровным именем. Будучи истинно омнисом первой линии, Balius использует технологии экономии веса в виде эндостального шасси, одиннадцати тонн ферроволоконной брони и двигателя XL. Однако на кваде это оставляет мало места для других компонентов. Тем не менее, он весьма быстр, Balius развивает максимальную скорость 97 км/ч, что довольно быстро для меха его размера.

content.original: Having dealt with years of incompatible systems with Clan-tech refits of the standard Beowulf, Odin built the Beowulf IIC from scratch in the hopes of avoiding them, only to use the same electronic systems which results in frequent glitches in combat. The main benefits of the switch to Clan-grade components was increased survivability for its 270-rated XL engine and the saving of half a ton through the use of Clan ferro-fibrous armor. Aside from that, the Beowulf IIC offers identical ground speed, bolstered by MASC, and jump distance as the ComStar BEO-12 model. The most notable and hotly contested change was the replacement of the Beagle active probe and TAG with a Watchdog CEWS and light TAG; while technically offering the same abilities with the added bonus of an ECM suite for less weight, the significantly reduced range forces the Beowulf IIC to put itself at much greater risk to fulfill its intended role. Similar to the ComStar original, the Beowulf IIC carries a right-arm mounted Series PPS-XX ER large pulse laser supported by a pair of left-arm mounted Series PPS-XIX ER medium pulse lasers. While doing more damage than the less advanced Inner Sphere weapons, the range brackets of the ComStar and Dominion models are almost identical, leading to further questions as to the value of the newer and more expensive design. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Based on ComStar's Beowulf, the Beowulf IIC is a more advanced Clan-Tech version for the Ghost Bear Dominion. One of the many smaller manufacturers to emerge in the wake of the Clan Invasion, Odin Manufacturing's prospects soared with the Word of Blake Jihad and the Clan Ghost Bear takeover of the Free Rasalhague Republic. Flush from the success of the Karhu OmniMech and eager to make the 15-year-old Beowulf more profitable, Odin set about developing IIC style remake under its own initiative. Though the Ghost Bear touman's post-Jihad need for a fast medium Clan BattleMech to supplement the slower Ursus led them to buy the overly expensive Beowulf IIC, the fact the Dominion needed a fast medium OmniMech even more and that Odin was clearly engaging in blatant profiteering increasingly soured the integration of Rasalhagian and Ghost Bear arms manufacturing.

content.original: The Blade is a light-weight scouting and raiding 'Mech that employs its fearsome speed to strike at larger 'Mechs, then to escape before their opponents can track them. Well-suited for pack-hunter and swarming tactics, the Blade works well with other fast units such as the classic Locust and the Clan Dasher. Originally commissioned by the Republic of the Sphere's first Commanding General Victor Steiner-Davion, the Blade was his attempt to standardize and simplify the hodgepodge military hardware as Stone's Coalition became the Republic Armed Forces. The Blade was manufactured from the mid-3080s until around 3096, becoming the signature 'Mechs for Principes Guards, Hastati Sentinels, and elite Knights of the Sphere regiments.

content.content: Blade — лёгкий разведывательно-рейдерский мех, использующий свою устрашающую скорость для нападения на более крупные мехи, а затем для побега до того, как противник успеет их отследить. Blade, идеально подходящий для охоты стаями, отлично работает с другими быстрыми юнитами, такими как классический Locust и клановый Dasher. Изначально созданный по заказу верховного главнокомандующего Республики Сферы Виктора Штайнера-Дэвиона, Blade стал его попыткой стандартизировать и упростить разношерстную военную технику, когда Коалиция Стоуна стала Вооружёнными силами Республики. Blade производился с середины 3080-х годов до примерно 3096 года, став знаковым мехом для Principes Guards, Hastati Sentinels и элитных полков Рыцарей Сферы.

content.original: An excellent close quarters 'Mech, the Blade XL is built around a rotary autocannon/5 supplied with three tons of reloads as its primary weapon, supported by a pair of ER medium lasers, all three weapons located in the 'Mech's right arm. While critics pointed out the risk of locating all the 'Mechs weapon in a single location, the decision was based on the manufacturer's attempts to achieve an OmniMech level ease of maintenance on a standard BattleMech. Save for the shoulder actuator, ammo, and energy feeds, the entire arm is a self contained system, allowing technicians to quickly and easily detach and replace a damaged arm with a undamaged replacement with relative ease. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Blade is a light-weight scouting and raiding 'Mech that employs its fearsome speed to strike at larger 'Mechs, then to escape before their opponents can track them. Well-suited for pack-hunter and swarming tactics, the Blade works well with other fast units such as the classic Locust and the Clan Dasher. Originally commissioned by the Republic of the Sphere's first Commanding General Victor Steiner-Davion, the Blade was his attempt to standardize and simplify the hodgepodge military hardware as Stone's Coalition became the Republic Armed Forces. The Blade was manufactured from the mid-3080s until around 3096, becoming the signature 'Mechs for Principes Guards, Hastati Sentinels, and elite Knights of the Sphere regiments.

content.content: Blade — лёгкий разведывательно-рейдерский мех, использующий свою устрашающую скорость для нападения на более крупные мехи, а затем для побега до того, как противник успеет их отследить. Blade, идеально подходящий для охоты стаями, отлично работает с другими быстрыми юнитами, такими как классический Locust и клановый Dasher. Изначально созданный по заказу верховного главнокомандующего Республики Сферы Виктора Штайнера-Дэвиона, Blade стал его попыткой стандартизировать и упростить разношерстную военную технику, когда Коалиция Стоуна стала Вооружёнными силами Республики. Blade производился с середины 3080-х годов до примерно 3096 года, став знаковым мехом для Principes Guards, Hastati Sentinels и элитных полков Рыцарей Сферы.

content.original: The Bloodhound-B3, developed in 3081, is apparently intended to counter large numbers of infantry and battle armor. All the standard weapons of the Bloodhound have been removed, replaced with a pair of ER flamers and a medium pulse laser in each arm. The right arm is also equipped with a fluid gun that has two tons of ammo in the right torso, and a single B-Pod is also mounted in the center torso. To make room for this equipment the Bloodhound-B3 removes the Beagle active probe, drops down to eleven double heat sinks, and loses half a ton of armor. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: Built to operate in an counterinsurgency role, the Bloodhound is designed to engage enemy guerilla units. The Bloodhound is built on an Earthwerks PXH IV endo steel chassis that carries a lightweight Hermes 315 XL engine capable of pushing the Bloodhound up to speeds of 118.8 km/h. In addition to this speed, the Bloodhound is well armored for its mission, with nine and a half tons of Durallex Light armor with CASE to protect the 'Mech against complete destruction in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Bloodhound also carries a Beagle active probe which is capable of finding hidden enemy units.

content.original: First encountered on Lackland in 3083, the LDT-5 is a well-designed raiding 'Mech that combines the best features of the LDT-XPR prototypes. Faster than any previous Brigand thanks to the use of an Omni 175 extralight engine to reach a top speed of 111 km/h, the LDT-5 retains the endo steel chassis to carry five and a half tons of standard plate. Equipped with three medium lasers spread across its three torso sections, the LDT-5 carries a mace in the left arm, enhancing its close combat ability but also limiting how much booty the LDT-5 can make off with. Seven jump jets provide a 210 meter jump capability. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.

content.original: Designed to compete with 'Mechs like the Atlas and King Crab, the Cerberus is a 'Mech designed around speed and firepower. The Cerberus uses a massive GM 380 XL engine to propel it to a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is also armored with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous armor, which provides more protection per ton than standard armor. The large amount of free weight on the 'Mech, almost half of its mass, is dedicated to its weapons systems, which are designed to do as much damage to an enemy at as great a distance as possible.

content.original: The original Fire Moth, designated Dasher by the Inner Sphere, is a light 'Mech that is known for having great speed but weak armor, and it was found that the Dasher was not very effective at swarm tactics or raiding due to this deficiency. Because of this deficiency in the design the Dasher II entered service during the Word of Blake Jihad. Much heavier and sturdier than the original Dasher, the Dasher II has a top speed of 162 km/h that equals that of the original Dasher. The Dasher II's top speed allows it to close in to effectively use its firepower.

content.original: The 'Mech features the same weapons layout (including the Omni design's permanently mounted weapons) as the Deimos Primary Configuration. The Deimos' head-mounted AMS system is exchanged for an experimental laser version. The 'Mech's armor capacity has been reduced to 13 tons, and uses ferro-fibrous instead of standard armor. Its engine is upgraded to a 340-rated XL Fusion, while only carrying ten double heat sinks. Its MASC equipment allows the design to move at speeds reaching 86 km/h. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The prime variant was designed for anti-air role and fire support.

content.content: «Деймос» был разработан кланом Снежного Ворона. Этот мех впервые был представлен в середине 3060-х годов, предположительно на планете Люм в Кластере Керенского. Однако во время Джихада разведслужбы Внутренней Сферы перестали получать информацию об этом мехе, и он канул в Лету. В 3085 году Снежные Вороны раскрыли Внутренней Сфере существование «Деймоса». Он считается гордостью их клана, и как минимум один такой мех был приписан к каждому тумену. Prime вариант был разработан для противовоздушной обороны и огневой поддержки.

content.original: This Dola is the production variant of the original DOL-1A, and is intended to act as a skirmisher. By replacing the fragile composite internal structure and the XL gyro with standard versions, the Dola is now a much tougher 'Mech. In addition, the use of a full-sized cockpit in place of the small cockpit makes piloting the 'Mech much easier. To make room for these changes, the armor was reduced by a half-ton and the vibroblade was downgraded to a standard sword. Despite this sacrifice, the 'Mech has become very popular with Capellan pilots. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: Mounting an ER PPC in each arm and an ATM 6 in each side torso the Ebon Jaguar F is a fearsome variant that can tear into its foes at any range. Three tons of ATM ammo split between the side torsos, two in the right and one in the left, allow the full tactical flexibility of the launchers. A Targeting Computer resides in the right torso and makes the PPCs deadly accurate. The left torso carries one additional heat sink while each arm carries two. Eighteen total heat sinks allows the F to fire its primary armament relentlessly. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Exhumer is a medium BattleMech first produced for the Draconis Combine in the third decade of the thirty-second century. The 'Mech was first advocated to enter the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery by Benjamin District Warlord Mitsura Sakamoto, who felt that the design would become a mainstay of the Combine's Armed forces. With the Warlord's backing, the 'Mech would finally enter service with its first production models joining the 2nd Benjamin Regulars in 3129. However, early engagements using the 'Mech by frontline forces would prove disastrous due to a flaw in the Exhumer's targeting systems. The 'Mech orders from DCMS were subsequently canceled, shuffling the produced units to sale in the mercenary market.

content.content: The Exhumer is a medium BattleMech first produced for the Draconis Combine in the third decade of the thirty-second century. The 'Mech was first advocated to enter the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery by Benjamin District Warlord Mitsura Sakamoto, who felt that the design would become a mainstay of the Combine's Armed forces. With the Warlord's backing, the 'Mech would finally enter service with its first production models joining the 2nd Benjamin Regulars in 3129. However, early engagements using the 'Mech by frontline forces would prove disastrous due to a flaw in the Exhumer's targeting systems. The 'Mech orders from DCMS were subsequently canceled, shuffling the produced units to sale in the mercenary market.

The company's plants sustained heavy damage in the Second Combine-Ghost Bear War, and the Gravedigger was produced to generate much needed capital.
