content.original: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.

content.content: Являясь смесью популярного Thug эпохи Звездной Лиги и не пользующегося популярностью Charger, Hatamoto-Chi в стиле самураев был первым боевым мехом Синдиката Дракона, построенным после Наследных войн с использованием восстановленного лостеха. По поручению канреи Теодора Куриты провести обратную разработку образцов передовых боевых мехов СОЗЛ, предоставленных КомСтаром в 3035 году для будущего производства, Luthien Armor Works тайно соединила вооружение Thug с обликом злосчастного Charger. Хотя изначально компания не могла массово производить передовые шасси из эндостали, необходимые для Thug, появление ранних Hatamoto-Chi и их бесконечных вариаций, созданных на основе просторного корпуса Charger, привело к замешательству в объединенных вооруженных силах Федеративного Содружества во время войны 3039 года.

content.original: Designed by Adam Tech Industries and manufactured from their plant on Abadan, the Havoc was inspired by the JR7-K Jenner and managed to improve on many of the JR7-K's design features. The combination of almost double the Jenner's armor, a 10% increase in speed thanks to the 280 XL engine and a weapons loadout that allowed it to battle 'Mechs heavier than itself spurred the Adam Tech advertising campaign, which was geared exclusively towards pilots of light BattleMechs. The key to the Havoc's success was the Octagon Tartrac System E, considered the best short-range targeting and tracking system available on the market at the time and often compared to the highly successful and effective Garret D2j targeting system. The Octagon system identified threats faster than comparable systems, an invaluable aid to MechWarriors in the field. The Havoc also mounted five jump jets distributed throughout the Havoc's torso locations, allowing it to jump up to 150 meters.

content.original: Named for a canine predator adapted to Randis IV, the HawkWolf is a unique BattleMech constructed by the Brotherhood of Randis that entered production in 3076. To help support their activities, the Brotherhood set aside resources to develop production facilities to build "RetroMechs", in order to both fill out its own forces and to sell as a means of generating further capital. Initially starting with RetroTech Firebees and Dervishes, their success led the Brotherhood to develop an entirely new design. Intended mainly for fire-support roles, the HawkWolf was generally assigned to the Brotherhood's "squires" as a means for its youngest warriors to gain experience and avoid placing the primitive design at threat against more advanced opponents in direct combat.

content.original: The Ha Otoko (Bladed Man in Japanese) is primarily a defensive, second-line BattleMech. Clan Diamond Shark first fielded the cheap 'Mech when they helped Clan Nova Cat evacuate from Clan space in 3060. Clan Jade Falcon merchants were the first to point out that the Ha Otoko name and oriental aspect and style of combat were meant to be sold to the Inner Sphere, being easily modified to accommodate similar Inner Sphere weaponry, in addition to the Oriental styling of the 'Mech's exterior. The Ha Otoko is protected by thirteen tons of armor.

content.original: The Hercules was built in response to a request by the Free Worlds League for a 'Mech with balanced mobility and firepower. The Hercules is powered by a 350 XL engine that propels the 'Mech up to speeds of 86.4 km/h. The Hercules is also well armored, with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous for protection. Overall, the Hercules has turned out to be a good all-around trooper 'Mech that can handle a variety of combat roles, from air defense to long-range direct fire support.

content.original: The G1 variant of the Hollander is built to address concerns about the Hollander's lack of back up weapons. First debuting in 3056 the 'Mech replaces the heavy Gauss Cannon with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon, freeing up weight to mount two Defiance B3M Medium Lasers in its arms as backup weapons and add two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The G1 is an excellent 'Mech for vehicle hunting as well as anti-aircraft use with its LB-X cluster rounds.

content.original: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper. The Federated Commonwealth was in dire need of a response to the fast-moving, long-range firepower of the Clan Invaders at the time, and looked at a number of light 'Mech designs featuring PPCs or LRMs as a potential answer. It was Coventry's unorthodox decision to mount such a large weapon, one that had neither the overheating or ammunition explosion drawbacks of the other designs, which won them the contract. With its single massive cannon and use of rediscovered technology, the Hollander can destroy another light 'Mech in a single hit at extreme range and threaten heavier targets easily.

content.original: Designed to be an all-purpose BattleMech, the JLN-5A uses a mix of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies. The 'Mech is built on an Endo-Composite frame, which is powered by a 360-rated extralight fusion engine. The 'Mech's hull is protected by 16.5 tons of Light Ferro-Fibrous armor with a pair of CASE II equipment mounted in its arms actuators. To ensure the survival of the MechWarrior, engineers have reinforced the armor around the cockpit. The Juliano's firepower comes from its three Extended-Range Large Lasers found each of the 'Mech's torsos. Those weapons are backed by three Extended-Range Medium Lasers and four arm mounted Clan produced Streak-6 SRM Launchers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Jupiter was designed by Clan Jade Falcon to complement their premier assault 'Mech, the Turkina, during the Jihad. Although not as versatile as the Turkina, it was developed from the most commonly available parts at the time, giving the Jupiter a rugged and easily repaired design that many other designs cannot match. Due to its durability, Jupiters have been spotted in many mercenary and House armies throughout the post-Jihad Inner Sphere

content.original: The first Clantech OmniMech produced by Odin Manufacturing for the Ghost Bear Dominion, the Karhu (Finnish for "Bear") earned the reputation as a fast cavalry 'Mech. Built on an Endo Steel based chassis, powered by a 325-rated XL engine and clad in ten and half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Karhu featured respectable speed and armor for its size while providing thirty tons of available pod space for equipment. Twelve Double Heat Sinks coped with most of the waste heat of its varied configurations.

content.original: Intended as a symbol of Inner Sphere/Clan unity, the Kuma (Japanese for "Bear") is a fast if lightly armed Ghost Bear Dominion heavy cavalry BattleMech. While derisively referred to by some as the Charger IIC, the specialist Kuma was a heavy cornerstone to light Stars in the post-Jihad Dominion touman. Built on an Endo Steel frame, powered by an enormous 360 XL fusion engine and equipped with a large number of Improved Jump Jets, the Kuma is one of the most mobile heavy 'Mechs ever built, with a ground speed equal to the medium-weight Phoenix Hawk and a jump distance as high as the light-weight Spider. Clad in ten and half tons of standard armor, eleven Double Heat Sinks are barely able to cope with the design's weaponry and jump jets.

Built on an Endo Steel frame, powered by an enormous 360 XL fusion engine and equipped with a large number of Improved Jump Jets, the Kuma is one of the most mobile heavy 'Mechs ever built, with a ground speed equal to the medium-weight Phoenix Hawk and a jump distance as high as the light-weight Spider. Clad in ten and half tons of standard armor, eleven Double Heat Sinks are barely able to cope with the design's weaponry and jump jets.

content.original: The Legionnaire was developed as the Federated Suns answer to the Lyran Blitzkrieg, and entered production during the Word of Blake Jihad. A lance of Legionnaires played an important role in the Third Battle of New Avalon, where they quickly assaulted the Blakist force's left flank as they were attempting to ford the Thames river, breaking their momentum and eventually forcing them off world. Capable of reaching 118 km/h, the Legionnaire is a fast flanker.

content.content: «Легионер» был разработан Федеративными Солнцами как ответ на лиранский «Блицкриг» и поступил в производство во время Джихада Слова Блейка. Копьё легионеров сыграло важную роль в Третьей битве за Новый Авалон, где они стремительно атаковали левый фланг блейкистов, пытавшихся переправиться через Темзу, сломив их натиск и в конечном итоге вытеснив с планеты. Развивая скорость до 118 км/ч, «Легионер» — быстрый фланговик.

content.original: The Lu Wei Bing is known for its durability in battle. This is due in part to its 16 tons of standard armor and the use of reinforced armor around its Cockpit. Constructed with Endo Steel, using four JumpJets, and powered by a 340 Light engine, the 'Mech has the same speed and tactical flexibility as the older Victor. The 'Mech's main weapon is its Class 20 LB-X Autocannon, which is found in its right arm and is fed by four tons of ammunition. Unlike its spiritual predecessor, the Lu Wei Bing has more long-range weapons at its disposal in a fight. This includes two left-arm-mounted Light PPCs and a single MML-5 found in the left torso. Lastly, the Lu Wei Bing mounts a powerful Angel ECM Suite, giving the 'Mech additional electronic screening from advance weaponry and sensors. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Lu Wei Bing is an assault BattleMech first designed in the thirty-second century by Tao 'Mechworks for the Armed Forces of the Capellan Confederation. Physically resembling a slightly heavier Victor, the Lu Wei Bing's weapons layout also echoes the twenty-sixth century 'Mech. First produced in 3110, the Lu Wei Bing was produced as a replacement production design after the Confederation lost its Shengli Arms Assault 'Mech factories to the Federated Suns during the Victoria War.

content.original: The Antlion mounts a pair of Clan-tech Mech Mortar/4, one in the left torso and one in the right, both fed by six tons of ammunition secured deep inside the right torso and protected by CASE II. This ample supply of ammunition allows the Antlion to conduct substantial bombardments, if it has the time and opportunity to do so; however, the only other weapons mounted onto the Antlion are a pair of light machine guns mounted in its head. Relatively slow despite the use of a 225 XL engine, XL gyro, and small cockpit, the Antlion combined nine and a half tons of light ferro-fibrous armor with a reinforced structure for survivability, although a great deal of the Antlion's defense depended on the Bloodhound active probe each 'Mech was equipped with. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: Having dealt with years of incompatible systems with Clan-tech refits of the standard Beowulf, Odin built the Beowulf IIC from scratch in the hopes of avoiding them, only to use the same electronic systems which results in frequent glitches in combat. The main benefits of the switch to Clan-grade components was increased survivability for its 270-rated XL engine and the saving of half a ton through the use of Clan ferro-fibrous armor. Aside from that, the Beowulf IIC offers identical ground speed, bolstered by MASC, and jump distance as the ComStar BEO-12 model. The most notable and hotly contested change was the replacement of the Beagle active probe and TAG with a Watchdog CEWS and light TAG; while technically offering the same abilities with the added bonus of an ECM suite for less weight, the significantly reduced range forces the Beowulf IIC to put itself at much greater risk to fulfill its intended role. Similar to the ComStar original, the Beowulf IIC carries a right-arm mounted Series PPS-XX ER large pulse laser supported by a pair of left-arm mounted Series PPS-XIX ER medium pulse lasers. While doing more damage than the less advanced Inner Sphere weapons, the range brackets of the ComStar and Dominion models are almost identical, leading to further questions as to the value of the newer and more expensive design. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

The base chassis, armor, and ground performance remain the same as the parent design, but the ER large pulse laser and light TAG were replaced with a standard ER large laser and C3i computer. This design was used by troops from the First Drakøns on Labrea in 3099. The C3i technology was eventually removed from the factory by The Republic of the Sphere inspectors after exerting political pressure to stop using the equipment. content.original: An excellent close quarters 'Mech, the Blade XL is built around a rotary autocannon/5 supplied with three tons of reloads as its primary weapon, supported by a pair of ER medium lasers, all three weapons located in the 'Mech's right arm. While critics pointed out the risk of locating all the 'Mechs weapon in a single location, the decision was based on the manufacturer's attempts to achieve an OmniMech level ease of maintenance on a standard BattleMech. Save for the shoulder actuator, ammo, and energy feeds, the entire arm is a self contained system, allowing technicians to quickly and easily detach and replace a damaged arm with a undamaged replacement with relative ease. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

Faster than any previous Brigand thanks to the use of an Omni 175 extralight engine to reach a top speed of 111 km/h, the LDT-5 retains the endo steel chassis to carry five and a half tons of standard plate. Equipped with three medium lasers spread across its three torso sections, the LDT-5 carries a mace in the left arm, enhancing its close combat ability but also limiting how much booty the LDT-5 can make off with. Seven jump jets provide a 210 meter jump capability. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

content.original: This Dola is the production variant of the original DOL-1A, and is intended to act as a skirmisher. By replacing the fragile composite internal structure and the XL gyro with standard versions, the Dola is now a much tougher 'Mech. In addition, the use of a full-sized cockpit in place of the small cockpit makes piloting the 'Mech much easier. To make room for these changes, the armor was reduced by a half-ton and the vibroblade was downgraded to a standard sword. Despite this sacrifice, the 'Mech has become very popular with Capellan pilots. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: The Lu Wei Bing is known for its durability in battle. This is due in part to its 16 tons of standard armor and the use of reinforced armor around its Cockpit. Constructed with Endo Steel, using four JumpJets, and powered by a 340 Light engine, the 'Mech has the same speed and tactical flexibility as the older Victor. content.original: Created in 3058 in response to a call from Kurita to build more cost-effective BattleMechs with which to combat the Clans, the Akuma was designed by Independence Weaponry as a low-cost alternative to their Atlas variant. The Akuma actually shares several components with the Atlas and, much like that design, also features a head design intended to evoke fear in its enemies. The Akuma is built on a Foundation AKU Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a rugged and reliable GM 270 fusion engine that allows the 'Mech to reach a top speed of 54.0 km/h. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks to dissipate waste heat and carries seventeen and a half tons of Durallex Special Heavy armor for protection from enemy fire.

It is also the only Axman to not carry its typical melee weapon. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Debuted in 3140 on The Scrapyard Arena and piloted by Robert Driscan, the Pan makes several changes that give it an entirely new look and profile. A small vibroblade styled to resemble a 'Mech-scale parrying dagger replaces the original hatchet, and a collapsible partial wing assembly of Clan design featuring rounded-tip wings has been added to improve movement. These wings boost the already-impressive jump radius provided by the 'Mech's improved jump jets, allowing Pan to clear up to 330 meters in a single bound. Even with Clan-spec components used to save space and mass, this Buccaneer trades a lot of its original firepower away for its mobility. Because of this, Pan carries only three weapons, all of them lasers: two medium re-engineered lasers, able to cut through virtually any armor type, and one Inner Sphere ER medium laser. Double heat sinks and Clan ferro-fibrous armor complete the mix. The Pan's limited firepower means that slugging it out with one's adversary is just not an option for this 'Mech; agility and mobility are the order of the day for this machine. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: The Buccaneer is a product of the Word of Blake's voracious appetite for military equipment in its first few years, as the order had far more MechWarriors than they had 'Mechs. The Buccaneer was originally designed to be used by ComStar, but had not begun production. When the schism that created the Word of Blake occurred, the design was modified to accommodate equipment available to the Word of Blake in their temporary home of the Free Worlds League. The Buccaneer is built with a lightweight VOX 330 XL engine giving the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. It also carries an impressive ten tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the maximum amount of protection the chassis can carry, and mounts 10 double heat sinks as standard.

content.original: The product of a hybrid of Clan and Inner Sphere technology, the 'Mech benefits significantly from its dual heritage. Using a Clan-built 330-rated extralight engine and an Inner Sphere endo steel chassis, the Bakeneko was able carry a large array of weapons and equipment while maintaining a decent top speed of 97.2 km/h. It was also fitted with MASC, giving it crucial bursts of extra acceleration, and its six jump jets allowed it to leap up to 180 meters. The Bakeneko's main weaponry comes from an arm-mounted Clan produced large pulse laser and a light PPC, enhanced with a PPC capacitor. Additionally, found in the 'Mech's side torsos are a pair of MML-3s, each supplied by a ton of ammunition, providing supplemental firepower at long and short ranges, while at short ranges a head-mounted ER medium laser provides additional firepower. Protecting the design from enemy fire, the chassis was fitted with 11.5 tons of standard armor, with Clan CASE installed to mitigate any explosive detonations from its ammunition and PPC capacitor. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Bakeneko is a medium BattleMech originally created by the Draconis Combine and Clan Nova Cat at the dawn of the thirty-second century in a collaboration between Clan Nova Cat scientists and engineers from LAW. Based on the Phoenix Hawk, this slightly bigger design was intended as a fire support and skirmisher unit with the same mobility of the older design. The 'Mech was put into production in early 3100, where it was deployed to both Clan Nova Cat and the DCMS' Eleventh Ghost and Fifth Sword of Light Regiments during the last year of the Second Combine-Dominion War prior to the invasion of Irece in June, 3100. During the invasion, the greatly expanded factories which housed the Bakeneko's production lines were destroyed. The Bakeneko had a reputation as an effective fighting machine, as it was credited numerous kills by Draconis Combine forces during the conflict.

content.original: The Cadaver was introduced by the Taurian Concordat in 3094. With a top speed of 120 km/h, it typically functions as a high speed cavalry unit among Taurian forces, but has also been used as a scouting unit. Protected by six tons of ferro-fibrous armor, it has a great deal of armor for a light 'Mech, but doesn't possess much in the way of ranged firepower. The Cadaver carries a Full-Head Ejection System and a Guardian ECM suite disrupts enemy communications.

It removes all the standard weaponry and equipment and instead carries a Rocket Launcher 10 in the right torso, a light PPC on the right arm, and an ER flamer and ER medium laser on the left arm. For electronic warfare, it carries an Angel ECM suite, while a MASC system provides bursts of speed up to 160 km/h, allowing this Cadaver to run down hovercraft and VTOLs. The variant also replaces the ferro-fibrous with reflective armor. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

Originally developed to rapidly relocate heavy armor under battlefield conditions, the design has since spawned a host of imitators and copy cats with almost every developed world in the Inner Sphere and the Periphery possessing at least one Igor or Igor derived clone. Developed as a combat mod of the 60 ton VTOL, the Igor (LAC/5 WP) mounts a battery of Light AC/5s in place of the cargo bay. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Изначально разработанная для быстрой перевозки тяжёлой бронетехники в условиях боя, эта конструкция с тех пор породила множество подражателей и клонов, и практически в каждом развитом мире Внутренней Сферы и Периферии есть хотя бы один «Игорь» или его клон. content.original: The Skadi is a Fast Attack VTOL. It can reach a top speed of 162 km/h, and is protected by four and a half tons of Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The Skadi was originally designed by Clan Jade Falcon, but the main factory fell to the Lyran Commonwealth. For the next few decades, the Commonwealth sold the Skadi to any interested party. The combination of good protection, high speed, and a heavy gun proved to be very popular, and the Skadi was exported across the Inner Sphere. The Falcons later recaptured the facility and have restricted the Skadi to their own forces. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. The Falcons later recaptured the facility and have restricted the Skadi to their own forces. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 125 18 Left 100 18 Right 100 18 Rear 90 18 Turret 15 18 Total 430 90 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics
content.content: «Скади» — это быстрый боевой VTOL. Он способен развивать максимальную скорость 162 км/ч и защищён четырьмя с половиной тоннами клановой ферроволоконной брони. Изначально «Скади» был разработан кланом Нефритового Сокола, но позже основные производственные мощности перешли к Лиранскому Содружеству. В течение следующих нескольких десятилетий Содружество продавало «Скади» всем желающим. Сочетание хорошей защиты, высокой скорости и мощного орудия оказалось очень популярным, и «Скади» экспортировался по всей Внутренней Сфере. Позже Соколы вернули себе завод и ограничили использование «Скади» только для своих войск. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунных биомах. Передвижение: 10/15 гексов / 300/450 метров. content.original: The Amazon battle armor was created by the Magistracy of Canopus. Based on the standard Inner Sphere battle armor, the Amazon uses advanced armor to increase protection and provides a jump capability of 90 meters. This allows Amazon-equipped troops to clear obstacles that would stop other battle armor units. The Amazon is used by both the Magistracy and the Capellan Confederation. Amazons deployed by the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces faced Cavalier battle armor and turned in a better performance. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Это позволяет войскам, экипированным «Амазонками», преодолевать препятствия, которые остановили бы другие модели боевой брони. «Амазонки» используются как Магистратом, так и Конфедерацией Капеллы. «Амазонки», служившие в составе Вооружённых сил Конфедерации Капеллы, столкнулись с боевой броней «Кавалер» и показали лучшие результаты. content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: The -2Y is equipped with an XL engine that drives it to 54 km/h. The weight freed by the XL engine is used to add a Beagle Active Probe, Guardian ECM Suite, and C3 slave unit. It has thirteen and a half tons of armor to protect an Endo-Composite skeleton. It is also equipped with a Targeting Computer, and a Medium Shield is carried on the right arm. Offensively, it mounts a PPC, two large lasers, and three medium lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Buraq is a Clan medium-weight Quad battle armor, which was designed by Clan Hell's Horses during the early thirty-second century. The horselike Buraq was named for the mystical steed from ancient times, and like its mystical namesake, the battle armor is noted for its high ground speed. Typically, Clan Hell's Horses have used full Stars consisting of different variants of the battle armor. These Buraq Stars work as a team in their appointed mission assignments. They've been utilized on the Horses' Periphery borders to help scout and pin down pirates terrorizing their worlds. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Бурак» — это клановая боевая броня среднего веса, разработанная кланом Адских Лошадей в начале 32-го века. «Бурак», похожий на коня, получил своё название в честь таинственного скакуна из древности, и, подобно своему мистическому тёзке, этот боевой доспех отличается высокой скоростью передвижения по земле. Обычно, клан Адских Лошадей использует целые звёзды, полностью состоящие из различных вариантов этой боевой брони. Звёзды из «Бураков» работают в команде, выполняя поставленные задачи. Их использовали на границах Периферии Лошадей для разведки и пресечения пиратов, терроризирующих их миры. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.content: «Бурак» — это клановая боевая броня среднего веса, разработанная кланом Адских Лошадей в начале 32-го века. «Бурак», похожий на коня, получил своё название в честь таинственного скакуна из древности, и, подобно своему мистическому тёзке, этот боевой доспех отличается высокой скоростью передвижения по земле. Обычно, клан Адских Лошадей использует целые звёзды, полностью состоящие из различных вариантов этой боевой брони. Звёзды из «Бураков» работают в команде, выполняя поставленные задачи. Их использовали на границах Периферии Лошадей для разведки и пресечения пиратов, терроризирующих их миры.

content.original: The ultralight OmniMech Celerity was initially ComStar's attempt at creating an expendable drone reconnaissance BattleMech right after the Battle of Tukayyid. After the Fortress Protocols were activated, the Republic of the Sphere began experimenting with the Celerity as a means of expanding its military technology. They created a true OmniMech version of the Celerity to expand upon its utility and used it extensively on raids across their borders in the Dark Age era, causing endless confusion as to the identity of the parties using them.

content.content: Сверхлёгкий омнимех «Целерити» изначально был попыткой КомСтара создать одноразовый разведывательный дрон сразу после битвы на Туккайиде. После активации Протоколов Крепости Республика Сферы начала экспериментировать с «Целерити» как с инструментом расширения своих военных технологий. Они создали полноценную версию «Целерити» в формате омнимеха, чтобы расширить его возможности, и активно использовали его в рейдах вдоль своих границ в Тёмную эру.

content.original: The Clan Battle Armor is based on the Elemental suit, its visual aesthetic that shows that the Clan's contact with the Draconis Combine was already rubbing off on them. Though the design has a slow ground speed, the designers used the jump booster pioneered on the Gray Death Scout armor to rocket it up to one hundred twenty meters at a time. This necessitated a slight reduction in armor and a reworking of the weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.928 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Клановая боевая броня создана на основе костюма элементалей, внешний вид которого свидетельствует о том, что контакт Кланов с Синдикатом Дракона уже сказывался на них. Несмотря на низкую наземную скорость, разработчики использовали прыжковый ускоритель, впервые разработанный на броне Gray Death Scout, чтобы поднять его на высоту до ста двадцати метров. Это потребовало небольшого уменьшения толщины брони и переделки вооружения. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.928 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Introduced by Clan Ghost Bear, the Constable Pacification Suit was designed to help the Ghost Bear Dominion maintain order among its Inner Sphere-born citizenry. The Ghost Bear Watch originally developed it to help them against a Rasalhagian terrorist group known as the Motstånd. The suit's array of weapons and equipment options allowed the Watch to handle the terrorists while not exposing their civilian population to harm with a fully militarized police force. The suit's first usage was mishandled by the Ghost Bear Watch. The suit's sale to civilian police and other organizations allowed the Watch to be able develop less military tactics. The suit has since been spread to other Clans and the Draconis Combine's paramilitary organizations such as the Internal Security Force and the Civilian Guidance Corps. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Представленный кланом Призрачного Медведя, костюм для подавления беспорядков Constable был разработан, чтобы помочь Доминиону Призрачного Медведя поддерживать порядок среди своих граждан, родившихся во Внутренней Сфере. Дозор Призрачного Медведя изначально разработал его для борьбы с расальхагской террористической группировкой, известной как Motstånd. Разнообразие оружия и снаряжения костюма позволяло Дозору справляться с террористами, не подвергая гражданское население опасности. Первое применение костюма было неудачным для Дозора. Продажа костюма гражданской полиции и другим организациям позволила Дозору сбросить с себя часть нагрузки по наведению порядка. С тех пор костюм был распространен среди других кланов и военизированных организаций Синдиката Дракона, таких как Силы внутренней безопасности и Корпус гражданского руководства. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.9475 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Dragoon was conceived as a heavier, more versatile battlesuit for Wolf’s Dragoons’ Seventh Kommando. The Dragoon offers more protection and flexibility than common infiltration suits. This suit was originally designed to give combat engineers a degree of battlefield protection for high-risk intrusion operations, and to incorporate the ease of movement found in much lighter suits. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Изначально этот костюм был разработан для обеспечения боевых инженеров необходимой защитой на поле боя во время высокорискованных операций по проникновению, а также для обеспечения лёгкости движений, присущей гораздо более лёгким костюмам. The result of their work, Elemental II, discards Jump Jets and SRM pack in favor of battle armor myomer booster. Результатом их работы стал «Элементал II», отказавшийся от прыжковых двигателей и SRM в пользу миомерного усилителя боевой брони. Результатом их работы стал «Элементал II», отказавшийся от прыжковых двигателей и SRM в пользу миомерного усилителя боевой брони. Конструкция не снискала популярности и не вызвала интереса у других кланов, и «Элементал II» до сих пор ограниченно эксплуатируется лишь в гарнизонах Адских Лошадей.

content.original: As a heavy combat suit, the Fusilier combined aspects of the Grenadier and Sea Fox, and was designed to serve as a line unit alongside other similar suits. Because it was so slow-moving, the Fusilier mounted a Jump Booster to increase its mobility. Whereas other battlesuits in service to the AFFS typically earned a reputation based around their distinguishing characteristics, the best description of the Fusilier is "solid". Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Будучи тяжёлым боевым костюмом, «Фузилер» сочетал в себе особенности «Гренадера» и «Морского лиса» и был разработан для использования в качестве рядового юнита наряду с другими подобными костюмами. Из-за своей медлительности «Фузилера» оснастили прыжковым ускорителем. Боевые костюмы, состоявшие на вооружении ФедСолнц, обычно получали репутацию, основанную на их отличительных характеристиках, и лучшее описание «Фузилера» — «надёжный». Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Jihad-era -5R is known for its durability, and the -7R pushes that feature even further. Sluggish on the ground, it relies on its enhanced jump capacity for mobility; its Triple-Strength Myomer is useful for maintaining speed on long marches, but difficult to keep active in combat due to the -7R's limited heat-control options. Nonetheless, the 'Mech's potent short-range punch and incredibly stout hide make it an excellent urban combatant and line-holder—and no small prize for pirates and thieves. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Following the success of the Hermit Crab, StarCorps on Son Hoa found itself in the curious position of being a profitable advanced BattleMech manufacturer on an independent Periphery world. The company's Gladiator line had been running since the Blakist war, producing a few -5R export units every year. With minimal capital expansion costs and only a few newly-sourced components, the -7R refit became both an economical and effective local defense unit as well as a distinctive addition to the Son Hoa branch’s catalog for regional sales.

content.original: The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was the successor to the Infiltrator Mk. I, and while intended to fill a range of battlefield roles, it performed best as a scout or skirmisher. Nicknamed the Quokka, the Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was configured to be highly mobile and incorporated a Parafoil to allow it to make precise aerial drops. The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was capable of making swarm and leg attacks as well as being able to travel by mechanized transport. Each suit had a Basic Manipulator mounted on each arm and had more than a third of a ton of basic stealth armor for protection. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Инфильтрационный костюм «Серая смерть» был преемником Infiltrator Mk. I и, хотя и предназначался для выполнения различных боевых задач, лучше всего он проявлял себя в качестве разведчика или стрелка. Gray Death Infiltrator Suit, получивший прозвище «Квокка», был сконфигурирован для высокой мобильности и включал в себя параплан для точного десантирования с воздуха. Gray Death был способен совершать роевые атаки и атаки ногами, а также перевозиться на транспорте. Каждый костюм имел базовый манипулятор в каждой руке, и имел более трети тонны базовой стелс-брони для защиты. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Capture Gray Death Standard Battle Armor, like many other Inner Sphere variants, are often used as "Surat" Solahma suits. "Surat" is a Clan epithet that, when applied to infantry, often refers to captured or requisitioned Inner Sphere battle suits refit with Clan armor and weaponry and pressed into service in solahma formations - a formation of units made up of old or dying Clan warriors looking for a glorious death. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Grenadier is a battle armor design created by the Hahm-Heinz Design Bureau. The firm has long had a relationship with General Motors' secondary plants on Talcott and Salem, so when the NAIS first started creating battle armor, Hahm-Heinz had access to prototypes that they could work from. The armor is where the Grenadier is lacking, having only enough to stop an Inner Sphere Large Pulse Laser, the same amount as the venerable Inner Sphere Standard. This armor, however, is standard stealth armor, so the Grenadier is a bit more difficult to target.

content.original: The Hel is noted for its large 40 ton Omni Pod Capacity. This improvement was achieved through reducing the size of the 'Mech's engine to a 260-Rated XL Fusion Engine, installing a Small Cockpit, and the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prime Configuration of the Loki is geared towards long-range combat. The 'Mech's arms are fitted with a pair of Gauss Rifles and ER Large Lasers. In closer ranges, MechWarriors have a right torso mounted 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher to add additional firepower where the Gauss Rifles become difficult to aim. The main guns are supplied with 3 tons of ammunition, while the Streak launcher is allotted a single ton. Two additional Double Heat Sinks are fitted to the Prime, to help it cope with the heat of the ER Larges.

content.original: Designed in 3091 as an upgrade package for surviving HBK-4K models, the Hunchback HBK-6K swaps the original 14 SHS for 12 DHS. The newly created weight is used to install a C3 Slave and add the Apollo FCS to the MRM-40. Lastly the Medium Lasers are replaced with ER models. Intended to be finished by the early 32nd century, the upgrade package is part of an effort by House Kurita to shift older and less capable machines to militia units and allow frontline units to be rearmed with more advanced equipment. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The Infiltrator Mk. II is a battle armor suit designed as a replacement for the earlier Infiltrator Mk. I. With better armament and protection than its predecessor, the Mk. II was superior in all ways except cost. A battle armor-scale Magshot rifle provides firepower while an anti-infantry SMG provides light defense. A suite of stealth armor keeps the suit protected on the field. The only serious downside is the slow ground speed of the Mk. II, though jump jets help keep the suit semi-mobile. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Обладая лучшим вооружением и защитой, Mk II превзошёл своего предшественника по всем параметрам, кроме стоимости. Боевая винтовка Magshot обеспечивает огневую мощь, а противопехотный SMG - легкую защиту. Защиту на поле боя обеспечивает и комплект стелс-брони. Единственным серьезным недостатком Mk II является низкая скорость передвижения по земле, хотя прыжковые двигатели позволяют поддерживать какую-никакую мобильность. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.content: «Инфильтратор Mk II» - это боевая броня, разработанная в качестве замены более ранней модели Infiltrator Mk I. Обладая лучшим вооружением и защитой, Mk II превзошёл своего предшественника по всем параметрам, кроме стоимости. content.original: The Ironhold Assault Battle Armor was developed by Clan Jade Falcon during the Jihad. The roots of the Ironhold go back to development of the Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle in 3069. After the success of that weapon, a new project codenamed Project Ferrum was started to develop a new suit of battle armor with the support of the Elemental Trinary of 3rd Falcon Talon Cluster. The Ironhold is noted for being more mobile than typical Clan Assault Armor, where it can employ its Jump Jets and give itself better tactical advantage over its opponents. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня «Айронхолд» была разработана кланом Нефритового Сокола во время Джихада. История «Айронхолда» восходит к разработке противопехотной винтовки Гаусса в 3069 году. После успеха этого оружия был запущен новый проект под кодовым названием «Феррум» по разработке нового боевого доспеха при поддержке тринария «Элемнталов» 3-го кластера Когтей Сокола. «Айронхолд» отличается большей мобильностью, чем типичная штурмовая клановая броня, что позволяет ему использовать прыжковые двигатели и получать большее тактическое преимущество над противниками. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.96 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Kopis battle armor was designed by StarCorps Industries as an assault unit. Slow but heavily armed, the Kopis can remain on the battlefield supporting friendly units for a long time. The advanced armor used by the Kopis designers allows it to stand up to most weaponry, shrugging off anything short of a PPC or AC/10 hit. The low top speed is mitigated through the use of VTOL transportation for offensive operations, while smart commanders use the Kopis as a defense unit for cities or other tight terrain. In those restricted environments the low top speed isn't a factor. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Kopis была разработана компанией StarCorps Industries как штурмовой юнит. Медленный, но хорошо вооружённый, Kopis может долгое время оставаться на поле боя, поддерживая дружественные юниты. Продвинутая броня, использованная конструкторами Kopis, позволяет ему противостоять большинству видов вооружения, за исключением попаданий из PPC или AC/10. Низкая максимальная скорость компенсируется использованием вертикального взлёта и посадки (VTOL) в наступательных операциях, в то время как опытные командиры используют Kopis в качестве оборонительного юнита в городах или других труднодоступных местах. В таких ограниченных условиях низкая максимальная скорость не имеет значения. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Leonidas battle armor was a product of Etna Foundries and was intended to plug a capability gap in the armed forces of the Duchy of Oriente, a gap created by scarcity of the older Achileus stealth suit. The Leonidas suit is highly configurable, capable of being reconfigured for various battlefield missions including providing positional information, calling in artillery strikes, waging counterinsurgency warfare and conducting ambushes; the various roles are made possible through the different weapons and equipment loadouts available via the Modular Weapon Mount. Quirk: Information Gatherer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.prevOriginal: Leonidas battle armor was a product of Etna Foundries and was intended to plug a capability gap in the armed forces of the Duchy of Oriente, a gap created by scarcity of the older Achileus stealth suit. content.content: Боевая броня «Леонид» была разработана компанией Etna Foundries и должна была восполнить пробел в вооруженных силах герцогства Ориенте, возникший из-за нехватки более старого стелс-костюма «Ахиллес». Костюм Leonidas обладает высокой степенью гибкости и может быть перенастроен для выполнения различных задач на поле боя, включая предоставление информации о местоположении, нанесение артиллерийских ударов, ведение противоповстанческой войны и организацию засад; различные роли возможны благодаря различным вариантам вооружения и снаряжения, доступным через модульное крепление оружия. Особенность: Information Gatherer Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Несущий тринадцать тонн ферроволоконной брони, Mad Cat MK II - невероятно прочная конструкция. Пара установленных в руках пушек Гаусса, поддерживаемые LRM, обеспечивают ему полное господство на поле боя.

content.original: Such an extensive modification to the point it was an entirely different design, the MNL-3W was a complete rebuild utilizing Clan technology. Built on a Clan-grade Endo Steel chassis, powered by a Clan 350-rated XL fusion engine and clad in ten tons of Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor backed by an ECM suite, the 3W saved more weight while boasting superior durability to the Inner Sphere tech model. The weight saved allowed the replacement of the standard weaponry with a pair of full Clan-grade Gauss rifles and swapped the IS ER Mediums for more deadly Clan models. The MNL-3W also had far superior endurance in the field thanks to the four tons of Gauss reloads, two dedicated for each cannon, carried in automatically CASE equipped bays and two additional heat sinks. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
content.prevOriginal:
The Mangonel MNL-3L was literally built around the massive torso bay which contained its primary weapons, a pair of Light Gauss Rifles, which when combined with its high speed allowed the 'Mech to dance around its targets at range. Unfortunately the single ton of reloads carried was adequate only for Clan Trials, while the pair of ER Medium Lasers mounted in each arm made it an effective close-ranged combatant only as long as its minimal armor held out. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Designed by the Marian Hegemony using the most cutting-edge gear available to them, the Marauder Battle Armor is patterned after the venerable Marauder BattleMech. Armed with a pair of Support PPCs and a Light Recoilless Rifle, the Marauder BA is one of the most heavily armed BA in existence. The Marians deploy them in squads of five called a contubernium and the suits are designed for that kind of larger deployment. While not particularly well armored, their extreme firepower load for battle armor makes them deadly on the field. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.895 Can mount any unit, can not melee, can not swarm.

Вооружённая парой PPC и лёгким безоткатным ружьём, боевая броня «Мародер» является одной из самых вооружённых моделей боевой брони среди существующих. Марианцы используют их отрядами по пять человек, называемыми контуберниумом. Несмотря на не слишком прочную броню, их высокая огневая мощь делает их смертельно опасными на поле боя. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.895 Может крепиться на любом юните, не может рукопашную, не может swarm-атаку.

Its origin stems from Clan Ghost Bear's need to replace its aging inventory of 'Mechs; in order to accomplish this, a joint project was started between manufacturers in the Rasalhague Dominion and those in the Lyran Commonwealth that produced 'Mechs for Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The two Clan manufacturers desired for the 'Mech to be both inexpensive and combat effective.

content.original: Designed with a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies, the MGL-T1's noted speed comes from its 350 XL engine. This powerful Clan-tech engine allowed the swift 'Mech to outpace most machines on the battlefield with a top speed of 118.8 km/h. Its endo steel hull is protected by 10.5 tons of reactive armor, giving it additional protection from area-effect weapons, penetrating weapons, and missile fire. The Mongrel' T1 model weaponry includes three Clan ER medium lasers fitted to its right torso. Backing up these up is an AC/5, the autocannon is supplied with 20 rounds of ammunition found in its one-ton ammunition bin. The Mongrel has a retractable blade mounted in its right arm actuator, in case the pilot needs to engage in melee combat. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original: The Morrigan is a light BattleMech that was developed by Clan Nova Cat just after the Jihad to meet their need for a new scout 'Mech. The Nova Cats received technical and material support from the Draconis Combine who had access to the design as well. Political wrangling among the Nova Cats and Draconis Combine kept the overall production numbers low however. The design was deployed as part of the Nova Cat's second line troops, and the Combine sent Morrigans to their elite units.

Нова Коты получали техническую и материальную поддержку от Синдиката Дракона, который также имел доступ к проекту. Однако политические разногласия между Котами и Синдикатом сдерживали общее число произведенной продукции на низком уровне. Мех был задействован в составе войск второй линии Нова Котов, а Синдикат направлял «Морриган» в свои элитные подразделения.

content.original: The Night Wolf has a wide range of weaponry, which includes a Heavy Large Laser in the right torso and an ER medium laser in its right arm. To alleviate the targeting issues caused by the Heavy Laser, the 'Mech has been fitted with a Targeting Computer. For ranged attacks, the 'Mech utilizes a pair of ATM 9 Launchers mounted in both of the 'Mechs' arms. To help deal with the advent of increased conventional vehicles and infantry forces, the 'Mechs left arm is fitted with a Plasma Cannon. As a final defensive precaution, an anti-missile system is situated on the 'Mech's head to take down incoming missile fire. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Night Wolf is a Clan Wolf Assault BattleMech produced by 3085 on Weingarten. The design was created by the Wolves as a practical means to deal with the new Combined Arms strategies employed by its opponents. The Night Wolf is meant as a replacement assault 'Mech for its second-line units which needed to replace the aging designs in their ranks. The 'Mech is not considered very fast, but its jump jets make it mobile enough to handle most contemporaries on the battlefield. Using a 360 Rated Extra Light Fusion Engine, the design is able to afford a large array of weaponry. Due to use of standard armor, its armor protection is considered to be less than other Clan 'Mechs. However, its 15.5 tons of armor coverage is considered strong enough for normal encounters. To help deal with more sophisticated electronics that may be employed against it, the 'Mech has been fitted with a Guardian ECM Suite.

content.original: The Nyx is a light BattleMech originally developed by the Word of Blake in the late Jihad. The Blakists' designs for the 'Mech and a prototype were captured by the Allied Coalition's Draconis Combine force on Quentin in 3077,[4] and were rushed off to the Draconis Combine's Diplan MechYards, where engineers did not have the resources to put the advanced design into production. After the liberation of Terra in 3079, the Combine would ask aide from the new Terran government to assist with development of the 'Mech. It would be jointly produced by both the Republic and Combine, prior to the very end of the Jihad. The design was conceived as a speedy recon 'Mech, with a 300 XL engine allowing it to reach 162 km/h.

They attempted to create a 'Mech similar to the Pack Hunter, but ER PPCs were sparse at the time, however the team got its break when the Nova Cats acquired a cache of heavy large lasers from Clan Diamond Shark in 3065. They had to rework the original concept of duplicating the Pack Hunter, which eventually became the Ocelot.

content.original: The Ogre heavy battle armor has a physically intimidating appearance, largely due to the twin Heavy Battle Claws used as weapons and Tvastar's choice to use an unusually wide frame for the suit. Despite that appearance, the Ogre isn't well-suited to fighting conventional infantry, but the heavy armor and weapons mounted on the Ogre allows it to attack enemy armor, and actions in certain early battles saw the Ogre gain a reputation for tearing tanks in half - a reputation that was rather fanciful, but did serve to enhance the Ogre's reputation. The Ogre has since been exported outside the Regulan Fiefs by Tvastar, with the Duchy of Andurien and the Lyran Commonwealth both ordering large production runs. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.

Owens — это мощный юнит-корректировщик огня, а также боевой мех для отрядов с C3, со своими не снимаемыми блоками TAG, Beagle Probe и C3 Slave.

content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble.

content.content: «Пак Хантер» — первый новый проект, созданный кланом Волка-в-изгнании на Арк-Ройяле. Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей.

content.original: A light field artillery, experimental BattleMech, the Pandarus, named for a famous archer from the mythical battle of Troy on ancient Terra, is an Extended LRM Missile boat. Originally a Kali Yama design team proposal for an OmniMech missile boat capable of carrying both common and Experimental Technology missile systems, ultimately the high cost of building an all new design with all new OmniPods proved too high, with the design team forced to scale back their project to a non-Omni ELRM-equipped prototype built on a mothballed Orion chassis.

In the left torso, the 'Mech has an ER Large Laser to assist with long-range attacks. As a near afterthought, the design also sports a SRM-2 Launcher in right torso as well. The 'Mech is fitted out with 15 Double Heat Sinks to handle the significant heat load its weapons and propulsion system can generate during a firefight. content.original: To minimize logistical concerns, the Penthesilea uses several energy weapons. An ER PPC and Light PPC harass an enemy at longer ranges, while the LB 10-X AC can fire solid shot to penetrate armor or use cluster rounds to capitalize on armor breaches caused by the other weapons. When the range drops, the trio of ER Medium Lasers mounted in the center torso can easily carve up an opponent. Though the use of energy weapons does ease logistical concerns, the MechWarrior piloting a Penthesilea must monitor the heat closely, as the thirteen double heat sinks installed in the chassis are barely enough to dissipate the heat generated by the energy weapons, and careless weapon fire can quickly overwhelm the cooling system. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Penthesilea has the distinction of being the heaviest unit built by the Magistracy of Canopus. The 75 ton 'Mech is constructed not on Detroit, but at Majesty Metals' factory on Dunianshire. This places the production line squarely under Magistracy control, something the Magestrix needed for political reasons. The Penthesilea isn't the fastest heavy 'Mech on the field, but the presence of three jump jets allows it to cover 90 meters in a single leap. This helps offset the fact that the Penthesilea has an average top speed. Using an Endo Steel chassis allows the design to carry twelve tons of ferro-fibrous armor. In addition, the Endo Steel frame allows the 'Mech to carry more weapons, without resorting to a vulnerable XL engine.

content.original: The 2MAF removes all the standard weapons except for the ER PPC and a single ER Medium Laser. In their place are an LB 20-X AC and an ER Large Laser. The Compact Gyro and Jump Jets have also been removed, and replaced by an XL Gyro. The remaining ER Medium Laser was moved to the head to make room for the XL Gyro. This version carries an extra heat sink to help dissipate heat. Finally the designers removed the standard ferro-fibrous armor and replaced it with Light Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: This variant of the Penthesilea was created as a test of Actuator Enhancement Systems. Its top speed is reduced to 54 km/h thanks to a smaller compact engine, but it retains the ninety meter jump radius of its forbearers. Fitted with a variety of weapons systems, this Penthesilea PEN-3H carries a Bombast Laser and three Medium Lasers in the right arm; the left arm carries a Medium VSP Laser and Light AC/5. Both arms are equipped with AES. Four Light Machine Guns are carried as well: One in the right torso, while three more are carried in the center torso in a Machine Gun Array. Ammunition for the machine guns and Light AC/5 is stored in the left torso in a CASE II protected bay. Fourteen tons of Light Ferro-Fibrous armor protects the 3H. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. The Purifier Terra uses a Modular Weapon Mount to provide a variety of weapons options. The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.868 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Основное отличие от стандартного костюма Purifier заключается в отсутствии адаптивной брони и её замене на стандартную клановую, идентичной той, что используется в костюме «Элементалов». Purifier Terra использует модульное оружейное крепление (MWM), предоставляющее широкий выбор оружия. Коалиция столкнулась с вариантами, оснащёнными клановым малым ER-лазером, малым импульсным лазером и бронебойной винтовкой Гаусса. Другие варианты использовали среднюю безоткатную винтовку. Кроме того, можно было нести любое снаряжение, помещающееся в 400-килограммовое MWM. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.868 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Purifier Terra использует модульное оружейное крепление (MWM), предоставляющее широкий выбор оружия. Коалиция столкнулась с вариантами, оснащёнными клановым малым ER-лазером, малым импульсным лазером и бронебойной винтовкой Гаусса. Другие варианты использовали среднюю безоткатную винтовку. Кроме того, можно было нести любое снаряжение, помещающееся в 400-килограммовое MWM. content.original: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Квиринус», производимый на Терре компанией StarCorp Industries, — это средний боевой доспех конца 31-го века, изначально выпускавшийся для широкой продажи. Разработанный как основной боевой доспех в первые годы эры Республики, «Квиринус» изначально продавался раздробленной Лиге Свободных Миров. Хотя он не такой броский, как многие его современники, этот костюм известен своей надёжностью и эффективностью в полевых условиях. Этот боевой доспех впоследствии попал в руки наёмных отрядов, а также подразделений Республики Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Designed by the Marian Hegemony using the most cutting-edge gear available to them. The Marian Hegemony soon began marketing the suit for sale to the open market to help bolster the Hegemony's coffers. The Marians deploy them in squads of five called a contubernium and the suits are designed for that kind of larger deployment. While not particularly well armed, the Ravager has extensive armor coverage, making them extremely durable on the battlefield. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Юнит разработан Марианской Гегемонией с использованием самого современного оборудования, доступного им. Гегемония вскоре начала продавать костюм на открытом рынке, чтобы пополнить свою казну. Марианцы используют их отрядами по пять человек, называемыми контуберниумом. Несмотря на не слишком хорошее вооружение, «Опустошитель» имеет мощную броню, что делает его чрезвычайно живучим на поле боя. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: First known to have been deployed in 3073, the Rogue Bear is a battle armor design produced by Clan Ghost Bear. Initially confused for the Golem, the Rogue Bear is a heavy battlesuit that was initially deployed with garrison units, especially those of the KungsArmé who were incorporated into the Ghost Bear touman. The Rogue Bear can jump up to sixty meters at a time. It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle. The battlesuit uses mostly standard components with no disposable weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Salamander the design incorporates fire-based weapons; its primary armaments being a pair of Flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot short-range missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.928 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

Это делает «Саламандру» особенно эффективной против пехоты и боевой техники, хотя это не значит, что она менее устрашающа и для мехвоинов: мало кто захочет попасться на прицел «Саламандре». It keeps the same weapons configuration as the MN1-D but replaces the primitive engine, primitive armor, and primitive cockpit with more modern upgrades. content.original: One of the first primitive BattleMechs produced by the Free Worlds League, the Sarissa is one of many centuries-old Age of War designs reborn during the desperation of the Jihad. A contemporary of the Icarus and Mackie, the original MN1-K Sarissa, designed sometime shortly after 2470, was intended as a stopgap that could be readily manufactured in civilian IndustrialMech facilities to bolster the League's member state militias in the face of Lyran Commonwealth and Capellan Confederation newborn BattleMech forces. This philosophy would also make the Sarissa very appealing in 3080 as the Principality of Regulus suffered increasing losses during the Word of Blake Jihad, favoring even a primitive BattleMech over even more simple to build combat vehicles for propaganda purposes.

content.original: The Sea Fox amphibious battle armor is a niche unit, but one that excels within that niche; intended to operate underwater and equipped with a Clantech Underwater Maneuvering Unit capable of moving the suit at the same speed in shallow water as it could move on land, the Sea Fox is an excellent infiltrator and ambush fighter, capable of excelling in urban operations in areas where waterways are available for access. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня-амфибия Sea Fox — это узкоспециализированный юнит, который предназначен для действий под водой и оснащен клановым подводным маневровым модулем, позволяющим передвигаться в костюме по мелководью с той же скоростью, что и по суше. Sea Fox является превосходным средством проникновения и засадного боя, способным преуспеть в городских операциях в районах с доступом к воде. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

An ER Large Laser and LRM-10 provide long range firepower, and close combat is possible via the Heavy Medium Laser and Micro Pulse Laser mounted in each arm. content.original: To perform its role as a main line 'Mech the Shen Yi is armed with a pair of 20-Tube Medium Range Missile Launchers with four tons of ammunition in the center, left, and right torsos. These give it a respectable punch at medium to close ranges. For sparring with other units at long range the Shen Yi is armed with an ER Large Laser, mounted in the right arm with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers to give it some protection at close range. The 'Mech is protected by 13 tons of Stealth Armor, which is linked to its Guardian ECM Suite in the left arm. To manage its heat load, the 'Mech has been provided with fourteen Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Shen Yi is a front line stealth BattleMech which has its roots in previous programs such as the Men Shen and Sha Yu BattleMechs. The design was seen as a breakthrough in using 'Mechs with Stealth Armor in a front line role as opposed to the previously seen reconnaissance role by the CCAF. Within 15 years of its introduction, many older missile support elements in the CCAF had been replaced by the Shen Yi.

content.original: The Shockwave is geared primarily for long-range attacks. The combination of its Artemis IV FCS-enhanced LRM-10 launcher and ER large laser provide effective firepower at long range, supplemented by an RAC/5 for devastating firepower should opposing units close in. The only drawback to this weapon configuration is the 'Mech's heavy reliance on ammunition; if the one ton ammo bays for each weapon run dry, the Shockwave is left with only a single laser to defend itself. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The Shockwave was created by the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth in the years after the Jihad. Its high top speed, strong armor, and powerful weapons make it a popular choice around the Inner Sphere. Mobile and heavily-armed for a 50-ton 'Mech, the Shockwave can deliver a withering barrage and has the heat-sinks to keep it up almost indefinitely. The use of standard armor and commonly employed weapons allows the Shockwave to be used on nearly any battlefield.

Mobile and heavily-armed for a 50-ton 'Mech, the Shockwave can deliver a withering barrage and has the heat-sinks to keep it up almost indefinitely. The use of standard armor and commonly employed weapons allows the Shockwave to be used on nearly any battlefield.

content.original: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't designed for frontline combat, and the designation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional unarmored sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly armored and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle armor. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Spectre Battle Armor was developed and fielded by Protectorate Arms Conglomerate. It has got its name from the stealth armor that protects it. This armor, while good at hiding it from enemy sensors, fares very poorly when under fire. The Spectre is pretty quick for a humanoid Battle Armor, but its Mechanical Jump Booster is not a true replacement for regular Jump Jets. Magnetic clamps adapted from the Fa Shih Battle Armor allow the Spectre to be carried into battle. While its armament gives it better combat ability than some early stealth suits, it still cannot stand up to larger battle armor like the Elemental or Kanazuchi. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня «Спектр» была разработана и принята на вооружение компанией Protectorate Arms Conglomerate. Свое название броня получила от защищающей её стелс-брони. Эта броня, хотя и хорошо скрывает от вражеских сенсоров, очень плохо себя ведет под огнем. «Спектр» довольно быстр для боевой брони гуманоидного типа, но его механический прыжковый ускоритель не является полноценной заменой обычным прыжковым двигателям. Магнитные зажимы, адаптированные от боевой брони Fa Shih, позволяют доставить «Спектра» на поле боя. Хотя его вооружение обеспечивает ему лучшие боевые возможности, чем некоторые ранние стелс-костюмы, он все еще не может противостоять более крупной боевой броне, такой как «Элементал» или «Канадзучи». Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Sphinx was designed by Clan Nova Cat as a heavier companion to the Black Hawk OmniMech. The design was originally intended to be an OmniMech, but was changed due to the need to field 'Mechs more quickly. The Sphinx is built around an array of multiple lasers, allowing it to put out a massive amount of firepower at moderate ranges. It also maintains a similar movement profile to the Black Hawk although it lacks the jump jets of the lighter design. Its heavier frame also supports 13.5 tons of standard Clan armor, making it more durable than the smaller Black Hawk..

content.original: The Stormbird was commissioned by Clan Jade Falcon and intended as a bridge between the available Elemental and Ironhold battlesuits, being the result of collaboration between Falcon resources and Clan Snow Raven science. The proposed anti-infantry role for the Stormbird interested the Snow Ravens, who desired a similar-sized suit with a similar operational profile. The final result was not the versatile platform expected by the Falcons, with the design closely matching the already available Salamander. For the Snow Ravens however, the Stormbird proved to be an immense success providing them with fire-resistant armor that had thus far proved impossible to produce. Quirk: Inspiring Appearance Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount any unit, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Stormbird был заказан кланом Нефритового Сокола и задумывался как связующее звено между уже имеющимися боевыми костюмами «Элементал» и «Айронхолд», став результатом объединения ресурсов клана Сокола и учёных Снежного Ворона. Предполагаемая противопехотная роль Stormbird заинтересовала Снежных Воронов, которым требовался костюм схожего размера и с аналогичными характеристиками. Конечный результат не стал универсальной платформой, на которую рассчитывали Соколы, поскольку конструкция была очень похожа на уже существующую «Саламандру». Однако для Снежных Воронов Stormbird оказалась огромным успехом, обеспечив их огнестойкой броней, которую до сих пор было невозможно изготовить. Особенность: Вдохновляющий Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.935 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Designed by Defiance Industries, the Storm Raider was intended to be an alternative to the Hollander light 'Mech. Unfortunately for Defiance, the Storm Raider was 50 years too late for the market, and the various prototypes were poorly received - so poorly received, in fact, that Defiance licensed all of the designs to Coventry Metal Works. Coventry Metal Works was manufacturing four different variants of the Storm Raider intended for use in urban defense roles or for small-scale surgical strikes, but the Storm Raider was a poor performer in both roles, outgunned by contemporaries and slower than most. Despite that, the Storm Raider proved an able fighter in the arenas at Solaris VII, where it became a fan favorite.

content.original: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Named after the shield that was the primary means of defense for the Scottish Highlanders of Terra, the Targe is a lackluster recon and cavalry design born of compromise. To achieve enough movement speed to fullfill its role the 'Mech uses an engine large enough that it uses up nearly half the 'Mech's weight. The use of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor maximized the five tons available for armor coverage, while ten Double Heat Sinks could easily cope with the design's heat output.

content.original: Named after the shield that was the primary means of defense for the Scottish Highlanders of Terra, the Targe is a lackluster recon and cavalry design born of compromise. To achieve enough movement speed to fullfill its role the 'Mech uses an engine large enough that it uses up nearly half the 'Mech's weight. The use of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor maximized the five tons available for armor coverage, while ten Double Heat Sinks could easily cope with the design's heat output.

content.original: The primary configuration of the Templar is intended to be able to engage an enemy effectively at any range. For effective long range hitting power, the Templar carries a powerful Gauss Rifle. If the Templar does close with an enemy, it can bring its highly accurate Large Pulse Laser, Medium Pulse Laser, and two ER Medium Lasers to bear on a target. For increased accuracy, the Gauss Rifle and all the lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer. The Templar Prime has a Streak SRM-4 launcher for seeking weak points in an enemy's armor.

content.original: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.

content.content: Созданный по образцу омнимеха Thor, используемого Кланами, Thanatos отличается невероятной прочностью и мощью. Копируя как внешний вид, так и возможности кланового Thor, Thanatos является быстрой машиной, способной действовать на всех дистанциях, хотя для меха такого размера он немного скуповат в плане брони. Оснащенный ER Large Laser для дальних дистанций, парой усовершенствованных средних лазеров и MRM-20 для средних и ближних дистанций, Thanatos имеет оружие для любой ситуации. В сочетании с высокой максимальной скоростью 86,4 км/ч и пятью прыжковыми двигателями, Thanatos часто может догнать то, что не может перестрелять.
