content.original: The Thunder Fox is a medium Quad BattleMech that was produced at the end of the Jihad, with thanks to an engineer named Lara Harman. Harman, a former Mitchell Vehicles designer, secretly - and principally - combined the Blue Flame Quad 'Mech's design specs with other Blakist designs to conceive the Thunder Fox. The design became popular with the newly formed Republic of the Sphere. It was later exported to the Draconis Combine and Lyran Commonwealth.

content.original: The Thunder Fox TFT-F11 is protected by over twenty tons of Hardened Armor. The head carries a Clan-built ER PPC and a targeting computer in a head turret. To make room for the turret, this Thunder Fox uses a torso-mounted cockpit. To make room for the torso cockpit, it uses a compact gyro and a larger XXL engine allows it walk at 58 km/h while reaching a top speed of 74 km/h. It also has five standard jump jets, allowing it to cover 150 meters in a single jump. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Tian-zong is a post-Jihad design that the Capellan Confederation first developed in 3090. Equipped with thirteen and a half tons of Stealth Armor powered by an Angel ECM Suite, the Tian-zong is a premier 'Recon in Force' 'Mech. The 300-rated extralight engine propels the Tian-zong to a top speed of 64 km/h, which can make for a jarring ride given the Small Cockpit. The Tian-zong is one of the first Capellan 'Mechs to use an Endo-Composite skeleton. Twelve Double Heat Sinks dissipate the heat from the Stealth Armor. It is a popular 'Mech with CCAF commanders.

content.original: Produced by Hilltopper Engineering (a spin off of the mercenary command Holt's Hilltoppers) for the Fronc Reaches' Colonial Marshals the TinStar came as a shock both to the Fronc Reaches' neighbors and the local pirate groups when it was introduced in 3086. The initial suit contained a mixture of Clan and Inner Sphere technology that, while being powerful, was regarded as undesirable by the Marshals due to its reliance on outside suppliers. Hilltopper Engineering would accommodate the Marshals request for a more production friendly variant which would lead to the first mass production line outside of vehicles for the Fronc Reaches at the time. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Торнадо» — это легкая боевая броня, созданная КомСтаром в конце XXIX века для обеспечения дополнительной защиты юнитов специального назначения. Tornado основан на костюме Nighthawk от СОЗЛ, который, хотя КомСтар и приобрели несколько экземпляров, в то время не могли производить. Он включает в себя стелс-броню и адаптивную систему камуфляжа, которая имитирует эффект комбинированного камуфляжного/инфракрасного/электронного противодействия Sneak Suit, скрывая Tornado от всех типов датчиков. Броня также достаточно хороша, чтобы остановить огонь из стрелкового оружия и даже тяжелого оружия, такого как огнемет, и не дать ему повредить носителя. Особенность: Power Armor Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.8832 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Он включает в себя стелс-броню и адаптивную систему камуфляжа, которая имитирует эффект комбинированного камуфляжного/инфракрасного/электронного противодействия Sneak Suit, скрывая Tornado от всех типов датчиков. Броня также достаточно хороша, чтобы остановить огонь из стрелкового оружия и даже тяжелого оружия, такого как огнемет, и не дать ему повредить носителя. Особенность: Power Armor Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.8832 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The -K7R variant of the Trebuchet removes all the standard weaponry, the engine, and the skeleton, replacing them with a Light Engine, Endo Steel skeleton, and a new weapons array. Intended for short range combat, the TBT-K7R carries a pair of ER medium lasers, a pair of ER Flamers, a Streak SRM-6, and a Chain Whip. What makes it most deadly however, is the BattleMech Taser in the left arm. With this weapon the Trebuchet can capture an enemy 'Mech. The Trebuchet also carries Triple Strength Myomer, allowing it to pin 'Mechs as heavy as an Atlas. Ten and a half tons of armor and a 150 meter jump range protect the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The Trebuchet (also jovially referred to as the Trenchbucket) is a mainline medium weight BattleMech considered to be a fine blend of long- and short-range fire support for a unit of its size. Unlike many other pre-Clan 'Mechs, the Trebuchet was designed from the beginning to work as part of a lance instead of functioning as a stand-alone model.

content.content: Требушет (также шутливо называемый «Тренчбакет» («траншейное ведро»)) — это основной боевой мех среднего веса, считающийся идеальным сочетанием дальнего и ближнего огневого сопровождения для юнита такого размера. В отличие от многих других мехов доклановского периода, «Требушет» изначально разрабатывался как часть копья, а не как самостоятельная машина.

content.original: The -XK7 is a refit of the classical Trebuchet done by the Taurian Concordat. It uses ten double heat sinks and an XL engine for power. Several experimental systems have been added. A Chain Whip allows the 'Mech to pin units close to the Trebuchet. To capitalize on this, the traditional weapons have been replaced with a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers, an ER medium laser, ER Flamer, and a medium pulse laser. For additional protection, this Trebuchet carries Modular Armor on the front of each torso and a Small Shield on the left arm. Triple Strength Myomer maximizes the physical damage it can cause, and pins heavy and assault 'Mechs in place with the Chain Whip. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: The Tundra Wolf was the first brand new Clan Wolf BattleMech fully developed and solely produced in the Inner Sphere. With losses mounting during the Word of Blake's Jihad, rather than a costly and complex OmniMech, Wolf technicians focused on producing a standard generalist design that could be readily manufactured and fill as many roles within their depleted touman as possible. While somewhat slow for a Clan-made 75-ton 'Mech, the Tundra Wolf made up for that with MASC, that allowed it to sprint in bursts and jump jets, enabling it to leap up to 120 meters at a time.

While somewhat slow for a Clan-made 75-ton 'Mech, the Tundra Wolf made up for that with MASC, that allowed it to sprint in bursts and jump jets, enabling it to leap up to 120 meters at a time.

content.original: The suite of offensive weaponry carried by the Ursa is divided between the left and right torsos. On each side are a brace of Medium X-Pulse Laser, popular with those who regularly fought the Clans; mounted into the right torso is a Rotary AC/2 supplied with a ton of ammunition, while mounted into the left torso is an ER PPC. The MASC system built into the Ursa in combination with the 325 XL fusion engine that powers the 'Mech results in a ferocious quadrupedal design that can run at speeds of over 100 km/h; this, combined with the gyro and twelve and a half tons of armor meant that the Ursa can not only survive full-speed collisions but can do so without falling or the pilot losing control. This led to MechWarriors nicknamed the Ursa 'the Rhino' because of the brutal charges it can perform. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The quadrupedal Ursa was a jack of all trades often paired alongside the Scourge to perform risky escort duties or to go on heavy recon missions. The Ursa is popular with mercenary units and with those forces fighting along the border between the Lyran Commonwealth and Clan Jade Falcon. Key to the Ursa's design is its revolutionary gyroscope, which renders the 'Mech exceptionally stable - even in comparison to other quad BattleMechs.

content.original: The Valiant was developed by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, one of the many weapon manufacturers on Solaris VII, at the behest of Irian BattleMechs Unlimited. Based on the Scarabus, the Valiant was conceived as a light skirmisher and first saw use during the Solaran resistance to the occupying Word of Blake in 3068. The two remaining prototypes were smuggled off world in 3070, when the design was picked up by Wakazashi Enterprises. Since the destruction of Luthien Armor Works, the heavy industry of the Draconis Combine was diversifying and expanding to keep the DCMS equipped, and the need for a ready-made BattleMech design overwhelmed the traditional Draconian dislike of hatchets. The 'Mech has received a tepid reception, even among the mercenaries that VEST has sold the design to.

content.original: Designed to work with the lightweight Wolfhound BattleMech, the Verfolger (German for 'Pursuer') and Wolfhound together are capable of taking out much larger BattleMechs. The Verfolger is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 325 XL engine that sacrifices durability for lighter weight and propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The 'Mech uses its saved weight to carry an impressive twelve and a half tons of armor that allows the Verfolger to stand up to fire from most enemy units that it would encounter.

content.original: An ambush predator that originated in the Solaris VII arenas, Harmony MetalWorks' Violator originally rose to prominence through both the arena fights and the actions of a band of aces from the Regulan Fiefs during the late thirty-first century. The Violator's reputation continued to improve in the thirty-second century from continued arena performances and combat actions featuring the mech in service with the Regulan Hussars. The flashy reputation the Violator earned in the arenas belied the ease with which the Violator can be maintained and repaired, but despite the nine tons of Heavy standard armor and an Armored Cockpit the Violator wasn't suited for line combat.

content.original: An ambush predator that originated in the Solaris VII arenas, Harmony MetalWorks' Violator originally rose to prominence through both the arena fights and the actions of a band of aces from the Regulan Fiefs during the late thirty-first century. The Violator's reputation continued to improve in the thirty-second century from continued arena performances and combat actions featuring the mech in service with the Regulan Hussars. The flashy reputation the Violator earned in the arenas belied the ease with which the Violator can be maintained and repaired, but despite the nine tons of Heavy standard armor and an Armored Cockpit the Violator wasn't suited for line combat.

content.original: Created in the post-Jihad era, the Warg assault battle armor was Clan Wolf's response to the growing number of assault weight battle armor units being introduced after the Word of Blake's Jihad. Built in Clan Wolf's factory on Tamar, the Warg was developed over the course of six years to finally start deployment in 3085. The Warg differs from Clan Wolf's past preference of mobility over firepower. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

Созданный на заводе клана Волка на Тамаре, «Варг» разрабатывался в течение шести лет и, наконец, поступил на службу в 3085 году. «Варг» отличается от прежнего предпочтения кланом Волка мобильности над огневой мощью. content.original: The Wraith battle armor was designed by the Rasalhague Dominion to support conventional infantry as well as perform surgical strikes. It is equipped with Basic Stealth armor to hide it from enemy probes, and its jump jets allow it to cover ninety meters in a single jump. The suit was introduced after extensive testing of the Rogue Bear battle armor, and is a direct descendant of that design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня «Призрак» была разработана Доминионом Расальхаг для поддержки обычной пехоты, а также для нанесения точечных ударов. Она оснащена базовой стелс-броней, скрывающей её от вражеских зондов, а прыжковые двигатели позволяют ей преодолевать девяносто метров за один прыжок. Костюм был представлен после обширных испытаний боевой брони Rogue Bear и является её прямым потомком. Особенность: Удачный дизайн Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Xiphos assault battle armor was developed by Irian Technologies specifically to create an infantry suit protected against artillery attacks, one of the most commonly-used tactics for defeating battle armor. Manufactured on Irian and Washburn for the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth (prior to the capture of Washburn by Clan Wolf) the Xiphos was manufactured in three common configurations and specifically incorporated a high-powered communications system to allow battlefield commanders to keep lines of communication open even in the face of hostile electronic countermeasures. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня «Ксифос» была разработана компанией Irian Technologies специально для создания пехотного костюма, защищающего от артиллерийских атак – одного из наиболее распространённых способов борьбы с боевой бронёй. «Ксифос», производившийся на Ириане и Уошберне для Содружества Марика-Стюарта (до захвата Уошберна кланом Волка), выпускался в трёх распространённых вариантах и, в частности, включал в себя мощную систему связи, позволяющую командирам поддерживать связь даже под воздействием вражеского электронного противодействия. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня «Ксифос» была разработана компанией Irian Technologies специально для создания пехотного костюма, защищающего от артиллерийских атак – одного из наиболее распространённых способов борьбы с боевой бронёй. «Ксифос», производившийся на Ириане и Уошберне для Содружества Марика-Стюарта (до захвата Уошберна кланом Волка), выпускался в трёх распространённых вариантах и, в частности, включал в себя мощную систему связи, позволяющую командирам поддерживать связь даже под воздействием вражеского электронного противодействия.

content.original: Intended as a broken terrain and urban combat spotter for Blakist Level IIs, the Yao Lien compensates for its relatively slow ground speed with a large number of improved jump jets, while ten tons of ferro-fibrous armor and ten double heat sinks give the design reasonable combat endurance. As with much captured and repurposed Blakist military hardware, a Guardian ECM suite and standard C3 slave are located where the Eidolon formerly mounted an improved C3 computer. A holdover from the Eidolon's grab-bag construction, the Yao Liens sole weaponry is a pair of snub-nose PPCs mounted in its right arm. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Formerly a Word of Blake design, the Yao Lien is a Capellan Confederation BattleMech based on the Blakists' Celestial series OmniMechs. The Yao Lien started life as the Eidolon, a mass-produced FrankenMech using excess parts from the Celestial OmniMechs. With House Liao discovering the existence of the top secret Liberty-based Martinson Armaments facility that built it, the CCAF interrupted Operation SCOUR's recapture of the planet to secure the plant for themselves, dismantling the facility and spiriting it away before anybody in Stone's Coalition realized it was even there. Initially using captured parts before switching to locally manufactured subcomponents, the rebuilt facility on Capella was turning out the now renamed 'Mech for the Confederation shortly after the recapture of Terra.

content.original: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The -X3 carried four ER Medium Lasers in the right arm and an ER PPC in the left arm, connected to a Targeting Computer. The true uniqueness of the design came in its use of Improved Jump Jets: the -X3 could jump up to 240 meters, which rivaled the jumping capability of any light 'Mech. This combination of heavy armor, speed and firepower made -the X3 the nightmare of any light or medium 'Mech and could outmaneuver any heavy or assault 'Mech. The -X3 mounted seventeen double heat sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Изготовленный на заводе Defiance в Кванжон-ни, Zeus X стал одновременно образцом совершенства в области производственной инженерии и инновационной высокотехнологичной платформой. X3 нёс четыре средних ER-лазера в правой руке и одну ER PPC в левой, соединённых с компьютером наведения. Уникальность конструкции заключалась в использовании улучшенных прыжковых двигателей: X3 мог прыгать до 240 метров, что превосходило прыжковые возможности даже лёгких мехов. Сочетание тяжёлой брони, скорости и огневой мощи делало X3 настоящим кошмаром для любого лёгкого или среднего меха и превосходило по манёвренности любой тяжёлый или штурмовой мех. X3 нёс семнадцать двойных охладителей. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.16 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Zou - or "Elephant" - is one of the third generation of battle armor suits to be designed and fielded by the Draconis Combine. The suit was originally developed to be the successor to the Kanazuchi, an assault suit. It wasn't until the Zou was further developed by being upgraded with command-and-control (C2) capabilities that it came into its own, providing Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery commanders a heavier ground unit when deployed on combined-arms operations, directing troops, calling in long-range fire and artillery. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Зоу», или «Слон», — один из представителей третьего поколения боевых доспехов, разработанных и принятых на вооружение Синдикатом Дракона. Изначально этот костюм разрабатывался как преемник штурмового костюма «Канадзучи». Только после дальнейшего усовершенствования, в результате которого «Зоу» был модернизирован и получил функции командования и управления (C2), он обрёл свою окончательную форму, предоставляя командирам мобилизованных солдат Синдиката Дракона возможности управления войсками, вызова дальнобойного огня и артиллерии. Особенность: Intuitive Controls Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.892 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Skadi is a Fast Attack VTOL. It can reach a top speed of 162 km/h, and is protected by four and a half tons of Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The Skadi was originally designed by Clan Jade Falcon, but the main factory fell to the Lyran Commonwealth. For the next few decades, the Commonwealth sold the Skadi to any interested party. The combination of good protection, high speed, and a heavy gun proved to be very popular, and the Skadi was exported across the Inner Sphere. The Falcons later recaptured the facility and have restricted the Skadi to their own forces. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. content.content: «Скади» — это быстрый боевой VTOL. Он способен развивать максимальную скорость 162 км/ч и защищён четырьмя с половиной тоннами клановой ферроволоконной брони. Изначально «Скади» был разработан кланом Нефритового Сокола, но позже основные производственные мощности перешли к Лиранскому Содружеству. В течение следующих нескольких десятилетий Содружество продавало «Скади» всем желающим. Сочетание хорошей защиты, высокой скорости и мощного орудия оказалось очень популярным, и «Скади» экспортировался по всей Внутренней Сфере. Позже Соколы вернули себе завод и ограничили использование «Скади» только для своих войск. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунных биомах. content.original: The Amazon battle armor was created by the Magistracy of Canopus. Based on the standard Inner Sphere battle armor, the Amazon uses advanced armor to increase protection and provides a jump capability of 90 meters. This allows Amazon-equipped troops to clear obstacles that would stop other battle armor units. The Amazon is used by both the Magistracy and the Capellan Confederation. Amazons deployed by the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces faced Cavalier battle armor and turned in a better performance. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Buraq is a Clan medium-weight Quad battle armor, which was designed by Clan Hell's Horses during the early thirty-second century. The horselike Buraq was named for the mystical steed from ancient times, and like its mystical namesake, the battle armor is noted for its high ground speed. Typically, Clan Hell's Horses have used full Stars consisting of different variants of the battle armor. These Buraq Stars work as a team in their appointed mission assignments. They've been utilized on the Horses' Periphery borders to help scout and pin down pirates terrorizing their worlds. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Бурак» — это клановая боевая броня среднего веса, разработанная кланом Адских Лошадей в начале 32-го века. «Бурак», похожий на коня, получил своё название в честь таинственного скакуна из древности, и, подобно своему мистическому тёзке, этот боевой доспех отличается высокой скоростью передвижения по земле. Обычно, клан Адских Лошадей использует целые звёзды, полностью состоящие из различных вариантов этой боевой брони. Звёзды из «Бураков» работают в команде, выполняя поставленные задачи. Их использовали на границах Периферии Лошадей для разведки и пресечения пиратов, терроризирующих их миры. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Clan Battle Armor is based on the Elemental suit, its visual aesthetic that shows that the Clan's contact with the Draconis Combine was already rubbing off on them. Though the design has a slow ground speed, the designers used the jump booster pioneered on the Gray Death Scout armor to rocket it up to one hundred twenty meters at a time. This necessitated a slight reduction in armor and a reworking of the weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.928 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Несмотря на низкую наземную скорость, разработчики использовали прыжковый ускоритель, впервые разработанный на броне Gray Death Scout, чтобы поднять его на высоту до ста двадцати метров. Это потребовало небольшого уменьшения толщины брони и переделки вооружения. content.original: Introduced by Clan Ghost Bear, the Constable Pacification Suit was designed to help the Ghost Bear Dominion maintain order among its Inner Sphere-born citizenry. The Ghost Bear Watch originally developed it to help them against a Rasalhagian terrorist group known as the Motstånd. The suit's array of weapons and equipment options allowed the Watch to handle the terrorists while not exposing their civilian population to harm with a fully militarized police force. The suit's first usage was mishandled by the Ghost Bear Watch. The suit's sale to civilian police and other organizations allowed the Watch to be able develop less military tactics. The suit has since been spread to other Clans and the Draconis Combine's paramilitary organizations such as the Internal Security Force and the Civilian Guidance Corps. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Представленный кланом Призрачного Медведя, костюм для подавления беспорядков Constable был разработан, чтобы помочь Доминиону Призрачного Медведя поддерживать порядок среди своих граждан, родившихся во Внутренней Сфере. Дозор Призрачного Медведя изначально разработал его для борьбы с расальхагской террористической группировкой, известной как Motstånd. Разнообразие оружия и снаряжения костюма позволяло Дозору справляться с террористами, не подвергая гражданское население опасности. Первое применение костюма было неудачным для Дозора. Продажа костюма гражданской полиции и другим организациям позволила Дозору сбросить с себя часть нагрузки по наведению порядка. С тех пор костюм был распространен среди других кланов и военизированных организаций Синдиката Дракона, таких как Силы внутренней безопасности и Корпус гражданского руководства. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.9475 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Dragoon was conceived as a heavier, more versatile battlesuit for Wolf’s Dragoons’ Seventh Kommando. The Dragoon offers more protection and flexibility than common infiltration suits. This suit was originally designed to give combat engineers a degree of battlefield protection for high-risk intrusion operations, and to incorporate the ease of movement found in much lighter suits. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Драгун» был задуман как более тяжёлый и универсальный боевой костюм для Seventh Kommando Волчьих Драгун. «Драгун» обеспечивает большую защиту и гибкость, чем обычные инфильтрационные костюмы. Изначально этот костюм был разработан для обеспечения боевых инженеров необходимой защитой на поле боя во время высокорискованных операций по проникновению, а также для обеспечения лёгкости движений, присущей гораздо более лёгким костюмам. content.original: Despite the standard Elemental's all-around utility, Clan Hell's Horses sought to enhance their Elementals mobility. The result of their work, Elemental II, discards Jump Jets and SRM pack in favor of battle armor myomer booster. The design didn't gain popularity and saw no interest from other clans, and Elemental II remains in limited service in Hell's Horses garrisons. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.prevOriginal: Despite the standard Elemental's all-around utility, Clan Hell's Horses sought to enhance their Elementals mobility. content.content: Несмотря на универсальность стандартного «Элементала», клан Адских Лошадей стремился повысить мобильность своих «Элементалов». Результатом их работы стал «Элементал II», отказавшийся от прыжковых двигателей и SRM в пользу миомерного усилителя боевой брони. Конструкция не снискала популярности и не вызвала интереса у других кланов, и «Элементал II» до сих пор ограниченно эксплуатируется лишь в гарнизонах Адских Лошадей. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Fenrir II Assault Battle Armor may have allegedly originated as the result of a bet between Archon Adam Steiner and Duke Vedet Brewer of Hesperus II, but Duke Brewer's vision of "a monstrous wolf straight from the nightmares of our ancestors" proved to be one of the most popular battle suits on the market after its introduction to service in 3119. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
content.prevOriginal: The Fenrir II Assault Battle Armor may have allegedly originated as the result of a bet between Archon Adam Steiner and Duke Vedet Brewer of Hesperus II, but Duke Brewer's vision of "a monstrous wolf straight from the nightmares of our ancestors" proved to be one of the most popular battle suits on the market after its introduction to service in 3119. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня Fenrir II по слухам возникла в результате пари между архонтом Адамом Штайнером и герцогом Ведетом Брюером из Гесперуса II, и после появления в 3119 году на вооружении герцога Брюера «гигантского волка прямо из страшилок наших предков» он оказался одним из самых популярных боевых костюмов на рынке. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: As a heavy combat suit, the Fusilier combined aspects of the Grenadier and Sea Fox, and was designed to serve as a line unit alongside other similar suits. Because it was so slow-moving, the Fusilier mounted a Jump Booster to increase its mobility. Whereas other battlesuits in service to the AFFS typically earned a reputation based around their distinguishing characteristics, the best description of the Fusilier is "solid". Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Будучи тяжёлым боевым костюмом, «Фузилер» сочетал в себе особенности «Гренадера» и «Морского лиса» и был разработан для использования в качестве рядового юнита наряду с другими подобными костюмами. Из-за своей медлительности «Фузилера» оснастили прыжковым ускорителем. Боевые костюмы, состоявшие на вооружении ФедСолнц, обычно получали репутацию, основанную на их отличительных характеристиках, и лучшее описание «Фузилера» — «надёжный». Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Jihad-era -5R is known for its durability, and the -7R pushes that feature even further. Sluggish on the ground, it relies on its enhanced jump capacity for mobility; its Triple-Strength Myomer is useful for maintaining speed on long marches, but difficult to keep active in combat due to the -7R's limited heat-control options. Nonetheless, the 'Mech's potent short-range punch and incredibly stout hide make it an excellent urban combatant and line-holder—and no small prize for pirates and thieves. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was the successor to the Infiltrator Mk. I, and while intended to fill a range of battlefield roles, it performed best as a scout or skirmisher. Nicknamed the Quokka, the Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was configured to be highly mobile and incorporated a Parafoil to allow it to make precise aerial drops. The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was capable of making swarm and leg attacks as well as being able to travel by mechanized transport. Each suit had a Basic Manipulator mounted on each arm and had more than a third of a ton of basic stealth armor for protection. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.content: Инфильтрационный костюм «Серая смерть» был преемником Infiltrator Mk. I и, хотя и предназначался для выполнения различных боевых задач, лучше всего он проявлял себя в качестве разведчика или стрелка. Gray Death Infiltrator Suit, получивший прозвище «Квокка», был сконфигурирован для высокой мобильности и включал в себя параплан для точного десантирования с воздуха. Gray Death был способен совершать роевые атаки и атаки ногами, а также перевозиться на транспорте. Каждый костюм имел базовый манипулятор в каждой руке, и имел более трети тонны базовой стелс-брони для защиты. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was the successor to the Infiltrator Mk. I, and while intended to fill a range of battlefield roles, it performed best as a scout or skirmisher. Nicknamed the Quokka, the Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was configured to be highly mobile and incorporated a Parafoil to allow it to make precise aerial drops. The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was capable of making swarm and leg attacks as well as being able to travel by mechanized transport. Each suit had a Basic Manipulator mounted on each arm and had more than a third of a ton of basic stealth armor for protection. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Designed in 3091 as an upgrade package for surviving HBK-4K models, the Hunchback HBK-6K swaps the original 14 SHS for 12 DHS. The newly created weight is used to install a C3 Slave and add the Apollo FCS to the MRM-40. Lastly the Medium Lasers are replaced with ER models. Intended to be finished by the early 32nd century, the upgrade package is part of an effort by House Kurita to shift older and less capable machines to militia units and allow frontline units to be rearmed with more advanced equipment. content.original: The Infiltrator Mk. II is a battle armor suit designed as a replacement for the earlier Infiltrator Mk. I. With better armament and protection than its predecessor, the Mk. II was superior in all ways except cost. A battle armor-scale Magshot rifle provides firepower while an anti-infantry SMG provides light defense. A suite of stealth armor keeps the suit protected on the field. The only serious downside is the slow ground speed of the Mk. II, though jump jets help keep the suit semi-mobile. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Инфильтратор Mk II» - это боевая броня, разработанная в качестве замены более ранней модели Infiltrator Mk I. Обладая лучшим вооружением и защитой, Mk II превзошёл своего предшественника по всем параметрам, кроме стоимости. Боевая винтовка Magshot обеспечивает огневую мощь, а противопехотный SMG - легкую защиту. Защиту на поле боя обеспечивает и комплект стелс-брони. Единственным серьезным недостатком Mk II является низкая скорость передвижения по земле, хотя прыжковые двигатели позволяют поддерживать какую-никакую мобильность. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Ironhold Assault Battle Armor was developed by Clan Jade Falcon during the Jihad. The roots of the Ironhold go back to development of the Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle in 3069. After the success of that weapon, a new project codenamed Project Ferrum was started to develop a new suit of battle armor with the support of the Elemental Trinary of 3rd Falcon Talon Cluster. The Ironhold is noted for being more mobile than typical Clan Assault Armor, where it can employ its Jump Jets and give itself better tactical advantage over its opponents. content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня «Айронхолд» была разработана кланом Нефритового Сокола во время Джихада. История «Айронхолда» восходит к разработке противопехотной винтовки Гаусса в 3069 году. После успеха этого оружия был запущен новый проект под кодовым названием «Феррум» по разработке нового боевого доспеха при поддержке тринария «Элемнталов» 3-го кластера Когтей Сокола. «Айронхолд» отличается большей мобильностью, чем типичная штурмовая клановая броня, что позволяет ему использовать прыжковые двигатели и получать большее тактическое преимущество над противниками. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.96 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Kopis battle armor was designed by StarCorps Industries as an assault unit. Slow but heavily armed, the Kopis can remain on the battlefield supporting friendly units for a long time. The advanced armor used by the Kopis designers allows it to stand up to most weaponry, shrugging off anything short of a PPC or AC/10 hit. The low top speed is mitigated through the use of VTOL transportation for offensive operations, while smart commanders use the Kopis as a defense unit for cities or other tight terrain. In those restricted environments the low top speed isn't a factor. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Kopis была разработана компанией StarCorps Industries как штурмовой юнит. Медленный, но хорошо вооружённый, Kopis может долгое время оставаться на поле боя, поддерживая дружественные юниты. Продвинутая броня, использованная конструкторами Kopis, позволяет ему противостоять большинству видов вооружения, за исключением попаданий из PPC или AC/10. Низкая максимальная скорость компенсируется использованием вертикального взлёта и посадки (VTOL) в наступательных операциях, в то время как опытные командиры используют Kopis в качестве оборонительного юнита в городах или других труднодоступных местах. В таких ограниченных условиях низкая максимальная скорость не имеет значения. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Leonidas battle armor was a product of Etna Foundries and was intended to plug a capability gap in the armed forces of the Duchy of Oriente, a gap created by scarcity of the older Achileus stealth suit. The Leonidas suit is highly configurable, capable of being reconfigured for various battlefield missions including providing positional information, calling in artillery strikes, waging counterinsurgency warfare and conducting ambushes; the various roles are made possible through the different weapons and equipment loadouts available via the Modular Weapon Mount. Quirk: Information Gatherer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня «Леонид» была разработана компанией Etna Foundries и должна была восполнить пробел в вооруженных силах герцогства Ориенте, возникший из-за нехватки более старого стелс-костюма «Ахиллес». Костюм Leonidas обладает высокой степенью гибкости и может быть перенастроен для выполнения различных задач на поле боя, включая предоставление информации о местоположении, нанесение артиллерийских ударов, ведение противоповстанческой войны и организацию засад; различные роли возможны благодаря различным вариантам вооружения и снаряжения, доступным через модульное крепление оружия. Особенность: Information Gatherer Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Such an extensive modification to the point it was an entirely different design, the MNL-3W was a complete rebuild utilizing Clan technology. Built on a Clan-grade Endo Steel chassis, powered by a Clan 350-rated XL fusion engine and clad in ten tons of Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor backed by an ECM suite, the 3W saved more weight while boasting superior durability to the Inner Sphere tech model. The weight saved allowed the replacement of the standard weaponry with a pair of full Clan-grade Gauss rifles and swapped the IS ER Mediums for more deadly Clan models. The MNL-3W also had far superior endurance in the field thanks to the four tons of Gauss reloads, two dedicated for each cannon, carried in automatically CASE equipped bays and two additional heat sinks. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
content.prevOriginal:
The Mangonel MNL-3L was literally built around the massive torso bay which contained its primary weapons, a pair of Light Gauss Rifles, which when combined with its high speed allowed the 'Mech to dance around its targets at range. Unfortunately the single ton of reloads carried was adequate only for Clan Trials, while the pair of ER Medium Lasers mounted in each arm made it an effective close-ranged combatant only as long as its minimal armor held out. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
content.content: Such an extensive modification to the point it was an entirely different design, the MNL-3W was a complete rebuild utilizing Clan technology. Built on a Clan-grade Endo Steel chassis, powered by a Clan 350-rated XL fusion engine and clad in ten tons of Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor backed by an ECM suite, the 3W saved more weight while boasting superior durability to the Inner Sphere tech model. The weight saved allowed the replacement of the standard weaponry with a pair of full Clan-grade Gauss rifles and swapped the IS ER Mediums for more deadly Clan models. The MNL-3W also had far superior endurance in the field thanks to the four tons of Gauss reloads, two dedicated for each cannon, carried in automatically CASE equipped bays and two additional heat sinks. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.16 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Designed by the Marian Hegemony using the most cutting-edge gear available to them, the Marauder Battle Armor is patterned after the venerable Marauder BattleMech. Armed with a pair of Support PPCs and a Light Recoilless Rifle, the Marauder BA is one of the most heavily armed BA in existence. The Marians deploy them in squads of five called a contubernium and the suits are designed for that kind of larger deployment. While not particularly well armored, their extreme firepower load for battle armor makes them deadly on the field. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.895 Can mount any unit, can not melee, can not swarm.

Вооружённая парой PPC и лёгким безоткатным ружьём, боевая броня «Мародер» является одной из самых вооружённых моделей боевой брони среди существующих. Марианцы используют их отрядами по пять человек, называемыми контуберниумом. Несмотря на не слишком прочную броню, их высокая огневая мощь делает их смертельно опасными на поле боя. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.895 Может крепиться на любом юните, не может рукопашную, не может swarm-атаку.

content.original: Designed with a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies, the MGL-T1's noted speed comes from its 350 XL engine. This powerful Clan-tech engine allowed the swift 'Mech to outpace most machines on the battlefield with a top speed of 118.8 km/h. Its endo steel hull is protected by 10.5 tons of reactive armor, giving it additional protection from area-effect weapons, penetrating weapons, and missile fire. The Mongrel' T1 model weaponry includes three Clan ER medium lasers fitted to its right torso. Backing up these up is an AC/5, the autocannon is supplied with 20 rounds of ammunition found in its one-ton ammunition bin. The Mongrel has a retractable blade mounted in its right arm actuator, in case the pilot needs to engage in melee combat. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original: The Night Wolf has a wide range of weaponry, which includes a Heavy Large Laser in the right torso and an ER medium laser in its right arm. To alleviate the targeting issues caused by the Heavy Laser, the 'Mech has been fitted with a Targeting Computer. For ranged attacks, the 'Mech utilizes a pair of ATM 9 Launchers mounted in both of the 'Mechs' arms. To help deal with the advent of increased conventional vehicles and infantry forces, the 'Mechs left arm is fitted with a Plasma Cannon. As a final defensive precaution, an anti-missile system is situated on the 'Mech's head to take down incoming missile fire. content.original: The Ogre heavy battle armor has a physically intimidating appearance, largely due to the twin Heavy Battle Claws used as weapons and Tvastar's choice to use an unusually wide frame for the suit. Despite that appearance, the Ogre isn't well-suited to fighting conventional infantry, but the heavy armor and weapons mounted on the Ogre allows it to attack enemy armor, and actions in certain early battles saw the Ogre gain a reputation for tearing tanks in half - a reputation that was rather fanciful, but did serve to enhance the Ogre's reputation. The Ogre has since been exported outside the Regulan Fiefs by Tvastar, with the Duchy of Andurien and the Lyran Commonwealth both ordering large production runs. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Тяжёлая боевая броня «Огр» имеет физически устрашающий вид, в основном из-за пары тяжёлых боевых когтей, используемых в качестве оружия, и решения Tvastar использовать необычно широкую раму для костюма. Несмотря на этот внешний вид, «Огр» не очень хорошо подходит для сражения с обычной пехотой, но тяжёлая броня и оружие позволяют ему атаковать вражескую бронетехнику, а его действия в некоторых ранних сражениях дали ему репутацию того, кто «разрывает танки пополам». С тех пор Tvastar экспортировал «Огр» за пределы Regulan Fiefs, причём Герцогство Андуриен и Лиранское Содружество заказали крупные партии. Особенность: Отвлекающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.892 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: To minimize logistical concerns, the Penthesilea uses several energy weapons. An ER PPC and Light PPC harass an enemy at longer ranges, while the LB 10-X AC can fire solid shot to penetrate armor or use cluster rounds to capitalize on armor breaches caused by the other weapons. When the range drops, the trio of ER Medium Lasers mounted in the center torso can easily carve up an opponent. Though the use of energy weapons does ease logistical concerns, the MechWarrior piloting a Penthesilea must monitor the heat closely, as the thirteen double heat sinks installed in the chassis are barely enough to dissipate the heat generated by the energy weapons, and careless weapon fire can quickly overwhelm the cooling system. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: This variant of the Penthesilea was created as a test of Actuator Enhancement Systems. Its top speed is reduced to 54 km/h thanks to a smaller compact engine, but it retains the ninety meter jump radius of its forbearers. Fitted with a variety of weapons systems, this Penthesilea PEN-3H carries a Bombast Laser and three Medium Lasers in the right arm; the left arm carries a Medium VSP Laser and Light AC/5. Both arms are equipped with AES. Four Light Machine Guns are carried as well: One in the right torso, while three more are carried in the center torso in a Machine Gun Array. Ammunition for the machine guns and Light AC/5 is stored in the left torso in a CASE II protected bay. Fourteen tons of Light Ferro-Fibrous armor protects the 3H. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. The Purifier Terra uses a Modular Weapon Mount to provide a variety of weapons options. The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.868 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Основное отличие от стандартного костюма Purifier заключается в отсутствии адаптивной брони и её замене на стандартную клановую, идентичной той, что используется в костюме «Элементалов». Purifier Terra использует модульное оружейное крепление (MWM), предоставляющее широкий выбор оружия. Коалиция столкнулась с вариантами, оснащёнными клановым малым ER-лазером, малым импульсным лазером и бронебойной винтовкой Гаусса. Другие варианты использовали среднюю безоткатную винтовку. Кроме того, можно было нести любое снаряжение, помещающееся в 400-килограммовое MWM. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.868 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Квиринус», производимый на Терре компанией StarCorp Industries, — это средний боевой доспех конца 31-го века, изначально выпускавшийся для широкой продажи. Разработанный как основной боевой доспех в первые годы эры Республики, «Квиринус» изначально продавался раздробленной Лиге Свободных Миров. Хотя он не такой броский, как многие его современники, этот костюм известен своей надёжностью и эффективностью в полевых условиях. Этот боевой доспех впоследствии попал в руки наёмных отрядов, а также подразделений Республики Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Designed by the Marian Hegemony using the most cutting-edge gear available to them. The Marian Hegemony soon began marketing the suit for sale to the open market to help bolster the Hegemony's coffers. The Marians deploy them in squads of five called a contubernium and the suits are designed for that kind of larger deployment. While not particularly well armed, the Ravager has extensive armor coverage, making them extremely durable on the battlefield. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Юнит разработан Марианской Гегемонией с использованием самого современного оборудования, доступного им. Гегемония вскоре начала продавать костюм на открытом рынке, чтобы пополнить свою казну. Марианцы используют их отрядами по пять человек, называемыми контуберниумом. Несмотря на не слишком хорошее вооружение, «Опустошитель» имеет мощную броню, что делает его чрезвычайно живучим на поле боя. content.original: First known to have been deployed in 3073, the Rogue Bear is a battle armor design produced by Clan Ghost Bear. Initially confused for the Golem, the Rogue Bear is a heavy battlesuit that was initially deployed with garrison units, especially those of the KungsArmé who were incorporated into the Ghost Bear touman. The Rogue Bear can jump up to sixty meters at a time. It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle. The battlesuit uses mostly standard components with no disposable weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Rogue Bear, разработанная кланом Призрачного Медведя, впервые появившаяся в 3073 году. Первоначально ошибочно принятый за «Голема», «Бродячий Медведь» – тяжёлый боевой костюм, изначально использовавшийся вместе с гарнизонными юнитами, особенно с KungsArmé, входившими в состав тумена Призрачного Медведя. Rogue Bear может прыгать до 60 метров. Он защищён броней, достаточной, чтобы остановить выстрел из пушки Гаусса. Боевой костюм состоит в основном из стандартных компонентов и не имеет одноразового вооружения. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.935 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Salamander the design incorporates fire-based weapons; its primary armaments being a pair of Flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot short-range missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.928 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

Это делает «Саламандру» особенно эффективной против пехоты и боевой техники, хотя это не значит, что она менее устрашающа и для мехвоинов: мало кто захочет попасться на прицел «Саламандре». Особенность: Fire Demon Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.928 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: This is an updated version of the MN1-K that has been rebuilt using an IndustrialMech production line. It keeps the same weapons configuration as the MN1-D but replaces the primitive engine, primitive armor, and primitive cockpit with more modern upgrades. It's protected by heavy industrial armor, adds an ejection seat so the pilot can escape, increases the amount of single heat sinks to 18, and upgrades the engine to a 200 fusion engine. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.77

content.original: The Sea Fox amphibious battle armor is a niche unit, but one that excels within that niche; intended to operate underwater and equipped with a Clantech Underwater Maneuvering Unit capable of moving the suit at the same speed in shallow water as it could move on land, the Sea Fox is an excellent infiltrator and ambush fighter, capable of excelling in urban operations in areas where waterways are available for access. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня-амфибия Sea Fox — это узкоспециализированный юнит, который предназначен для действий под водой и оснащен клановым подводным маневровым модулем, позволяющим передвигаться в костюме по мелководью с той же скоростью, что и по суше. Sea Fox является превосходным средством проникновения и засадного боя, способным преуспеть в городских операциях в районах с доступом к воде. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. This variant has a head mounted Guardian ECM Suite that disrupts enemy electronic systems. An ER Large Laser and LRM-10 provide long range firepower, and close combat is possible via the Heavy Medium Laser and Micro Pulse Laser mounted in each arm. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.content: «Шэдоу Хок IIC» — клановый боевой мех второй линии, созданный на базе Shadow Hawk, впервые представленного Звездной Лигой. Этот вариант оснащен модулем Guardian ECM в голове, который подавляет работу электронных систем противника. Большой ER-лазер и LRM-10 обеспечивают дальнобойную огневую мощь, а тяжёлый средний лазер и микроимпульсный лазер, установленные в каждой руке, позволяют вести ближний бой. Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.09

content.original: The Sheng Long is a Quad type Heavy Class Battle Armor produced for both the Capellan Confederation and its close-allies in the Magistracy of Canopus. Designed with speed and firepower in mind, the Sheng Long employs its modular turret and stealth to out maneuver and assist in ambushing of enemy combat units. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

Designed with speed and firepower in mind, the Sheng Long employs its modular turret and stealth to out maneuver and assist in ambushing of enemy combat units. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.original: To perform its role as a main line 'Mech the Shen Yi is armed with a pair of 20-Tube Medium Range Missile Launchers with four tons of ammunition in the center, left, and right torsos. These give it a respectable punch at medium to close ranges. For sparring with other units at long range the Shen Yi is armed with an ER Large Laser, mounted in the right arm with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers to give it some protection at close range. The 'Mech is protected by 13 tons of Stealth Armor, which is linked to its Guardian ECM Suite in the left arm. To manage its heat load, the 'Mech has been provided with fourteen Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Shockwave is geared primarily for long-range attacks. The combination of its Artemis IV FCS-enhanced LRM-10 launcher and ER large laser provide effective firepower at long range, supplemented by an RAC/5 for devastating firepower should opposing units close in. The only drawback to this weapon configuration is the 'Mech's heavy reliance on ammunition; if the one ton ammo bays for each weapon run dry, the Shockwave is left with only a single laser to defend itself. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't designed for frontline combat, and the designation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional unarmored sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly armored and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle armor. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Spectre Battle Armor was developed and fielded by Protectorate Arms Conglomerate. It has got its name from the stealth armor that protects it. This armor, while good at hiding it from enemy sensors, fares very poorly when under fire. The Spectre is pretty quick for a humanoid Battle Armor, but its Mechanical Jump Booster is not a true replacement for regular Jump Jets. Magnetic clamps adapted from the Fa Shih Battle Armor allow the Spectre to be carried into battle. While its armament gives it better combat ability than some early stealth suits, it still cannot stand up to larger battle armor like the Elemental or Kanazuchi. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня «Спектр» была разработана и принята на вооружение компанией Protectorate Arms Conglomerate. Свое название броня получила от защищающей её стелс-брони. Эта броня, хотя и хорошо скрывает от вражеских сенсоров, очень плохо себя ведет под огнем. «Спектр» довольно быстр для боевой брони гуманоидного типа, но его механический прыжковый ускоритель не является полноценной заменой обычным прыжковым двигателям. Магнитные зажимы, адаптированные от боевой брони Fa Shih, позволяют доставить «Спектра» на поле боя. Хотя его вооружение обеспечивает ему лучшие боевые возможности, чем некоторые ранние стелс-костюмы, он все еще не может противостоять более крупной боевой броне, такой как «Элементал» или «Канадзучи». Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Stormbird was commissioned by Clan Jade Falcon and intended as a bridge between the available Elemental and Ironhold battlesuits, being the result of collaboration between Falcon resources and Clan Snow Raven science. The proposed anti-infantry role for the Stormbird interested the Snow Ravens, who desired a similar-sized suit with a similar operational profile. The final result was not the versatile platform expected by the Falcons, with the design closely matching the already available Salamander. For the Snow Ravens however, the Stormbird proved to be an immense success providing them with fire-resistant armor that had thus far proved impossible to produce. Quirk: Inspiring Appearance Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount any unit, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Stormbird был заказан кланом Нефритового Сокола и задумывался как связующее звено между уже имеющимися боевыми костюмами «Элементал» и «Айронхолд», став результатом объединения ресурсов клана Сокола и учёных Снежного Ворона. Предполагаемая противопехотная роль Stormbird заинтересовала Снежных Воронов, которым требовался костюм схожего размера и с аналогичными характеристиками. Конечный результат не стал универсальной платформой, на которую рассчитывали Соколы, поскольку конструкция была очень похожа на уже существующую «Саламандру». Однако для Снежных Воронов Stormbird оказалась огромным успехом, обеспечив их огнестойкой броней, которую до сих пор было невозможно изготовить. Особенность: Вдохновляющий Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.935 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Introduced into service in 3123, the Taranis is a Heavy Class battle armor first created for the Armed Forces of the Republic of the Sphere. Built on Terra, the heavyweight suit was designed to work closely with the RAF's Combined Arms formations, bringing its considerable toughness and firepower to bear. The battle armor is used in a range of roles from close combat to providing defense against incoming enemies. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: An experimental variant intended for command and training, developed by the Draconis Combine. The TFT-C3 variant removes the light Gauss rifle for a Cockpit Command Console and a C3 command unit, the ER small laser for an ER medium laser, and then adds a medium X-pulse laser instead of the Streak SRM-4. The variant also trades the A9's jump jets for mechanical jump boosters for each leg. All of these changes have been made possible by replacing the standard Fusion engine of the A9 variant with a light fusion engine. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

To make room for the turret, this Thunder Fox uses a torso-mounted cockpit. To make room for the torso cockpit, it uses a compact gyro and a larger XXL engine allows it walk at 58 km/h while reaching a top speed of 74 km/h. It also has five standard jump jets, allowing it to cover 150 meters in a single jump. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Produced by Hilltopper Engineering (a spin off of the mercenary command Holt's Hilltoppers) for the Fronc Reaches' Colonial Marshals the TinStar came as a shock both to the Fronc Reaches' neighbors and the local pirate groups when it was introduced in 3086. The initial suit contained a mixture of Clan and Inner Sphere technology that, while being powerful, was regarded as undesirable by the Marshals due to its reliance on outside suppliers. Hilltopper Engineering would accommodate the Marshals request for a more production friendly variant which would lead to the first mass production line outside of vehicles for the Fronc Reaches at the time. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Торнадо» — это легкая боевая броня, созданная КомСтаром в конце XXIX века для обеспечения дополнительной защиты юнитов специального назначения. Tornado основан на костюме Nighthawk от СОЗЛ, который, хотя КомСтар и приобрели несколько экземпляров, в то время не могли производить. Он включает в себя стелс-броню и адаптивную систему камуфляжа, которая имитирует эффект комбинированного камуфляжного/инфракрасного/электронного противодействия Sneak Suit, скрывая Tornado от всех типов датчиков. Броня также достаточно хороша, чтобы остановить огонь из стрелкового оружия и даже тяжелого оружия, такого как огнемет, и не дать ему повредить носителя. Особенность: Power Armor Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.8832 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The -K7R variant of the Trebuchet removes all the standard weaponry, the engine, and the skeleton, replacing them with a Light Engine, Endo Steel skeleton, and a new weapons array. Intended for short range combat, the TBT-K7R carries a pair of ER medium lasers, a pair of ER Flamers, a Streak SRM-6, and a Chain Whip. What makes it most deadly however, is the BattleMech Taser in the left arm. With this weapon the Trebuchet can capture an enemy 'Mech. The Trebuchet also carries Triple Strength Myomer, allowing it to pin 'Mechs as heavy as an Atlas. Ten and a half tons of armor and a 150 meter jump range protect the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The -XK7 is a refit of the classical Trebuchet done by the Taurian Concordat. It uses ten double heat sinks and an XL engine for power. Several experimental systems have been added. A Chain Whip allows the 'Mech to pin units close to the Trebuchet. To capitalize on this, the traditional weapons have been replaced with a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers, an ER medium laser, ER Flamer, and a medium pulse laser. For additional protection, this Trebuchet carries Modular Armor on the front of each torso and a Small Shield on the left arm. Triple Strength Myomer maximizes the physical damage it can cause, and pins heavy and assault 'Mechs in place with the Chain Whip. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: The suite of offensive weaponry carried by the Ursa is divided between the left and right torsos. On each side are a brace of Medium X-Pulse Laser, popular with those who regularly fought the Clans; mounted into the right torso is a Rotary AC/2 supplied with a ton of ammunition, while mounted into the left torso is an ER PPC. The MASC system built into the Ursa in combination with the 325 XL fusion engine that powers the 'Mech results in a ferocious quadrupedal design that can run at speeds of over 100 km/h; this, combined with the gyro and twelve and a half tons of armor meant that the Ursa can not only survive full-speed collisions but can do so without falling or the pilot losing control. This led to MechWarriors nicknamed the Ursa 'the Rhino' because of the brutal charges it can perform. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Created in the post-Jihad era, the Warg assault battle armor was Clan Wolf's response to the growing number of assault weight battle armor units being introduced after the Word of Blake's Jihad. Built in Clan Wolf's factory on Tamar, the Warg was developed over the course of six years to finally start deployment in 3085. The Warg differs from Clan Wolf's past preference of mobility over firepower. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Созданная в эпоху после Джихада, штурмовая боевая броня «Варг» стала ответом клана Волка на растущее число видов штурмовой боевой брони, вводимой после Джихада Блейка. Созданный на заводе клана Волка на Тамаре, «Варг» разрабатывался в течение шести лет и, наконец, поступил на службу в 3085 году. «Варг» отличается от прежнего предпочтения кланом Волка мобильности над огневой мощью. Особенность: Удачный дизайн Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.96 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Wraith battle armor was designed by the Rasalhague Dominion to support conventional infantry as well as perform surgical strikes. It is equipped with Basic Stealth armor to hide it from enemy probes, and its jump jets allow it to cover ninety meters in a single jump. The suit was introduced after extensive testing of the Rogue Bear battle armor, and is a direct descendant of that design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня «Призрак» была разработана Доминионом Расальхаг для поддержки обычной пехоты, а также для нанесения точечных ударов. Она оснащена базовой стелс-броней, скрывающей её от вражеских зондов, а прыжковые двигатели позволяют ей преодолевать девяносто метров за один прыжок. Костюм был представлен после обширных испытаний боевой брони Rogue Bear и является её прямым потомком. content.original: The Xiphos assault battle armor was developed by Irian Technologies specifically to create an infantry suit protected against artillery attacks, one of the most commonly-used tactics for defeating battle armor. Manufactured on Irian and Washburn for the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth (prior to the capture of Washburn by Clan Wolf) the Xiphos was manufactured in three common configurations and specifically incorporated a high-powered communications system to allow battlefield commanders to keep lines of communication open even in the face of hostile electronic countermeasures. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня «Ксифос» была разработана компанией Irian Technologies специально для создания пехотного костюма, защищающего от артиллерийских атак – одного из наиболее распространённых способов борьбы с боевой бронёй. «Ксифос», производившийся на Ириане и Уошберне для Содружества Марика-Стюарта (до захвата Уошберна кланом Волка), выпускался в трёх распространённых вариантах и, в частности, включал в себя мощную систему связи, позволяющую командирам поддерживать связь даже под воздействием вражеского электронного противодействия. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Intended as a broken terrain and urban combat spotter for Blakist Level IIs, the Yao Lien compensates for its relatively slow ground speed with a large number of improved jump jets, while ten tons of ferro-fibrous armor and ten double heat sinks give the design reasonable combat endurance. As with much captured and repurposed Blakist military hardware, a Guardian ECM suite and standard C3 slave are located where the Eidolon formerly mounted an improved C3 computer. A holdover from the Eidolon's grab-bag construction, the Yao Liens sole weaponry is a pair of snub-nose PPCs mounted in its right arm. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The -X3 carried four ER Medium Lasers in the right arm and an ER PPC in the left arm, connected to a Targeting Computer. The true uniqueness of the design came in its use of Improved Jump Jets: the -X3 could jump up to 240 meters, which rivaled the jumping capability of any light 'Mech. This combination of heavy armor, speed and firepower made -the X3 the nightmare of any light or medium 'Mech and could outmaneuver any heavy or assault 'Mech. The -X3 mounted seventeen double heat sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Изготовленный на заводе Defiance в Кванжон-ни, Zeus X стал одновременно образцом совершенства в области производственной инженерии и инновационной высокотехнологичной платформой. X3 нёс четыре средних ER-лазера в правой руке и одну ER PPC в левой, соединённых с компьютером наведения. Уникальность конструкции заключалась в использовании улучшенных прыжковых двигателей: X3 мог прыгать до 240 метров, что превосходило прыжковые возможности даже лёгких мехов. Сочетание тяжёлой брони, скорости и огневой мощи делало X3 настоящим кошмаром для любого лёгкого или среднего меха и превосходило по манёвренности любой тяжёлый или штурмовой мех. X3 нёс семнадцать двойных охладителей. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.16 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Zou - or "Elephant" - is one of the third generation of battle armor suits to be designed and fielded by the Draconis Combine. The suit was originally developed to be the successor to the Kanazuchi, an assault suit. It wasn't until the Zou was further developed by being upgraded with command-and-control (C2) capabilities that it came into its own, providing Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery commanders a heavier ground unit when deployed on combined-arms operations, directing troops, calling in long-range fire and artillery. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter.

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: The Prefect was an ammo-independent Republic of the Sphere BattleMech, designed specifically for guerrilla combat. With increasing legal tensions between the newborn Republic and military manufacturers who suffered heavy damage at the hands of Stone's Coalition during Operation SCOUR, Exarch Devlin Stone commissioned a new BattleMech intended to create jobs, bolster his military, and to stave off the worst of the lawsuits. While ultimately unsuccessful on the last count, the well-regarded Prefect would enter service with the public RAF as well as black ops units. Mandating a simple, fast and durable energy weapon design based on the guerrilla-style warfare he conducted in the early years of resistance to the Blakists, Stone was forced to make a number of concessions and include a more expensive Endo Steel chassis along with ferro-fibrous armor, as well as the more fragile Light Fusion Engine and XL Gyro in an attempt to win over the military-industrial complex.
