content.original: The Prefect was an ammo-independent Republic of the Sphere BattleMech, designed specifically for guerrilla combat. With increasing legal tensions between the newborn Republic and military manufacturers who suffered heavy damage at the hands of Stone's Coalition during Operation SCOUR, Exarch Devlin Stone commissioned a new BattleMech intended to create jobs, bolster his military, and to stave off the worst of the lawsuits. While ultimately unsuccessful on the last count, the well-regarded Prefect would enter service with the public RAF as well as black ops units. Mandating a simple, fast and durable energy weapon design based on the guerrilla-style warfare he conducted in the early years of resistance to the Blakists, Stone was forced to make a number of concessions and include a more expensive Endo Steel chassis along with ferro-fibrous armor, as well as the more fragile Light Fusion Engine and XL Gyro in an attempt to win over the military-industrial complex.

content.original: Designed by the Marian Hegemony using the most cutting-edge gear available to them, the Marauder Battle Armor is patterned after the venerable Marauder BattleMech. Armed with a pair of Support PPCs and a Light Recoilless Rifle, the Marauder BA is one of the most heavily armed BA in existence. The Marians deploy them in squads of five called a contubernium and the suits are designed for that kind of larger deployment. While not particularly well armored, their extreme firepower load for battle armor makes them deadly on the field. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount any unit, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Phoenix Hawk L is a light BattleMech, produced originally for the Draconis Combine at the dawn of the thirty-second century. It was modeled to resemble Crosby's old and remodeled Phoenix Hawk, which they had first produced in the 3060s, and was their BattleMechs Research Firm's bid to offer a replacement to the venerable Panther after the Second Combine-Dominion War. Alternately known as the Fenikkusu Taka, the Phoenix Hawk L retains the movement profile of its heavier predecessor.

content.original: The Quickdraw was originally built in 2779 as a replacement for the Rifleman BattleMech. While it was unsuccessful in supplanting the Rifleman, over time the Quickdraw proved itself to be a good generalist 'Mech. Packing excellent firepower, solid armor protection and above-average speed, it quickly earned the respect of many MechWarriors and status as a workhorse in every Successor State's military.

content.original: Created by a Capellan Confederation design team, the Thunderer was rushed into production during the chaos of the 4th succession war. Originally intended as a heavy tank to anchor second line formations and support infantry, the tank made a name for itself as a capable sniper that could harass and kill Mechs. The MK3 Thunderer mounts 10.5 tons of stealth armour and is built around a 165 rated XL engine. A paired RAC/5 and Large Laser are mounted in the turret, along with a TAG, providing the Thunderer with the means to spot for allied artillery units. A hull mounted Anti Missile System provides a modicum of defense against missiles. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: The Thanatos is a sturdy, hard-hitting BattleMech conceived to emulate the Clan Thor OmniMech. After years licensing OmniMechs, StarCorps Industries mastered the technology and in 3060 designed their own, debuting Thanatos as an OmniMech. However, the LAAF and AFFS, citing cost and existing inventory, declined new Omni designs. Pivoting, StarCorps converted it to a standard ’Mech and resubmitted; militaries adopted it. content.original: Created by a Capellan Confederation design team, the Thunderer was rushed into production during the chaos of the 4th succession war. Originally intended as a heavy tank to anchor second line formations and support infantry, the tank made a name for itself as a capable sniper that could harass and kill Mechs. The MK3 Thunderer mounts 10.5 tons of stealth armour and is built around a 165 rated XL engine. A paired RAC/5 and Large Laser are mounted in the turret, along with a TAG, providing the Thunderer with the means to spot for allied artillery units. A hull mounted Anti Missile System provides a modicum of defense against missiles. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: The Falconer was designed at the order of Hanse Davion to create a 'Mech that could tame the Jade Falcons and defeat a Clan OmniMech in one-on-one combat. The Falconer is powered by a 375 XL engine that propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. This speed is enhanced with greater mobility by fiv jump jets that allow the Falconer to jump the considerable distance of one hundred and fifty meters. The Falconer also saves weight to carry as many weapons as possible by using a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and carries eleven and a half tons of armor plating, which gives the Falconer a respectable amount of armor protection.

Машина оснащена двигателем XL 375, обеспечивающим максимальную скорость 86,4 км/ч. Высокая мобильность дополнительно повышается за счёт пяти прыжковых двигателей, позволяющих Falconer преодолевать по воздуху значительное расстояние в 150 метров. Для экономии массы и размещения максимально возможного количества вооружения в конструкции использовано шасси из более лёгкой эндостали, а наличие одиннадцати с половиной тонн брони обеспечивает меху достойный уровень защиты.

content.original: The Hermes III was created by Ostmann Industries by taking a Hermes II HER-2S and adapting it to the available technology in the Draconis Combine at that time. Its main goal was to act as a smaller companion to the Ostsol line, retaining the scouting and light skirmisher role of the original Hermes and Hermes II. As the demand for more upgraded mechs in these roles started growing, Luthien Armor Works upgraded a number of ageing first generation Hermes III to modern standards.

content.original: Originally intended to be a Solaris one-off design, the Dagoth took an unusual turn when outside investors had interest in a relatively cheap and tough stand-off mech. The Dagoth DG-A-1's modest armament for its weight class consists of a Gauss rifle and a pair of MML-9 launchers as the primary weapons but is backed up by 18 tons of armor and a large shield to keep it standing longer than many other assaults. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

A Gauss rifle, single LRM-10, and twin Large Lasers replace the pricier pulse laser and MML loadout, trading finesse for parts any backwater 'Mech bay can keep running. The trademark shield was kept due to its usefulness in garrison duties. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: Periphery armorers loved the DG-P-7 but cursed its Gauss rifle, whose ammunition proved scarce out in the sticks. The DG-P-7b refit fixes this by replacing the Gauss with a pair of common AC/5s feeding off plentiful standard rounds. The LRM-10 and twin Large Lasers remain, but the shield was dropped to reduce costs further as its repeated repairs proved too costly. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

Модификация DG-P-7b решает эту проблему заменой Гаусса на пару распространенных автопушек AC/5, использующих широко доступные стандартные снаряды. Установка сохранила пусковую установку LRM-10 и спаренные большие лазеры, однако от щита отказались для дополнительного снижения стоимости, поскольку его постоянный ремонт обходился слишком дорого. Особенность: Сбалансированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.15

content.original: VEST analyzers predicted a market for a more advanced version after the DG-P-7 proved its worth as a Periphery export, so VEST launched the DG-P-9. A switch to double heat sinks let it upgrade to extended-range Large Lasers and add a second LRM-10. In the end, even though it was capable it proved too costly, it found few takers among Periphery states long used to buying cheap. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

Поэтому компания выпустила DG-P-9. Переход на двойные охладители позволил установить большие лазеры повышенной дальности и добавить вторую пусковую установку LRM-10. Однако в итоге, несмотря на высокие боевые качества, машина оказалась слишком дорогой и не нашла широкого спроса среди государств Периферии, привыкших приобретать недорогую технику.
